	internal class MMTextBox : TextBox
	{
		private bool _isChangedStyleApplyed;

		private static DependencyProperty TextChangedStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TextChangedStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(MMTextBox));

		private string _previousValue = string.Empty;

		private string _regexParten;

		private static DependencyProperty ValueTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ValueType", typeof(Type), typeof(MMTextBox), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(object)));

		public Style TextChangedStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(TextChangedStyleProperty) as Style;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TextChangedStyleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string RegexConstraints
		{
			get
			{
				return _regexParten;
			}
			set
			{
				_regexParten = value.Replace("&lt;", "<");
			}
		}

		public Type ValueType
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ValueTypeProperty) as Type;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueTypeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyUp(e);
			if (e.Key == Key.Return)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = base.Parent as FrameworkElement;
				while (frameworkElement != null && !frameworkElement.Focus())
				{
					frameworkElement = frameworkElement.Parent as FrameworkElement;
				}
			}
			if (TextChangedStyle != null && !_isChangedStyleApplyed)
			{
				base.Style = TextChangedStyle;
				_isChangedStyleApplyed = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			InitContextMenu();
		}

		private void InitContextMenu()
		{
			ContextMenu contextMenu = new ContextMenu();
			contextMenu.Items.Add(new MenuItem
			{
				Header = UIResources.ContextMenu_Copy,
				CommandTarget = this,
				Command = ApplicationCommands.Copy
			});
			contextMenu.Items.Add(new MenuItem
			{
				Header = UIResources.ContextMenu_Paste,
				CommandTarget = this,
				Command = ApplicationCommands.Paste
			});
			contextMenu.Items.Add(new MenuItem
			{
				Header = UIResources.ContextMenu_Cut,
				CommandTarget = this,
				Command = ApplicationCommands.Cut
			});
			base.ContextMenu = contextMenu;
		}

		protected override void OnGotFocus(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGotFocus(e);
			_previousValue = base.Text;
		}

		protected override void OnLostFocus(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_regexParten))
			{
				string input = base.Text;
				if (base.Text != null && ValueType == typeof(double) && GetSystemDecimalSymbol() != ".")
				{
					input = base.Text.Replace(GetSystemDecimalSymbol(), ".");
				}
				if (!new Regex(_regexParten).IsMatch(input))
				{
					base.Text = _previousValue;
				}
			}
			else if (ValueType == typeof(double))
			{
				if (double.TryParse(base.Text, out var result))
				{
					base.Text = result.ToString("G6");
				}
				else
				{
					base.Text = _previousValue;
				}
			}
			if (_previousValue != base.Text)
			{
				base.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold;
			}
			base.OnLostFocus(e);
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ValueType == typeof(double))
			{
				if (e.Key == Key.Decimal)
				{
					if (GetSystemDecimalSymbol() != "." && e.OriginalSource is IInputElement inputElement)
					{
						inputElement.RaiseEvent(new TextCompositionEventArgs(e.Device, new TextComposition(InputManager.Current, inputElement, GetSystemDecimalSymbol()))
						{
							RoutedEvent = UIElement.TextInputEvent
						});
						e.Handled = true;
					}
				}
				else if (e.Key == Key.OemPeriod)
				{
					if (GetSystemDecimalSymbol() != ".")
					{
						e.Handled = true;
					}
				}
				else if (e.Key == Key.OemComma && GetSystemDecimalSymbol() != ",")
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			base.OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
		}

		public static string GetSystemDecimalSymbol()
		{
			return 0.1.ToString().Replace("0", string.Empty).Replace("1", string.Empty);
		}
	}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()

				textBox.PreviewTextInput += textBox_PreviewTextInput;
				textBox.LostFocus += textBox_LostFocus;

		private void textBox_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is TextBox textBox && textBox.Text != Value.ToString())
			{
				textBox.Text = Value.ToString();
				textBox.Focus();
			}
		}

		public NumericSpinBox()
		{
			ApplyTemplate();
		}

		private void textBox_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.Text) && Regex.IsMatch(e.Text, "\\D"))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		static NumericSpinBox()
		{
			LowerLimitProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LowerLimit", typeof(int?), typeof(NumericSpinBox), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			UpperLimitProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UpperLimit", typeof(int?), typeof(NumericSpinBox), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			SpinStepSizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SpinStepSize", typeof(int), typeof(NumericSpinBox), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1));
			ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Value", typeof(int), typeof(NumericSpinBox), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0));
			_spinUpCommand = new RoutedCommand("SpinUpCommand", typeof(NumericSpinBox));
			_spinDownCommand = new RoutedCommand("SpinDownCommand", typeof(NumericSpinBox));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(NumericSpinBox), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(NumericSpinBox)));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(NumericSpinBox), new CommandBinding(SpinUpCommand, OnSpinUp));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(NumericSpinBox), new CommandBinding(SpinDownCommand, OnSpinDown));
		}

		private static void OnSpinUp(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			NumericSpinBox numericSpinBox = sender as NumericSpinBox;
			if (numericSpinBox.UpperLimit.HasValue)
			{
				if (numericSpinBox.Value + numericSpinBox.SpinStepSize <= numericSpinBox.UpperLimit.Value)
				{
					numericSpinBox.Value += numericSpinBox.SpinStepSize;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				numericSpinBox.Value += numericSpinBox.SpinStepSize;
			}
		}

		private static void OnSpinDown(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			NumericSpinBox numericSpinBox = sender as NumericSpinBox;
			if (numericSpinBox.LowerLimit.HasValue)
			{
				if (numericSpinBox.Value - numericSpinBox.SpinStepSize >= numericSpinBox.LowerLimit.Value)
				{
					numericSpinBox.Value -= numericSpinBox.SpinStepSize;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				numericSpinBox.Value -= numericSpinBox.SpinStepSize;
			}
		}
	}

		private static void OnUnityContainerChanged(DependencyObject tabItem, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (tabItem is MMTabItem mMTabItem)
			{
				object newContainer = (object)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/;
				object oldValue = args.OldValue;
				mMTabItem.CreateContent((IUnityContainer)newContainer, (IUnityContainer)((oldValue is IUnityContainer) ? oldValue : null));
			}
		}

		private void CreateContent(IUnityContainer newContainer, IUnityContainer oldContainer)
		{
			if (newContainer != oldContainer && newContainer != null && !(ContentType == null))
			{
				base.Content = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve(Container, ContentType, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			}
		}

		private static void ContentTypePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is MMTabItem mMTabItem && e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				mMTabItem.OnContentTypeChanged(e.OldValue as Type, e.NewValue as Type);
			}
		}

		protected void OnContentTypeChanged(Type oldType, Type newType)
		{
			if (!(oldType == newType) && !(newType == null))
			{
				UpdateContent();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateContent()
		{
			if (!base.IsSelected || base.Content != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (Container != null)
				{
					base.Content = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve(Container, ContentType, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				}
				else
				{
					base.Content = Activator.CreateInstance(ContentType) as MMTabPage;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				base.Content = ex.Message;
			}
		}

		static MMTabItem()
		{
			ContainerProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MyContainer", typeof(IUnityContainer), typeof(MMTabItem), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnUnityContainerChanged));
			ContentTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ContentType", typeof(Type), typeof(MMTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, ContentTypePropertyChanged));
			VariableProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Variable", typeof(object), typeof(MMTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, VariablePropertyChanged));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MMTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(MMTabItem)));
		}

		public MMTabItem()
		{
			Binding binding = BindingOperations.GetBinding(this, VariableProperty);
			if (binding == null)
			{
				binding = new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath("Variable"),
					RelativeSource = new RelativeSource(RelativeSourceMode.FindAncestor)
					{
						AncestorType = typeof(MMViewModelContainer),
						AncestorLevel = 1
					},
					Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
				};
				SetBinding(VariableProperty, binding);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSelected(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateContent();
			OnVariableChange();
			base.OnSelected(e);
		}

		private static void VariablePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is MMTabItem mMTabItem && e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				mMTabItem.OnVariableChange();
			}
		}

		private void OnVariableChange()
		{
			if (base.Content != null && Variable != null && base.Content is MMTabPage mMTabPage)
			{
				mMTabPage.Variable = Variable as DataVariable;
			}
		}
	}

		protected double GetLimitedHeight(Grid maingrid, int nRowIndex)
		{
			double num = base.ActualHeight - 22.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < maingrid.RowDefinitions.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != nRowIndex)
				{
					num -= maingrid.RowDefinitions[i].ActualHeight;
				}
			}
			if (!(num < 10.0))
			{
				return num;
			}
			return 10.0;
		}

		[InjectionConstructor]
		public MMTabPage(IUnityContainer container)
		{
			base.Container = container;
			base.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Add(new ResourceDictionary
			{
				Source = new Uri("/Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface;component/Themes/Generic.xaml", UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute)
			});
			if (TryFindResource("MMPageStyle") is Style style)
			{
				base.Style = style;
			}
			if (_updateFormToken != null)
			{
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UpdateFormEvent>().Unsubscribe(_updateFormToken);
			}
			_updateFormToken = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UpdateFormEvent>().Subscribe(UpdateForm);
			HelpId = 0;
			base.CommandBindings.Add(new CommandBinding(ApplicationCommands.Help, OnHelpExecuted));
			base.Loaded += MMTabPage_Loaded;
			base.Unloaded += MMTabPage_Unloaded;
		}

		protected void ChangeStyleSetForLandingPage()
		{
			if (base.Template.FindName("Part_Viewer", this) is ScrollViewer scrollViewer)
			{
				scrollViewer.VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Disabled;
				scrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Disabled;
			}
			if (base.Template.FindName("Part_Content", this) is ContentPresenter contentPresenter)
			{
				contentPresenter.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Stretch;
			}
		}

		protected void OnHelpExecuted(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (HelpId != 0)
			{
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>())?.OnShowHelpHtml(HelpId);
			}
		}

		private void MMTabPage_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void MMTabPage_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ScrollContentPresenter scrollContentPresenter = Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, typeof(ScrollContentPresenter), allowSubclassOfType: false) as ScrollContentPresenter;
			if (base.ViewModel is Landing_Configuration_vm landing_Configuration_vm)
			{
				landing_Configuration_vm.Update();
			}
			if (scrollContentPresenter != null)
			{
				_contentBorder = scrollContentPresenter.Content as Border;
			}
			ApplyZoomFactor(_zoomFactor);
			InvalidateInContextGuidanceButtonLayout();
		}

		public void InvalidateInContextGuidanceButtonLayout()
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				MMInContextGuidanceButton.InvalidateInjectionPosition((ContentControl)this);
			}, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}

		public MMTabPage()
		{
			base.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Add(new ResourceDictionary
			{
				Source = new Uri("/Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface;component/Themes/Generic.xaml", UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute)
			});
			if (TryFindResource("MMPageStyle") is Style style)
			{
				base.Style = style;
			}
			HelpId = 0;
			base.CommandBindings.Add(new CommandBinding(ApplicationCommands.Help, OnHelpExecuted));
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{

			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewMouseWheel(e);
			try
			{
				if (e.Source != null && e.Source.GetType() == typeof(XamDataGrid))
				{
					if (_scrollViewer == null)
					{
						_scrollViewer = Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, typeof(ScrollViewer), allowSubclassOfType: false) as ScrollViewer;
					}
					if (_scrollViewer != null)
					{
						double offset = _scrollViewer.VerticalOffset - (double)e.Delta;
						_scrollViewer.ScrollToVerticalOffset(offset);
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public void OnClosing(CancelEventArgs args)
		{
			if (_updateFormToken != null)
			{
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UpdateFormEvent>().Unsubscribe(_updateFormToken);
			}
			_updateFormToken = null;
			OnClosing(this, args);
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosing(object sender, CancelEventArgs args)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateForm(UpdateFormArgs arg)
		{
			if (arg == null || (arg != null && arg.UpdateViewModel))
			{
				base.ViewModel?.OnUpdate(arg);
			}
			if (arg != null && arg.SpecifiedParas != null && arg.SpecifiedParas is object[] array)
			{
				object[] array2 = array;
				foreach (object obj in array2)
				{
					OnPropertyChanged(obj.ToString());
				}
			}
		}

				{
					SpecifiedParas = paras,
					UpdateViewModel = false
				});
			}
		}

		void IShellZoomable.Zoom(double factor)
		{
			object content = base.Content;
			IShellZoomable val = (IShellZoomable)((content is IShellZoomable) ? content : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.Zoom(factor);
			}
			else
			{
				ApplyZoomFactor(factor);
			}
			_zoomFactor = factor;
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyZoomFactor(double zoomFactor)
		{
			if (_contentBorder != null)
			{
				if (!(_contentBorder.LayoutTransform is ScaleTransform scaleTransform))
				{
					_contentBorder.LayoutTransform = new ScaleTransform(zoomFactor, zoomFactor);
					return;
				}
				double scaleX = (scaleTransform.ScaleY = zoomFactor);
				scaleTransform.ScaleX = scaleX;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnXamDataGridClipboardCopying(object sender, ClipboardCopyingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).Values == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (((IEnumerable<CellValueHolder>)((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).Values).Count() == 1)
			{
				CellValueHolder val = ((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).Values[0, 0];
				if (val != null && val.Value != null)
				{
					((CancelableRoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
					((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Handled = true;
					Clipboard.Clear();
					Clipboard.SetText(val.Value.ToString());
				}
				return;
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).Values.RecordCount; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < ((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).Values.FieldCount; j++)
				{
					CellValueHolder val2 = ((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).Values[i, j];
					if (val2.Value != null)
					{
						text += val2.Value.ToString();
						if (j + 1 < ((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).Values.FieldCount)
						{
							text += "\t";
						}
					}
				}
				if (i + 1 < ((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).Values.RecordCount)
				{
					text += "\r\n";
				}
			}
			((CancelableRoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
			((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Handled = true;
			Clipboard.Clear();
			Clipboard.SetText(text);
		}
	}

	public class MMTabStrip : Control, IShellZoomable
	{

		private double _zoomFactor = 1.0;

		{
			get

				return (IUnityContainer)((value is IUnityContainer) ? value : null);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ContainerProperty, value);
			}
		}

		bool IShellZoomable.SupportsZoom
		{
			get
			{
				MMTabItem mMTabItem = Items.FirstOrDefault((MMTabItem p) => p.IsSelected);
				if (mMTabItem != null)
				{
					object content = mMTabItem.Content;
					IShellZoomable val = (IShellZoomable)((content is IShellZoomable) ? content : null);
					if (val != null)
					{
						return val.SupportsZoom;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		static MMTabStrip()
		{
			ContainerProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("MyContainer", typeof(IUnityContainer), typeof(MMTabStrip), new PropertyMetadata(null, UnityContainerChanged));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MMTabStrip), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(MMTabStrip)));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(MMTabStrip), Selector.SelectionChangedEvent, new SelectionChangedEventHandler(TabControl_SelectionChanged));
		}

		private static void UnityContainerChanged(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is MMTabStrip mMTabStrip && e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				object oldValue = (object)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/;
				object newValue = e.NewValue;
				mMTabStrip.InjectionToChildControls((IUnityContainer)oldValue, (IUnityContainer)((newValue is IUnityContainer) ? newValue : null));
			}
		}

		private void InjectionToChildControls(IUnityContainer oldValue, IUnityContainer newValue)
		{
			if (newValue == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (MMTabItem item in Items)
			{
				UnityContainerExtensions.BuildUp(Container, item.GetType(), (object)item, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			}
		}

		void IShellZoomable.Zoom(double factor)
		{
			OnZoom(factor);
		}

		protected virtual void OnZoom(double factor)
		{
			_zoomFactor = factor;
			foreach (MMTabItem item in Items)
			{
				object content = item.Content;
				IShellZoomable val = (IShellZoomable)((content is IShellZoomable) ? content : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.Zoom(factor);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void TabControl_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			MMTabStrip control = sender as MMTabStrip;
			control.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				control.OnZoom(control._zoomFactor);
			}, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}
	}

	public class MMViewModelContainer : ContentControl
	{

		public static DependencyProperty ViewModelTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ViewModelType", typeof(Type), typeof(MMViewModelContainer), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnViewModelTypePropertyChange));

		private static DependencyProperty VariableProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Variable", typeof(DataVariable), typeof(MMViewModelContainer), new PropertyMetadata(OnVariableChanged));

		public static bool bIsBackground = false;

		[Dependency]
		public IUnityContainer Container
		{
			get
			{
				object value = GetValue(MyContainerProperty);
				return (IUnityContainer)((value is IUnityContainer) ? value : null);

		{

			}
			set

			}
		}

		public DataVariable Variable
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(VariableProperty) as DataVariable;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(VariableProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void UnityContainerChanged(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is MMViewModelContainer mMViewModelContainer && e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				object oldValue = (object)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/;
				object newValue = e.NewValue;
				mMViewModelContainer.InjectionToChildControl((IUnityContainer)oldValue, (IUnityContainer)((newValue is IUnityContainer) ? newValue : null));
				object oldValue2 = (object)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/;
				object newValue2 = e.NewValue;
				mMViewModelContainer.OnUnityContainerChanged((IUnityContainer)oldValue2, (IUnityContainer)((newValue2 is IUnityContainer) ? newValue2 : null));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnUnityContainerChanged(IUnityContainer oldValue, IUnityContainer newValue)
		{
		}

		private void InjectionToChildControl(IUnityContainer oldValue, IUnityContainer newValue)
		{
			if (newValue != null && base.Content != null)
			{
				UnityContainerExtensions.BuildUp(Container, base.Content.GetType(), base.Content, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (ViewModelType != null)
				{
					ViewModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve(newValue, ViewModelType, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()) as MMViewModel;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnViewModelTypePropertyChange(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is MMViewModelContainer mMViewModelContainer && e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				mMViewModelContainer.CreateViewModelInstance();
			}
		}

		private void CreateViewModelInstance()
		{
			if (!(ViewModelType == null))
			{
				if (Container == null)
				{
					ViewModel = Activator.CreateInstance(ViewModelType) as MMViewModel;
				}
				else
				{
					ViewModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve(Container, ViewModelType, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()) as MMViewModel;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnViewModelPropertyChange(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is MMViewModelContainer mMViewModelContainer && e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				mMViewModelContainer.BindingDataContext(e.OldValue as MMViewModel, e.NewValue as MMViewModel);
			}
		}

		private void BindingDataContext(MMViewModel oldValue, MMViewModel newValue)
		{
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				Binding binding = new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath("ViewModel"),
					RelativeSource = RelativeSource.Self
				};
				SetBinding(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, binding);
			}
		}

		private static void OnVariableChanged(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is MMViewModelContainer mMViewModelContainer && e.NewValue != e.OldValue && e.NewValue is DataVariable dataVariable)
			{
				if (mMViewModelContainer.ViewModel != null)
				{
					mMViewModelContainer.ViewModel.Key = dataVariable.ProjectKey;
				}
				mMViewModelContainer.OnVariableChanged(dataVariable, bIsBackground);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnVariableChanged(DataVariable dataVariable, bool bIsBackground)
		{
		}
	}

		{
			new NewHeatExchangerView(new HeatExchanger())
		}));

		private int _lowestDesignIndexer = -1;

		private double _correctionfactor = 0.8;

		public double SettleCorrectionFactor
		{
			get
			{
				Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.CaseDocument caseDocument = null;
				try
				{
					caseDocument = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.CaseDocument>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				}
				catch (ResolutionFailedException)
				{
					return 0.8;
				}
				string path = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_MinLMTDConrrectionFactor, base.ProjejectKey);
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = caseDocument?.GetValue(path);
				if ((dictionary == null || dictionary.Count == 0) && base.Container.Parent != null)
				{
					caseDocument = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.CaseDocument>(base.Container.Parent, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				}
				dictionary = caseDocument?.GetValue(path);
				if (dictionary == null || dictionary.Count == 0)
				{
					return 0.8;
				}
				if (!double.TryParse(dictionary.First().Value, out var result))
				{
					return 0.8;
				}
				_correctionfactor = result;
				return _correctionfactor;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<SurfaceAreanEntityView> SurfaceAreaCollection
		{
			get

		{
			//IL_018f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0199: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (para is RadioButton { Tag: not null } radioButton && int.TryParse(radioButton.Tag.ToString(), out var result))
			{
				NewHeatExchangerView newHeatExchangerView = null;
				if (radioButton.IsChecked.HasValue && radioButton.IsChecked.Value)
				{
					string s = string.Empty;
					foreach (NewHeatExchangerView item in NewHXCollection)
					{
						if (!MMViewModelContainer.bIsBackground && string.Compare(radioButton.Tag.ToString(), item.DesignIndex.ToString()) == 0)
						{
							item.IsSelected = true;
							s = item.Payback;
							newHeatExchangerView = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (newHeatExchangerView != null)
					{
						foreach (NewHeatExchangerView item2 in NewHXCollection)
						{
							if (item2 != newHeatExchangerView)
							{
								item2.IsSelected = false;
							}
						}
					}
					_lowestDesignIndexer = result;
					UpdateSummarries(base.ScenarioIdentifier, MMViewModelContainer.bIsBackground);
					string moniker = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_PaybackPeriod, base.ProjejectKey, base.ScenarioIdentifier);
					base.DataResolver.Write(moniker, double.Parse(s));
				}
				UnityContainerExtensions.RegisterInstance<int>(base.Container, base.ScenarioIdentifier + "DesignIndex" + UtilityBelongTo.AddHeatExchanger.ToString() + base.RetrofitIndex, _lowestDesignIndexer, (LifetimeManager)new ContainerControlledLifetimeManager());
				base.DataResolver.Write(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_DesignIndex, base.ProjejectKey, base.ScenarioIdentifier), _lowestDesignIndexer);
				string key = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_AddHeatExchanger_Item, base.ProjejectKey, base.ScenarioIdentifier, null, _lowestDesignIndexer.ToString());
				_surfaceAreaCollection = ((((_resolvedData != null && _resolvedData.ContainsKey(key)) ? _resolvedData[key] : null) as SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection) ?? new SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection()).OrderByDescending((SurfaceAreanEntityView item) => item.OriginalNewAea);
				NotifyPropertyChanged("SurfaceAreaCollection", "SummaryItems", "NewHXCollection");
			}
		});

				IEventAggregator eventAggregator = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (_subscriptionToken != null)
				{
					eventAggregator.GetEvent<DataSourceChangedEvent>().Unsubscribe(_subscriptionToken);
				}
				_subscriptionToken = eventAggregator.GetEvent<DataSourceChangedEvent>().Subscribe(delegate
				{
					base.Dispatcher.Invoke((Action<object>)delegate(object scenarioIdentifer2)
					{
						UpdateSource(scenarioIdentifer2, bIsBackground);
					}, scenarioIdentifer);
				}, ThreadOption.UIThread, keepSubscriberReferenceAlive: true, (DataSourceChangedEventArgs filter) => filter.SourceType == DataSourceTypeEnum.UpdateAddHeatExchanger && filter.State == null && filter.CanUpdate);
				UpdateSource(scenarioIdentifer, bIsBackground);
			}
			catch (ResolutionFailedException)
			{
			}
		}

		private string ExtractSelectedNewHeatExchangerName()
		{
			SummaryUtilityInformationView summaryUtilityInformationView = _summaryItems.FirstOrDefault((SummaryUtilityInformationView item) => item.DesignIndex == _lowestDesignIndexer);
			if (summaryUtilityInformationView == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(summaryUtilityInformationView.Name))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return summaryUtilityInformationView.NameData?.ToString();
		}

		private string BuildMainMoniker(string scenarioKey, string retrofitIndex)
		{
			return DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_AddHeatExchanger, scenarioKey: scenarioKey, retrofitIndex: retrofitIndex.ToString(), projectKey: base.ProjejectKey);
		}

		private void UpdateSource(object scenarioIdentifer, bool bIsBackground)
		{
			if (scenarioIdentifer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = BuildMainMoniker(scenarioIdentifer.ToString(), base.RetrofitIndex.ToString());
			_resolvedData = base.DataResolver.ResolveData(text);
			if (((_resolvedData != null && _resolvedData.ContainsKey(text)) ? _resolvedData[text] : null) is NewHeatExchangerViewCollection source && source.Count() > 0)
			{
				NewHXCollection = source.OrderBy((NewHeatExchangerView item) => double.Parse(item.Payback));
				NewHeatExchangerView newHeatExchangerView = source.FirstOrDefault((NewHeatExchangerView tempItem) => tempItem.IsSelected);
				if (newHeatExchangerView == null)
				{
					newHeatExchangerView = NewHXCollection.ElementAt(0);
				}
				if (!bIsBackground)
				{
					newHeatExchangerView.IsSelected = true;
				}
				_lowestDesignIndexer = newHeatExchangerView.DesignIndex;
				base.DataResolver.Write(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_DesignIndex, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer.ToString()), _lowestDesignIndexer);
				string moniker = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_PaybackPeriod, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer.ToString());
				base.DataResolver.Write(moniker, double.Parse(newHeatExchangerView.Payback));
			}
			UpdateSummarries(scenarioIdentifer, bIsBackground);
			string key = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_AddHeatExchanger_Item, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer.ToString(), null, _lowestDesignIndexer.ToString());
			_surfaceAreaCollection = ((((_resolvedData != null && _resolvedData.ContainsKey(key)) ? _resolvedData[key] : null) as SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection) ?? new SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection()).OrderByDescending((SurfaceAreanEntityView item) => item.OriginalNewAea);
			OnPropertyChanged("SurfaceAreaCollection");
			UpdateTreeNode(scenarioIdentifer.ToString());
		}

		private void UpdateSummarries(object scenarioIdentifer, bool bIsBackground)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)scenarioIdentifer))
			{
				return;
			}
			string moniker = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_Scenario, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer.ToString());
			_summaryItems = base.DataResolver.ResolveData<SummaryUtilities>(moniker);
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 1; i < _summaryItems.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				SummaryUtilityInformationView summaryUtilityInformationView = _summaryItems[i];
				if (summaryUtilityInformationView.RetrofitIndex == base.RetrofitIndex && summaryUtilityInformationView.BelongTo == UtilityBelongTo.AddHeatExchanger)
				{
					if (!bIsBackground)
					{
						summaryUtilityInformationView.IsSelected = summaryUtilityInformationView.DesignIndex == _lowestDesignIndexer;
					}
					_summaryItems[i] = summaryUtilityInformationView;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				base.DataResolver.Write(moniker, _summaryItems);
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("SummaryItems");
		}

		private void UpdateTreeNode(string scenarioIdentifer)
		{
			string text = ExtractSelectedNewHeatExchangerName();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				UpdateGridTitle(text);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateGridTitle(string hxName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(hxName) && ((Collection<FieldLayout>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)surfaceAreaGrid).FieldLayouts).Count != 0 && ((Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)surfaceAreaGrid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields).Count != 0)
			{
				((FieldItem)((Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)surfaceAreaGrid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields)[0]).Label = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, UIResources.AddExchanger_LocationTableTitle, hxName);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClosing(object sender, CancelEventArgs args)
		{
			if (_subscriptionToken != null)
			{
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<DataSourceChangedEvent>().Unsubscribe(_subscriptionToken);
			}
			if (TryFindResource("GridResource") is IDisposable disposable)

				disposable.Dispose();
			}
			((IDisposable)SurfaceGridPanel)?.Dispose();
			((IDisposable)SummaryGridPanel)?.Dispose();
			base.OnClosing(sender, args);
		}

		object IPersistent.Save()
		{
			AddXchangerState addXchangerState = new AddXchangerState
			{
				ShowAllExchange = SurfaceGridPanel.ShowAllHeatExchange
			};
			if (SurfaceGridPanel != null && SurfaceGridPanel.SurfaceAreaFields != null)
			{
				foreach (Field surfaceAreaField in SurfaceGridPanel.SurfaceAreaFields)
				{
					if (((FieldItem)surfaceAreaField).Label != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((FieldItem)surfaceAreaField).Label.ToString()) && !addXchangerState.FieldVisibilities.ContainsKey(((FieldItem)surfaceAreaField).Label.ToString()))
					{
						addXchangerState.FieldVisibilities.Add(((FieldItem)surfaceAreaField).Label.ToString(), ((FieldItem)surfaceAreaField).Visibility);
					}
				}
			}
			addXchangerState.ScreenZoomFactor = base._zoomFactor;
			return addXchangerState;
		}

		void IPersistent.Restore(object state)
		{
			if (!(state is AddXchangerState addXchangerState))
			{
				return;
			}
			base._zoomFactor = addXchangerState.ScreenZoomFactor;
			if (addXchangerState.ScreenZoomFactor == 0.0)
			{
				base._zoomFactor = 1.0;
			}
			if (SurfaceGridPanel == null || SurfaceGridPanel.SurfaceAreaFields == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Field surfaceAreaField in SurfaceGridPanel.SurfaceAreaFields)
			{
				if (((FieldItem)surfaceAreaField).Label != null && addXchangerState.FieldVisibilities.ContainsKey(((FieldItem)surfaceAreaField).Label.ToString()))
				{
					((FieldItem)surfaceAreaField).Visibility = addXchangerState.FieldVisibilities[((FieldItem)surfaceAreaField).Label.ToString()];
				}
			}
			SurfaceGridPanel.ShowAllHeatExchange = addXchangerState.ShowAllExchange;
		}

		private IList<CompareProjectInfo> ConstructData()
		{
			List<CompareProjectInfo> list = new List<CompareProjectInfo>();
			string[] projectKeys = EACFormFactory.ProjectKeys;
			Regex regex = new Regex("(\\d+)");
			string[] array = projectKeys;
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				Match match = regex.Match(text);
				string project = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(FormCategory.Project), match.ToString());
				UtilityView utilityView = base.DataResolver.ResolveData<UtilityView>(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_UtilityView, text));
				if (utilityView == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				CompareProjectInfo compareProjectInfo = new CompareProjectInfo();
				InitializeCompareProjectData(compareProjectInfo);
				compareProjectInfo.Project = project;
				string text2 = "    ";
				for (int j = 0; j < utilityView.UtilityItems.Count; j++)
				{
					if (utilityView.UtilityItems[j].Name == text2 + UIResources.Total_Hot_Utilities)
					{
						compareProjectInfo.HotEnergyCurrent = utilityView.UtilityItems[j].Current;
						compareProjectInfo.HotEnergyTarget = utilityView.UtilityItems[j].Target;
						compareProjectInfo.HotEnergySP = utilityView.UtilityItems[j].Scope;
						compareProjectInfo.HotGHGCurrent = utilityView.UtilityItems[j].GHGCurrent;
						compareProjectInfo.HotGHGTarget = utilityView.UtilityItems[j].GHGTarget;
						compareProjectInfo.HotGHGSP = utilityView.UtilityItems[j].GHGScope;
					}
					if (utilityView.UtilityItems[j].Name == text2 + UIResources.Total_Cold_Utilities)
					{
						compareProjectInfo.ColdEnergyCurrent = utilityView.UtilityItems[j].Current;
						compareProjectInfo.ColdEnergyTarget = utilityView.UtilityItems[j].Target;
						compareProjectInfo.ColdEnergySP = utilityView.UtilityItems[j].Scope;
						compareProjectInfo.ColdGHGCurrent = utilityView.UtilityItems[j].GHGCurrent;
						compareProjectInfo.ColdGHGTarget = utilityView.UtilityItems[j].GHGTarget;
						compareProjectInfo.ColdGHGSP = utilityView.UtilityItems[j].GHGScope;
					}
				}
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.CaseDocument>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>())?.GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Information_Notes, text));
				string text3 = ((dictionary == null || dictionary.Count == 0) ? string.Empty : dictionary.First().Value);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3) && text3.EndsWith("\r\n"))
				{
					text3 = text3.TrimEnd('\r', '\n');
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text3))
				{
					text3 = null;
				}
				compareProjectInfo.ProjectTooltip = text3;
				compareProjectInfo.TotalEnergyCurrent = Add(compareProjectInfo.HotEnergyCurrent, compareProjectInfo.ColdEnergyCurrent);
				compareProjectInfo.TotalEnergyTarget = Add(compareProjectInfo.HotEnergyTarget, compareProjectInfo.ColdEnergyTarget);
				compareProjectInfo.TotalEnergySP = Add(compareProjectInfo.HotEnergySP, compareProjectInfo.ColdEnergySP);
				compareProjectInfo.TotalGHGCurrent = Add(compareProjectInfo.HotGHGCurrent, compareProjectInfo.ColdGHGCurrent);
				compareProjectInfo.TotalGHGTarget = Add(compareProjectInfo.HotGHGTarget, compareProjectInfo.ColdGHGTarget);
				compareProjectInfo.TotalGHGSP = Add(compareProjectInfo.HotGHGSP, compareProjectInfo.ColdGHGSP);
				List<RowDetail> list2 = new List<RowDetail>();
				list2.Add(new RowDetail
				{
					C1 = UIResources.Total_Hot_Utilities,
					C2 = compareProjectInfo.HotEnergyCurrent,
					C3 = compareProjectInfo.HotEnergyTarget,
					C4 = compareProjectInfo.HotEnergySP,
					C5 = compareProjectInfo.HotGHGCurrent,
					C6 = compareProjectInfo.HotGHGTarget,
					C7 = compareProjectInfo.HotGHGSP
				});
				list2.Add(new RowDetail
				{
					C1 = UIResources.Total_Cold_Utilities,
					C2 = compareProjectInfo.ColdEnergyCurrent,
					C3 = compareProjectInfo.ColdEnergyTarget,
					C4 = compareProjectInfo.ColdEnergySP,
					C5 = compareProjectInfo.ColdGHGCurrent,
					C6 = compareProjectInfo.ColdGHGTarget,
					C7 = compareProjectInfo.ColdGHGSP
				});
				compareProjectInfo.RowDetails = list2;
				list.Add(compareProjectInfo);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static string Add(string s1, string s2)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(s1) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(s2) && double.TryParse(s1, out var result) && double.TryParse(s2, out var result2))
			{
				return (result + result2).ToString("G4");
			}
			return "0";
		}

			cpi.ColdGHGCurrent = "0";
			cpi.ColdGHGTarget = "0";
			cpi.ColdGHGSP = "0";
			cpi.TotalEnergyCurrent = "0";
			cpi.TotalEnergyTarget = "0";
			cpi.TotalEnergySP = "0";
			cpi.TotalGHGCurrent = "0";
			cpi.TotalGHGTarget = "0";
			cpi.TotalGHGSP = "0";
		}

		void IPersistent.Restore(object state)
		{
			if (!(state is CompareProjectResultFormState compareProjectResultFormState))
			{
				return;
			}

				}
			}
		}

		private Collection<CompareScenarioRecord> ConstructGridDataSource(ScenarioComparationCollection data)
		{
			Collection<CompareScenarioRecord> collection = new Collection<CompareScenarioRecord>();
			if (data.Count > 0)
			{
				int changedLineCount = data.Max((ScenarioComparationView item) => item.ValueFlex.Count());
				ScenarioComparationView scenarioComparationView = data.FirstOrDefault((ScenarioComparationView item) => item.ValueFlex.Count() == changedLineCount);
				for (int num = 0; num < changedLineCount; num++)
				{
					CompareScenarioRecord compareScenarioRecord = new CompareScenarioRecord();
					compareScenarioRecord.ConfigProjectProperty(scenarioComparationView.NameFlex.ElementAt(num).ToString(), null);
					compareScenarioRecord.ValueFlex = new string[data.Count];
					int num2 = 0;
					for (int count = data.Count; num2 < count; num2++)
					{
						compareScenarioRecord.ValueFlex[num2] = ((data[num2].ValueFlex.Count() <= num) ? string.Empty : data[num2].ValueFlex.ElementAt(num));
					}
					collection.Add(compareScenarioRecord);
				}
			}
			collection.Add(new CompareScenarioRecord
			{
				IsEmptyLine = true
			});
			ConstructCommonLines(data, collection);
			return collection;
		}

		private void ConstructCommonLines(ScenarioComparationCollection data, Collection<CompareScenarioRecord> source)
		{
			int num = 8;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				CompareScenarioRecord compareScenarioRecord = new CompareScenarioRecord
				{
					ValueFlex = new string[data.Count]
				};
				switch (i)
				{
				case 0:
					compareScenarioRecord.BaseDesign = data.BaseHotUtilitiesSummary;
					compareScenarioRecord.ConfigProjectProperty(UIResources.CompareScenarios_Project_HotUtilities_Title, "EnthalpyUserUnit");
					FillValueFlex("HotUtiliiesSummary", data, compareScenarioRecord.ValueFlex);
					break;
				case 1:
					compareScenarioRecord.BaseDesign = data.BaseColdUtilitiesSummary;
					compareScenarioRecord.ConfigProjectProperty(UIResources.CompareScenarios_Project_ColdUtilities_Title, "EnthalpyUserUnit");
					FillValueFlex("ColdUtiliesSummary", data, compareScenarioRecord.ValueFlex);
					break;
				case 2:
					compareScenarioRecord.ConfigProjectProperty(UIResources.CompareScenarios_Project_TotalEnergySaving_Title, "EnthalpyUserUnit");
					FillValueFlex("TotalEnergySavingSummary", data, compareScenarioRecord.ValueFlex);
					break;
				case 3:
					compareScenarioRecord.ConfigProjectProperty(UIResources.CompareScenarios_Project_EnergySaving_Title, null);
					FillValueFlex("EnergySavingSummary", data, compareScenarioRecord.ValueFlex);
					break;
				case 4:
					compareScenarioRecord.ConfigProjectProperty(string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0} [{1}]", UIResources.CompareScenarios_Project_EnergyCostSaving_Title, SystemUnit_Label.Instance.CostYearlyRateUnit), null);
					FillValueFlex("CostSaving", data, compareScenarioRecord.ValueFlex);
					break;
				case 5:
					compareScenarioRecord.ConfigProjectProperty(UIResources.CompareScenarios_Project_NewArea_Title, "AreaUserUnit");
					FillValueFlex("NewAreaSummary", data, compareScenarioRecord.ValueFlex);
					break;
				case 6:
					compareScenarioRecord.ConfigProjectProperty(UIResources.CompareScenarios_Project_ExtraCapital_Title, "FiscalUserUnit");
					FillValueFlex("ExtraCapitalSummary", data, compareScenarioRecord.ValueFlex);
					break;
				case 7:
					compareScenarioRecord.ConfigProjectProperty(UIResources.CompareScenarios_Project_Payback_Title, null);
					FillValueFlex("PaybackSummary", data, compareScenarioRecord.ValueFlex);
					break;
				}
				source.Add(compareScenarioRecord);
			}
		}

				}
			}
		}

				try
				{

				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = caseDocument?.GetValue(path);

		private string ExtractSelectedNewHeatExchangerName()
		{
			try
			{
				string result = null;
				foreach (SummaryUtilityInformationView summaryItem in _summaryItems)

		private void UpdateSource(object scenarioIdentifer)
		{
			string text = BuildMainMoniker(scenarioIdentifer.ToString(), base.RetrofitIndex.ToString());
			_resolvedData = base.DataResolver.ResolveData(text);
			if (((_resolvedData != null && _resolvedData.ContainsKey(text)) ? _resolvedData[text] : null) is RelocateHeatExchangerViewCollection source && source.Count() > 0)
			{
				RelcoateHXCollection = source.OrderBy((RelocateHeatExchangerView item) => double.Parse(item.Payback));
				RelocateHeatExchangerView relocateHeatExchangerView = source.FirstOrDefault((RelocateHeatExchangerView newItem) => newItem.IsSelected);
				if (relocateHeatExchangerView == null)
				{
					relocateHeatExchangerView = RelcoateHXCollection.ElementAt(0);
				}
				if (!MMViewModelContainer.bIsBackground)
				{
					relocateHeatExchangerView.IsSelected = true;
				}
				_lowestDesignIndexer = relocateHeatExchangerView.DesignIndex;
				base.DataResolver.Write(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_DesignIndex, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer.ToString()), _lowestDesignIndexer);
				string moniker = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_PaybackPeriod, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer.ToString());
				base.DataResolver.Write(moniker, double.Parse(relocateHeatExchangerView.Payback));
			}
			UpdateSummarries(scenarioIdentifer);
			string key = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_RelocateHeatExchanger_Item, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer.ToString(), null, _lowestDesignIndexer.ToString());
			_surfaceAreaCollection = ((((_resolvedData != null && _resolvedData.ContainsKey(key)) ? _resolvedData[key] : null) as SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection) ?? new SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection()).OrderByDescending((SurfaceAreanEntityView item) => item.OriginalNewAea);
			OnPropertyChanged("SurfaceAreaCollection");
			UpdateTreeNode(scenarioIdentifer.ToString());
		}

		private string BuildMainMoniker(string scenarioKey, string retrofitIndex)
		{
			return DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_RelocateHeatExchanger, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioKey, retrofitIndex);
		}

		private void UpdateSummarries(object scenarioIdentifer)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)scenarioIdentifer))
			{
				return;
			}
			string moniker = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_Scenario, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer.ToString());
			_summaryItems = base.DataResolver.ResolveData<SummaryUtilities>(moniker);
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 1; i < _summaryItems.Count; i++)
			{
				SummaryUtilityInformationView summaryUtilityInformationView = _summaryItems[i];
				if (summaryUtilityInformationView.RetrofitIndex == base.RetrofitIndex && summaryUtilityInformationView.BelongTo == UtilityBelongTo.RelocateHeatExchanger)
				{
					if (!MMViewModelContainer.bIsBackground)
					{
						summaryUtilityInformationView.IsSelected = summaryUtilityInformationView.DesignIndex == _lowestDesignIndexer;
					}
					_summaryItems[i] = summaryUtilityInformationView;
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				base.DataResolver.Write(moniker, _summaryItems);
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("SummaryItems");
		}

		private void UpdateTreeNode(string scenarioIdentifer)
		{
			string text = ExtractSelectedNewHeatExchangerName();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				UpdateGridTitle(text);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateGridTitle(string hxName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(hxName) && ((Collection<FieldLayout>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)surfaceAreaGrid).FieldLayouts).Count != 0 && ((Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)surfaceAreaGrid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields).Count != 0)
			{
				((FieldItem)((Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)surfaceAreaGrid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields)[0]).Label = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, UIResources.AddExchanger_LocationTableTitle, hxName);
			}
		}

			}
			if (TryFindResource("GridResource") is IDisposable disposable)

				disposable.Dispose();
			}
			((IDisposable)SurfaceGridPanel)?.Dispose();
			((IDisposable)SummaryGridPanel)?.Dispose();
			base.OnClosing(sender, args);
		}

		object IPersistent.Save()
		{
			ScenarioPageState scenarioPageState = new ScenarioPageState();
			if (SurfaceGridPanel != null && SurfaceGridPanel.surfaceAreaGrid != null)
			{
				scenarioPageState.ShowAllHeatExchange = SurfaceGridPanel.ShowAllHeatExchange;
				foreach (Field item in (Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)SurfaceGridPanel.surfaceAreaGrid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields)
				{
					if (((FieldItem)item).VisibilityResolved == Visibility.Visible)
					{
						scenarioPageState.VisibleHeatExchangerDetailsColumns.Add(item.Index);
					}
				}
			}
			scenarioPageState.ScreenZoomFactor = base._zoomFactor;
			return scenarioPageState;
		}

		void IPersistent.Restore(object state)
		{
			if (!(state is ScenarioPageState scenarioPageState))
			{
				return;
			}
			base._zoomFactor = scenarioPageState.ScreenZoomFactor;
			if (scenarioPageState.ScreenZoomFactor == 0.0)
			{
				base._zoomFactor = 1.0;
			}
			if (scenarioPageState.VisibleHeatExchangerDetailsColumns == null || scenarioPageState.VisibleHeatExchangerDetailsColumns.Count <= 0 || SurfaceGridPanel == null || SurfaceGridPanel.surfaceAreaGrid == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SurfaceGridPanel.ShowAllHeatExchange = scenarioPageState.ShowAllHeatExchange;
			foreach (Field item in (Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)SurfaceGridPanel.surfaceAreaGrid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields)
			{
				if (scenarioPageState.VisibleHeatExchangerDetailsColumns.Contains(item.Index))
				{
					((FieldItem)item).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else
				{
					((FieldItem)item).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
			}
		}

	internal class Project_Setup_HeatExchangerConstraints_vm : MMViewModel
	{
		private SubscriptionToken _token;

		private static double _LMTD = 0.8;

		private static double _maxAreaPerShell = 500.0;

		private static double _exchangerMinTemperature = 10.0;

		private IValueUnit _valueUnit;

		public ProcessStreamCollection MatchConstraintsStream => base.DataResolver.ResolveData<ProcessStreamCollection>(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_MatchConstraints, base.Key));

		public string LMTDCorrectionFactor
		{
			get
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> value = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_MinLMTDConrrectionFactor, base.Key));
				double result = -1.0;
				if (value != null && value.Count > 0)
				{
					double.TryParse(value.First().Value, out result);
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					SetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_MinLMTDConrrectionFactor, base.Key), _LMTD);
				}
				string text = "F2";
				if (result * 100.0 % 10.0 == 0.0)
				{
					text = "F1";
				}
				if (result > 0.0)
				{
					return result.ToString(text, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				}
				return _LMTD.ToString(text, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.Trim()))
				{
					return;
				}
				double num = 0.001;
				if (double.TryParse(value, out var result))
				{
					if (0.7 - num > result)
					{
						result = 0.7;
					}
					if (1.0 + num < result)
					{
						result = 1.0;
					}
					SetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_MinLMTDConrrectionFactor, base.Key), result);
					UpdateForm();
				}
			}
		}

		public string MaxAreaPerShell
		{
			get
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> value = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_MAxAreaPerShell, base.Key));
				if (value == null)
				{
					SetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_MAxAreaPerShell, base.Key), _maxAreaPerShell);
				}
				double result = -1.0;
				if (value != null && value.Count > 0)
				{
					double.TryParse(value.First().Value, out result);
				}
				if (result > 0.0)
				{
					if (ValueConverter == null)
					{
						return result.ToString("F1", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
					}
					return ((double)(object)ValueConverter.Convert(result, PropertyEnum.Area)).ToString("F1", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				}
				if (ValueConverter == null)
				{
					return _maxAreaPerShell.ToString("F1", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				}
				return ((double)(object)ValueConverter.Convert(_maxAreaPerShell, PropertyEnum.Area)).ToString("F1", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
			set
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.Trim()) && double.TryParse(value, out var result) && ValueConverter != null)
				{
					double num = (double)(object)ValueConverter.Convert(result, PropertyEnum.ToArea);
					if (!(num < 0.0) && !(num > 10000.0))
					{
						SetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_MAxAreaPerShell, base.Key), num);
						UpdateForm();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeAndBindData(string projectKey)
		{
			if (!_hxModelDict.ContainsKey(projectKey))
			{
				_hxModelDict.Add(projectKey, GetHeatExchangerModels());
			}
			_heatExchangerCostModels = _hxModelDict[projectKey];
			if (_heatExchangerCostModels == null || _heatExchangerCostModels.Count == 2)
			{
				_heatExchangerCostModels = GetHeatExchangerModels();
			}
			if (_allowAddNewRow && _heatExchangerCostModels.FirstOrDefault((HeatExchangerCostView item) => string.Compare(item.Name, _defaultNewModelName) == 0) == null)
			{
				_heatExchangerCostModels.Add(new HeatExchangerCostView
				{
					Name = _defaultNewModelName,
					FormulaType = HeatExchangerType.Unknow,
					Index = _heatExchangerCostModels.Count,
					ValueUnitConverter = UnitValueFactory.Create(_valueUnit)
				});
			}
			HeatExchangerCostView heatExchangerCostView = _heatExchangerCostModels[0];
			bool canBeDeleted = (_heatExchangerCostModels[1].CanBeDeleted = false);
			heatExchangerCostView.CanBeDeleted = canBeDeleted;
			_heatExchangerItem = _heatExchangerCostModels[0];
			OnPropertyChanged("HeatExchangerItem");
			_modelNames.Add("Default", UIResources.HeaterExchangerCost_CostRule_DefaultRuleName);
			_modelNames.Add("Fired Heater", UIResources.HeaterExchangerCost_CostRule_FireHeaterRuleName);
		}

		private BindingList<HeatExchangerCostView> GetHeatExchangerModels()
		{
			BindingList<HeatExchangerCostView> bindingList = new BindingList<HeatExchangerCostView>();
			string projectKey = ((base.Variable == null) ? "Project 1" : base.Variable.ProjectKey);
			Dictionary<string, string> value = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_HeatExchangerModel, projectKey), isResultXmlSection: true);
			if (value == null || value.Count == 0)
			{
				bindingList.Add(new HeatExchangerCostView
				{
					Name = UIResources.HeaterExchangerCost_CostRule_DefaultRuleName,
					ValueUnitConverter = UnitValueFactory.Create(_valueUnit),
					FormulaType = HeatExchangerType.HeatExchanger,
					VariableA = Convert.ToDouble("1.000e+04", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture),
					VariableB = 800.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture),
					VariableC = 0.8.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture),
					Index = 0
				});
				bindingList.Add(new HeatExchangerCostView
				{
					Name = UIResources.HeaterExchangerCost_CostRule_FireHeaterRuleName,
					ValueUnitConverter = UnitValueFactory.Create(_valueUnit),
					FormulaType = HeatExchangerType.FireHeater,
					VariableA = Convert.ToDouble("1.000e+05", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture),
					VariableB = Convert.ToDouble("1000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture),
					VariableC = 0.8.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture),
					Index = 1
				});
			}
			else
			{
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < value.Count; i++)
				{
					XElement xElement = XElement.Parse(value.ElementAt(i).Value);
					if (xElement == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable = xElement.Descendants("Name");
					IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable2 = xElement.Descendants("VariableA");
					IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable3 = xElement.Descendants("VariableB");
					IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable4 = xElement.Descendants("VariableC");
					IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable5 = xElement.Descendants("HTConfiguration");
					if (enumerable2 != null && enumerable2.Count() != 0 && enumerable != null && enumerable.Count() != 0 && enumerable3 != null && enumerable3.Count() != 0 && enumerable4 != null && enumerable4.Count() != 0 && enumerable5 != null && enumerable5.Count() != 0)
					{
						try
						{
							bindingList.Add(new HeatExchangerCostView
							{
								Name = enumerable.ElementAt(0).Value,
								ValueUnitConverter = UnitValueFactory.Create(_valueUnit),
								FormulaType = ((string.Compare(enumerable5.ElementAt(0).Value, "0") != 0) ? HeatExchangerType.FireHeater : HeatExchangerType.HeatExchanger),
								VariableA = enumerable2.ElementAt(0).Value,
								VariableB = enumerable3.ElementAt(0).Value,
								VariableC = enumerable4.ElementAt(0).Value,
								Index = num++
							});
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							_ = ex.Message;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return bindingList;
		}

		private void HXGrid_SelectedItemsChanged(object sender, SelectedItemsChangedEventArgs e)

		private void ChangeFormula(HeatExchangerType exchangerType)
		{
			switch (exchangerType)
			{
			case HeatExchangerType.HeatExchanger:
				_defaultFomulaVisiblity = Visibility.Visible;
				_fireHeatFomulaVisiblity = Visibility.Collapsed;
				break;
			case HeatExchangerType.FireHeater:
				_fireHeatFomulaVisiblity = Visibility.Visible;
				_defaultFomulaVisiblity = Visibility.Collapsed;
				break;
			}
			NotifyPropertyChanged("FireHeatFomulaVisibility", "DefaultFomulaVisibility");
		}

						{

							FormulaType = HeatExchangerType.Unknow,
							Index = _heatExchangerCostModels.Count,
							ValueUnitConverter = UnitValueFactory.Create(_valueUnit)
						});
						NotifyPropertyChanged("HeatExchangerCostModels");
						SendSingleHeatExchangerModel(heatExchangerCostView);
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					MessageBox.Show(string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, UIResources.HeaterExchangerCost_CostRuleGrid_Message_RuleExist, text), UIResources.HeaterExchangerCost_CostRuleGrid_Message_ErrorTitle, MessageBoxButton.OK);
					((ValuePresenter)(object)val4).StartEditMode();
					val4.Value = _defaultNewModelName;
				}
			}
			IList<string> source = (from item in _heatExchangerCostModels
				select item.Name into item
				where string.Compare(item, _defaultNewModelName, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) != 0
				select item).ToList();
			UpdateMatchCostingTable(source.AsEnumerable());
		}

		private void SendSingleHeatExchangerModel(HeatExchangerCostView heatExchanger)
		{
			if (heatExchanger != null)
			{
				if (heatExchanger.VariableA == string.Empty)
				{
					heatExchanger.VariableA = Convert.ToDouble("1.000e+04", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				if (heatExchanger.VariableB == string.Empty)
				{
					heatExchanger.VariableB = 800.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				if (heatExchanger.VariableC == string.Empty)
				{
					heatExchanger.VariableC = 0.8.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				Collection<IList<string>> collection = new Collection<IList<string>>();
				collection.Add(new string[6]
				{
					heatExchanger.Name,
					heatExchanger.VariableA,
					heatExchanger.VariableC,
					heatExchanger.VariableB,
					((int)heatExchanger.FormulaType).ToString(),
					heatExchanger.Index.ToString()
				});
				BackDoorMessage[] obj = new BackDoorMessage[1]
				{
					new BackDoorMessage
					{
						MessageType = BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.HeatExchangerCost_Models,
						State = collection
					}
				};
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Action<IList<BackDoorMessage>>>(base.Container, "SendingVariableAction", Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>())?.Invoke(obj);
			}
		}

		private void SetDefaultValue(HeatExchangerCostView dataItem, DataRecord dataRecord)
		{
			dataItem.VariableA = Convert.ToDouble("1.000e+04", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			dataItem.VariableB = 800.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			dataItem.VariableC = 0.8.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			dataRecord.Cells[1].Value = dataItem.DisplayVariableA;
			dataRecord.Cells[2].Value = dataItem.DisplayVariableB;
			dataRecord.Cells[3].Value = dataItem.DisplayVariableC;
			dataItem.FormulaType = HeatExchangerType.HeatExchanger;
			dataRecord.Cells[4].Value = dataItem.FormulaTypeName;
			_heatExchangerItem = dataItem;
			NotifyPropertyChanged("HeatExchangerItem");
		}

				return "auto";

		public string RateOfReturn
		{
			get
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> value = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_RateOfReturn, base.Key));
				if (value != null && value.Count > 0 && double.TryParse(value.First().Value, out var result))
				{
					return result.ToString("0.00");
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					SetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_RateOfReturn, base.Key), _rateOfReturn);
				}
				return _rateOfReturn.ToString("0.00");
			}
			set
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.Trim()))
				{
					Regex regex = new Regex("^((100(\\.0*)?)|([1-9]?[0-9]{1}(\\.[0-9]*)?))$");
					if (regex.IsMatch(value.Trim()))
					{
						double num = Convert.ToDouble(regex.Match(value.Trim()).Groups[1].Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						SetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_RateOfReturn, base.Key), num);
						UpdateForm();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public string AnnualizationCapitalCost
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Container == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				HYSYSParameters hYSYSParameters = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (hYSYSParameters == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				_OperationLifeOfPlant = hYSYSParameters.OperatingLifeOfPlant;
				Dictionary<string, string> value = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_RateOfReturn, base.Key));
				double result = _rateOfReturn;
				if (value != null && value.Count > 0)
				{
					double.TryParse(value.First().Value, out result);
				}
				if (result == 0.0)
				{
					result = _rateOfReturn;
				}
				return (result / 100.0 * Math.Pow(1.0 + result / 100.0, _OperationLifeOfPlant) / (Math.Pow(1.0 + result / 100.0, _OperationLifeOfPlant) - 1.0)).ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateDisplaySourceWithEnergyStream(string flowsheetName, bool isDisplay, bool fsChanged)
		{
			if (fsChanged)
			{
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).topologyChanged = true;
				string hYSYSFile = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).HYSYSFile;
				if (string.Equals(UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).SimulatorName, "aspenplus") && base.Container.Parent != null)
				{
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IApplicationWrapper>(base.Container.Parent, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ResetTopologyFlaginSimulator(hYSYSFile, topologyFlag: true);
				}
				else
				{
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IApplicationWrapper>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ResetTopologyFlaginSimulator(hYSYSFile, topologyFlag: true);
				}
			}
			foreach (HYSYSEnergyStream stream in _streams)
			{
				if (string.Compare(stream.FlowSheetName, flowsheetName) == 0 && stream.IsDisplay != isDisplay)
				{
					stream.IsDisplay = isDisplay;
				}
			}
			string path = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_Flowsheets, base.Key);
			Dictionary<string, string> value = GetValue(path);
			string text = "";
			if (value != null)
			{
				using Dictionary<string, string>.Enumerator enumerator2 = value.GetEnumerator();
				if (enumerator2.MoveNext())
				{
					text = enumerator2.Current.Value;
				}
			}
			List<string[]> list = new List<string[]>();
			string[] array = text.Split('|');
			foreach (string text2 in array)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					string[] item = text2.Split(',');
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (list.Count > 1)
			{
				foreach (string[] item2 in list)
				{
					if (item2[0] == flowsheetName)
					{
						item2[1] = (isDisplay ? "1" : "0");
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				list.Add(new string[2]
				{
					flowsheetName,
					isDisplay ? "1" : "0"
				});
			}
			string text3 = "";
			foreach (string[] item3 in list)
			{
				if (item3.Count() > 1)
				{
					text3 += $"{item3[0]},{item3[1]}|";
				}
			}
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).topologyChanged = true;
			SetValue(path, text3.Substring(0, text3.Length - 1));
			UpdateForm();
		}

		private void UpdateProcessTypeAreaUI(ComboxItemData dataItem)
		{
			if (dataItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool num = string.Compare(UIResources.SubflowsheetSelection_ProcessType_Content_UserSpecified, dataItem.Item, ignoreCase: true) == 0 || string.Compare(dataItem.Item, UIResources.SubflowsheetSelection_ProcessTypeDropdownDefault, ignoreCase: true) == 0;
			string value = string.Empty;
			if (!num)
			{
				string text = dataItem.ToolTip;
				string[] array = dataItem.ToolTip.Split(' ');
				IValueUnit valueUnit = UnitValueFactory.Create(UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).SimulatorName);
				if (array != null && valueUnit != null && double.TryParse(array[0], out var result))
				{
					result = Convert.ToDouble(array[0], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					string arg = ((double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(result, PropertyEnum.DeltaTemperature)).ToString("F1");
					if (array.Length > 2 && double.TryParse(array[2], out var result2))
					{
						result2 = Convert.ToDouble(array[2], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						string arg2 = ((double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(result2, PropertyEnum.DeltaTemperature)).ToString("F1");
						text = $"{arg} - {arg2} {SystemUnit_Label.Instance.TempUserUnit}";
					}
					else
					{
						text = $"{arg} {SystemUnit_Label.Instance.TempUserUnit}";
					}
				}
				value = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, UIResources.TypicalDTMinPrefix + text, dataItem.Item.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
			}
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Publish(new WorkflowControlStateArgs
			{
				ControlType = WorkflowControl.Tranfer,
				State = true
			});
			double num2 = 10.0;
			if (!double.IsNaN(dataItem.Value) && dataItem.Value > 0.0)
			{
				num2 = dataItem.Value;
			}
			SetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_ProcessType, base.Key), dataItem.Item);
			SetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_GlobalDTminTip, base.Key), value);
			SetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_GlobalDTmin, base.Key), num2.ToString("F1"));
			UtilityView utilityView = null;
			IDataResolver dataResolver = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IDataResolver>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (dataResolver != null)
			{
				utilityView = dataResolver.ResolveData<UtilityView>(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_UtilityView, base.Key));
			}
			if (utilityView != null)
			{
				utilityView.GlobalMinDeltaTemperature = num2;
			}
			Dictionary<string, string> value2 = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.CaseDocument>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_ExchangerMinApproachTemperature, base.Key));
			if (value2 != null && value2.Count > 0 && double.TryParse(value2.First().Value, out var result3) && num2 < result3)
			{
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.CaseDocument>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).Write(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_ExchangerMinApproachTemperature, base.Key), num2);
			}
		}

		static Project_Setup_SubflowsheetSelection_vm()
		{
			MatchCollection matchCollection = new Regex("\\{([^}]+)", RegexOptions.Multiline).Matches(UIResources.SubflowsheetSelection_ProcessType_Content);
			_processTypeModel = new ComboxItemData[matchCollection.Count + 2];
			_processTypeModel[0] = new ComboxItemData
			{
				Item = UIResources.SubflowsheetSelection_ProcessTypeDropdownDefault,
				Value = 10.0
			};
			for (int i = 0; i < matchCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				string value = matchCollection[i].Groups[1].Value;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					string[] array = value.Split(',');
					if (array.Length >= 3 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(array[0]) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(array[2]) && double.TryParse(array[1], out var result))
					{
						_processTypeModel[i + 1] = new ComboxItemData
						{
							Item = array[0].Trim(),
							Value = result,
							ToolTip = array[2].Trim()
						};
					}
				}
			}
			_processTypeModel[matchCollection.Count + 1] = new ComboxItemData
			{
				Item = UIResources.SubflowsheetSelection_ProcessType_Content_UserSpecified,
				Value = double.NaN
			};
		}

		public string BoilerFeedWaterTemperature
		{
			get
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> value = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.DataExtraction_ExtractRule_BoilerWater, base.Key));

				return _boilerFeedWaterTemperature.ToString("F1", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) + SystemUnit_Label.Instance.TempUserUnit;

			set
			{
				Regex regex = new Regex("(^\\d+)");
				if (regex.IsMatch(value.Trim()))

					double num = Convert.ToDouble(regex.Match(value.Trim()).Groups[1].Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					if (num > 0.0)
					{
						_boilerFeedWaterTemperature = num;
					}
				}
				SetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.DataExtraction_ExtractRule_BoilerWater, base.Key), _boilerFeedWaterTemperature);

			}

		protected override void SenarioChanged(string scenarioIdentifer, bool bIsBackground)
		{
			try
			{
				if (_token != null)
				{
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<DataSourceChangedEvent>().Unsubscribe(_token);
				}
				if (bIsBackground)
				{
					return;
				}
				_token = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<DataSourceChangedEvent>().Subscribe(delegate
				{
					base.Dispatcher.Invoke((Action<object>)delegate(object scenarioIdentifer2)
					{
						UpdateSource(scenarioIdentifer2);
					}, scenarioIdentifer);
				}, ThreadOption.UIThread, keepSubscriberReferenceAlive: true, (DataSourceChangedEventArgs filter) => filter.SourceType == DataSourceTypeEnum.Summary || filter.SourceType == DataSourceTypeEnum.ModifyHeatExchanger);
				UpdateSource(scenarioIdentifer);
				((Project_Summary_vm)base.ViewModel).Update(base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer);
			}
			catch (ResolutionFailedException)
			{
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClosing(object sender, CancelEventArgs args)
		{
			if (_token != null && base.Container != null)
			{
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<DataSourceChangedEvent>().Unsubscribe(_token);
			}
			if (base.ViewModel is Project_Summary_vm project_Summary_vm)
			{
				project_Summary_vm.UnRegisterEvents();
			}
			((IDisposable)SummaryGridPanel)?.Dispose();
			base.OnClosing(sender, args);
		}

		private void UpdateSource(object scenarioIdentifer)

			_summaryItems = base.DataResolver.ResolveData<SummaryUtilities>(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_Scenario, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer.ToString()));
			if (_summaryItems == null)
			{
				_summaryItems = new SummaryUtilities();
			}
			try
			{
				IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> enumerable = _summaryItems.Where((SummaryUtilityInformationView item) => item.IsSelected);
				if (enumerable.Count() == 2 && _summaryItems.Count > enumerable.Count())
				{
					SetDefaultSelectedSummaryUtility(scenarioIdentifer, _summaryItems.ElementAt(1).BelongTo);
					enumerable = _summaryItems.Where((SummaryUtilityInformationView item) => item.IsSelected);
				}
				SummaryUtilities summaryUtilities = new SummaryUtilities();
				foreach (SummaryUtilityInformationView item in enumerable)
				{
					summaryUtilities.Add(item);
				}
				_summaryItems = ParsePaybackCapitalCostSurface((summaryUtilities.Count != 0) ? summaryUtilities : _summaryItems, scenarioIdentifer.ToString()) ?? _summaryItems;

			catch (ResolutionFailedException)
			{
				_summaryItems = ParsePaybackCapitalCostSurface(_summaryItems, scenarioIdentifer.ToString()) ?? _summaryItems;
			}
			if (_summaryItems != null && _summaryItems.Count > 0)
			{
				OnPropertyChanged("SummaryItems");
			}
		}

		private SummaryUtilities ParsePaybackCapitalCostSurface(SummaryUtilities source, string scenarioIdentifyer)
		{
			try
			{
				if (source == null || source.Count() < 3)
				{
					return null;
				}
				IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> enumerable = new SummaryUtilities();
				IEnumerable<IGrouping<int, SummaryUtilityInformationView>> enumerable2 = from item in source
					group item by item.RetrofitIndex;
				IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> source2 = null;
				foreach (IGrouping<int, SummaryUtilityInformationView> item in enumerable2)
				{
					if (item.Key == 0)
					{
						source2 = item;
						continue;
					}
					IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> enumerable3 = FilterSummaryUtilityInformationView(item, item.Key, scenarioIdentifyer);
					if (enumerable3 != null)
					{
						enumerable = enumerable.Union(enumerable3);
					}
				}
				SummaryUtilities summaryUtilities = new SummaryUtilities();
				summaryUtilities.Add(source2.FirstOrDefault());
				foreach (SummaryUtilityInformationView item2 in enumerable)
				{
					summaryUtilities.Add(item2);
				}
				summaryUtilities.Add(source2.LastOrDefault());
				return summaryUtilities;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

						string moniker5 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_NewSurfaceArea, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifyer);
						base.DataResolver.Write(moniker5, surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView mdItem) => mdItem.OriginalNewAea));
					}
					return source;
				}
				default:
					return source;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				_ = ex.Message;
				return source;
			}
			return summaryUtilities;
		}

	public class Project_Scenario : MMTabPage
	{
		private static DependencyProperty ScenarioProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Scenario", typeof(string), typeof(Project_Scenario), new PropertyMetadata(OnSenarioChangeEvent));

		private static SubscriptionToken _clearDataToken;

		private static SubscriptionToken _subscriptionToken;

		private static int _retrofitIndex;

		private string _scenarioIdentifer;

		public string Scenario
		{
			get

			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ScenarioProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected int RetrofitIndex => _retrofitIndex;

		protected string ScenarioIdentifier => _scenarioIdentifer;

		protected string ProjejectKey
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Variable != null)
				{
					return base.Variable.ProjectKey;
				}
				return "Project 1";
			}
