		}

		public Project_Scenario(IUnityContainer container)
			: base(container)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnClosing(object sender, CancelEventArgs args)
		{
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				if (_subscriptionToken != null)
				{
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Unsubscribe(_subscriptionToken);
				}
				if (_clearDataToken != null)
				{
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Unsubscribe(_clearDataToken);
				}
			}
			base.OnClosing(sender, args);
		}

		private static void OnSenarioChangeEvent(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue != e.OldValue && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.NewValue as string) && sender is Project_Scenario project_Scenario)
			{
				Regex regex = new Regex("Scenario\\s*\\(*(\\d+)\\)*");
				Match match = regex.Match(e.NewValue.ToString());
				if (regex.IsMatch(e.NewValue.ToString()) && match.Groups.Count != 0 && double.TryParse(match.Groups[1].Value, out var result))
				{
					Regex regex2 = new Regex("RetrofitIndex\\s*(\\d+)");
					match = regex2.Match(e.NewValue.ToString());
					_retrofitIndex = ((!regex2.IsMatch(e.NewValue.ToString()) || match.Groups.Count == 0) ? 1 : int.Parse(match.Groups[1].Value));
					project_Scenario.OnScenarioChanged(result + " Scenario");
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnScenarioChanged(string scenarioIndentifier)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			_scenarioIdentifer = scenarioIndentifier;
			UnityContainerExtensions.RegisterInstance<int>(base.Container, "RetrofitIndex", _retrofitIndex, (LifetimeManager)new ContainerControlledLifetimeManager());
			IEventAggregator eventAggregator = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (_subscriptionToken != null)
			{
				eventAggregator.GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Unsubscribe(_subscriptionToken);
			}
			_subscriptionToken = eventAggregator.GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Subscribe(delegate(WorkflowControlStateArgs e)
			{
				object[] array = e.State as object[];
				eventAggregator.GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Publish(new WorkflowControlStateArgs
				{
					ControlType = WorkflowControl.ModifyHeatExchanger_ProcessBar,
					State = new object[5]
					{
						"message",
						array[1],
						array[2],
						array[3],
						(array.Length > 4) ? array[4] : null
					}
				});
			}, ThreadOption.UIThread, keepSubscriberReferenceAlive: true, delegate(WorkflowControlStateArgs filter)
			{
				if (filter.ControlType != WorkflowControl.ModifyHeatExchanger_ProcessBar)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!(filter.State is object[] array) || array.Length < 5 || string.Compare("SolutionStatus", array[0].ToString(), StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) != 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return !(array[4] is bool) || !(bool)array[4];
			});
			if (_clearDataToken != null)
			{
				eventAggregator.GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Unsubscribe(_clearDataToken);
			}
			_clearDataToken = eventAggregator.GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Subscribe(delegate(WorkflowControlStateArgs e)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.Invoke(delegate
				{
					try
					{
						object[] array = e.State as object[];
						if (array.Length >= 3 && !(array[0] is string))
						{
							_ = ScenarioIdentifier;
						}
					}
					catch (ResolutionFailedException)
					{
					}
					catch (XPathException)
					{
					}
				});
			}, ThreadOption.PublisherThread, keepSubscriberReferenceAlive: false, (WorkflowControlStateArgs filter) => filter.ControlType == WorkflowControl.ClearCachedData);
		}

		protected override void OnVariableChanged(DataVariable dataVariable, bool bIsBackground)
		{
			SenarioChanged(_scenarioIdentifer, bIsBackground);
		}

		protected virtual void SenarioChanged(string scenarioIdentifer, bool bIsBackground)
		{
		}
	}

		public double SettleCorrectionFactor
		{
			get
			{
				Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.CaseDocument caseDocument = null;
				try
				{
					caseDocument = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.CaseDocument>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				}
				catch (ResolutionFailedException)
				{
					return 0.8;
				}
				string path = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_MinLMTDConrrectionFactor, base.ProjejectKey);
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = caseDocument?.GetValue(path);
				if ((dictionary == null || dictionary.Count == 0) && base.Container.Parent != null)
				{
					caseDocument = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.CaseDocument>(base.Container.Parent, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				}
				dictionary = caseDocument?.GetValue(path);
				if (dictionary == null || dictionary.Count == 0)
				{
					return 0.8;
				}
				if (!double.TryParse(dictionary.First().Value, out var result))
				{
					return 0.8;
				}
				_correctionfactor = result;
				return _correctionfactor;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<SurfaceAreanEntityView> SurfaceAreaCollection => _surfaceAreaCollection;

		private void UpdateSource(object scenarioIdentifer)

		private void DataBind(object scenarioIdentifer)
		{
			SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection = base.DataResolver.ResolveData<SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection>(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_ModifyHeatExchanger, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer.ToString(), base.RetrofitIndex.ToString()));
			if (surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection != null)
			{
				_surfaceAreaCollection = surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection.OrderByDescending((SurfaceAreanEntityView item) => item.OriginalNewAea);
				string moniker = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_TotalCapitalCost, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer.ToString());
				base.DataResolver.Write(moniker, _surfaceAreaCollection.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView item) => item.ExtraCapitalCost));
				string moniker2 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_NewSurfaceArea, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer.ToString());
				base.DataResolver.Write(moniker2, _surfaceAreaCollection.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView item) => item.OriginalNewAea));
				OnPropertyChanged("SurfaceAreaCollection");
			}
			_summaryItems = base.DataResolver.ResolveData<SummaryUtilities>(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_Scenario, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioIdentifer.ToString()));
			OnPropertyChanged("SummaryItems");
		}

		object IPersistent.Save()
		{
			ScenarioPageState scenarioPageState = new ScenarioPageState();
			if (SurfaceGridPanel != null && SurfaceGridPanel.surfaceAreaGrid != null)
			{
				scenarioPageState.ShowAllHeatExchange = SurfaceGridPanel.ShowAllHeatExchange;
				foreach (Field item in (Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)SurfaceGridPanel.surfaceAreaGrid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields)
				{
					if (((FieldItem)item).VisibilityResolved == Visibility.Visible)
					{
						scenarioPageState.VisibleHeatExchangerDetailsColumns.Add(item.Index);
					}
				}
			}
			scenarioPageState.ScreenZoomFactor = base._zoomFactor;
			return scenarioPageState;
		}

		void IPersistent.Restore(object state)
		{
			if (!(state is ScenarioPageState scenarioPageState))
			{
				return;
			}
			base._zoomFactor = scenarioPageState.ScreenZoomFactor;
			if (scenarioPageState.ScreenZoomFactor == 0.0)
			{
				base._zoomFactor = 1.0;
			}
			if (scenarioPageState.VisibleHeatExchangerDetailsColumns == null || scenarioPageState.VisibleHeatExchangerDetailsColumns.Count <= 0 || SurfaceGridPanel == null || SurfaceGridPanel.surfaceAreaGrid == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SurfaceGridPanel.ShowAllHeatExchange = scenarioPageState.ShowAllHeatExchange;
			foreach (Field item in (Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)SurfaceGridPanel.surfaceAreaGrid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields)
			{
				if (scenarioPageState.VisibleHeatExchangerDetailsColumns.Contains(item.Index))
				{
					((FieldItem)item).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else
				{
					((FieldItem)item).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CellValuePresenter_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			CellValuePresenter val = (CellValuePresenter)((sender is CellValuePresenter) ? sender : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ValueEditor editor = ((ValuePresenter)(object)val).Editor;
			if (editor != null && !editor.IsReadOnly && Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(editor, typeof(TextBox), allowSubclassOfType: false) is TextBox textBox)
			{
				string empty = string.Empty;
				empty = ((e.Text == " ") ? GetPreviewInputStringWhenAddText(textBox, " ") : ((!(e.Text == ".")) ? GetPreviewInputStringWhenAddText(textBox, e.Text) : GetPreviewInputStringWhenAddText(textBox, GetSystemDecimalSymbol())));
				if (!maskDoubleValue(empty, 0))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				else if (e.Text == ".")
				{
					textBox.Text = empty;
					textBox.SelectionStart = empty.Length;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public static string GetPreviewInputStringWhenAddText(TextBox tb, string previewAddingText)
		{
			string text = tb.Text;
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (text != null)
			{
				int selectionStart = tb.SelectionStart;
				selectionStart = ((selectionStart > text.Length) ? text.Length : selectionStart);
				int selectionLength = tb.SelectionLength;
				int num = selectionStart + selectionLength;
				num = ((num > tb.Text.Length) ? tb.Text.Length : num);
				string obj = ((selectionStart == 0) ? string.Empty : text.Substring(0, selectionStart));
				string text2 = ((num >= text.Length) ? string.Empty : text.Substring(selectionStart + selectionLength));
				return obj + previewAddingText + text2;
			}
			return previewAddingText;
		}

		public static string GetSystemDecimalSymbol()
		{
			return 0.1.ToString().Replace("0", string.Empty).Replace("1", string.Empty);
		}

		public static bool maskDoubleValue(string testString, int MaxLength)
		{
			testString = testString.Replace(GetSystemDecimalSymbol(), ".");
			if (!maskDoubleRegex.IsMatch(testString) || (MaxLength != 0 && testString.Length > MaxLength))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(testString) && (testString.Contains("e") || testString.Contains("E")))
			{
				if (double.TryParse(testString, out var result))
				{
					if (result < -1E+300 || result > 1E+300)
					{
						return false;
					}
					int num = result.ToString().IndexOf("e", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
					if (num > -1 && num > 0 && int.TryParse(result.ToString().Substring(num + 1), out var result2) && (result2 < -300 || result2 > 300))
					{
						return false;
					}
					num = testString.IndexOf("e", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
					if (result == 0.0 && double.TryParse(testString.Substring(0, num), out var result3) && result3 != 0.0)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!double.TryParse(testString, out result) && validDoubleRegex.IsMatch(testString))
				{
					int num2 = testString.IndexOf("e", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
					if (num2 > -1 && int.TryParse(testString.Substring(num2 + 1), out var result4) && result4 >= -300 && result4 <= 300)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CrossPinchCompare(Field currentField, bool? isHotStream, HeatExchangerPinchValueComparison comparison)
		{
			syncContext.Post(delegate
			{
				DataPresenterBase dataPresenter = ((FieldItem)currentField).Owner.DataPresenter;
				if (dataPresenter != null)
				{
					RecordCollectionBase records = dataPresenter.Records;
					IEnumerable<SurfaceAreanBaseView> enumerable = new SurfaceAreanBaseViewCollection();
					enumerable = HeatExchangerDetails;
					if (enumerable != null && records != null && ((IEnumerable<Record>)records).Count() == enumerable.Count())
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < enumerable.Count(); i++)
						{
							Record obj = records[i];
							DataRecord val = (DataRecord)(object)((obj is DataRecord) ? obj : null);
							SurfaceAreanBaseView surfaceAreanBaseView = val.DataItem as SurfaceAreanBaseView;
							if (comparison == HeatExchangerPinchValueComparison.UnKnow)
							{
								((Record)val).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
							}
							else if (isHotStream.Value)
							{
								((Record)val).Visibility = ((surfaceAreanBaseView.HotStreamPinchValueComparison != comparison) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
							}
							else
							{
								((Record)val).Visibility = ((surfaceAreanBaseView.ColdStreamPinchValueComparison != comparison) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
							}
						}
						switch (comparison)
						{
						case HeatExchangerPinchValueComparison.Above:
							if (isHotStream.Value)
							{
								SetHotFilterCheck(0);
							}
							else
							{
								SetColdFilterCheck(0);
							}
							break;
						case HeatExchangerPinchValueComparison.Below:
							if (isHotStream.Value)
							{
								SetHotFilterCheck(1);
							}
							else
							{
								SetColdFilterCheck(1);
							}
							break;
						case HeatExchangerPinchValueComparison.Across:
							if (isHotStream.Value)
							{
								SetHotFilterCheck(2);
							}
							else
							{
								SetColdFilterCheck(2);
							}
							break;
						default:
							if (isHotStream.Value)
							{
								SetHotFilterCheck(3);
							}
							else
							{
								SetColdFilterCheck(3);
							}
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}, null);
		}

		private void HeatExchangerDetailsGrid_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (HotSideFluidFilterIndex < imgHots.Length - 1 && HotSideFluidFilterIndex > -1)
			{
				CrossPinchCompare(((Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)HeatExchangerDetailsGrid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields)[14], true, (HeatExchangerPinchValueComparison)HotSideFluidFilterIndex);
			}
			else if (ColdSideFluidFilterIndex < imgHots.Length - 1 && ColdSideFluidFilterIndex > -1)
			{
				CrossPinchCompare(((Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)HeatExchangerDetailsGrid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields)[15], false, (HeatExchangerPinchValueComparison)ColdSideFluidFilterIndex);
			}
		}

	internal abstract class UserUnitResource : INotifyPropertyChanged, IDisposable
	{
		private IList<string> _properties;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		private void OnPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		protected UserUnitResource(params string[] propertyName)
		{
			SystemUnit_Label.Instance.PropertyChanged += OnPropertyChanged;
			SystemUnit_Label.Instance.AddProperty(propertyName);
			_properties = propertyName;
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			if (_properties != null)
			{
				SystemUnit_Label.Instance.RemoveProperty(_properties.ToArray());
			}
			SystemUnit_Label.Instance.PropertyChanged -= OnPropertyChanged;
		}
	}
	internal class HeatExchangerDetailsSortComparer : IComparer
	{
		public int Compare(object x, object y)
		{
			if (x == null && y == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (x == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (y == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (x is int && y is int)
			{
				return ((int)x).CompareTo((int)y);
			}
			if (x is double && y is double)
			{
				return ((double)x).CompareTo((double)y);
			}
			double result = 0.0;
			double result2 = 0.0;
			if (double.TryParse(x.ToString(), out result) && double.TryParse(y.ToString(), out result2))
			{
				return result.CompareTo(result2);
			}
			if (x is string && y is string)
			{
				return ((string)x).CompareTo((string)y);
			}
			if (x.GetType() == y.GetType() && x is IComparable)
			{
				return ((IComparable)x).CompareTo(y);
			}
			return x.ToString().CompareTo(y.ToString());
		}
	}

	public class XamEditorValueConvert : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.ToString().Trim()))
			{
				if (parameter is XamTextEditor xamTextEditor)
				{
					xamTextEditor.Text = "";
					xamTextEditor.Value = "";
				}
				return value;
			}
			if (value.ToString().StartsWith("."))
			{
				return 0 + value.ToString();
			}
			return Regex.Replace(value.ToString(), "^0*([1-9]+)", "$1");
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

namespace IGDataChart.Custom.Behaviors
{
	public class ChartStripBehaviors : DependencyObject
	{
		internal const string ChartInfoStripsPropertyName = "ChartInfoStrips";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChartInfoStripsProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ChartInfoStrips", typeof(ChartInfoStripsBehavior), typeof(ChartStripBehaviors), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnInfoStripsChanged(o as XamDataChart, e.OldValue as ChartInfoStripsBehavior, e.NewValue as ChartInfoStripsBehavior);
		}));

		public static ChartInfoStripsBehavior GetChartInfoStrips(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return target.GetValue(ChartInfoStripsProperty) as ChartInfoStripsBehavior;
		}

		public static void SetChartInfoStrips(DependencyObject target, ChartInfoStripsBehavior behavior)
		{
			target.SetValue(ChartInfoStripsProperty, behavior);
		}

		private static void OnInfoStripsChanged(XamDataChart chart, ChartInfoStripsBehavior oldValue, ChartInfoStripsBehavior newValue)
		{
			if (chart != null)
			{
				oldValue?.OnDetach(chart);
				newValue?.OnAttach(chart);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartInfoStripsBehavior : DependencyObject
	{
		private XamDataChart _owner;

		internal const string InfoStripsPropertyName = "InfoStrips";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty InfoStripsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("InfoStrips", typeof(InfoStripCollection), typeof(ChartInfoStripsBehavior), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(o as ChartInfoStripsBehavior).OnStripsChanged(e.OldValue as InfoStripCollection, e.NewValue as InfoStripCollection);
		}));

		public InfoStripCollection InfoStrips
		{
			get
			{
				return (InfoStripCollection)GetValue(InfoStripsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(InfoStripsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate InfoStripTemplate { get; set; }

		public ChartInfoStripsBehavior()
		{
			InfoStrips = new InfoStripCollection();
		}

		private void OnStripsChanged(InfoStripCollection oldValue, InfoStripCollection newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.CollectionChanged -= OnStripsCollectionChanged;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.CollectionChanged += OnStripsCollectionChanged;
			}
			RefreshStrips();
		}

		private void OnStripsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RefreshStrips();
		}

		public void OnAttach(XamDataChart chart)
		{
			if (_owner != null)
			{
				OnDetach(_owner);
			}
			_owner = chart;
			_owner.WindowRectChanged += Owner_WindowRectChanged;
			_owner.SizeChanged += Owner_SizeChanged;
			_owner.Axes.CollectionChanged += Axes_CollectionChanged;
			_owner.Axes.CollectionResetting += Axes_CollectionResetting;
			RefreshStrips();
		}

		public void OnDetach(XamDataChart chart)
		{
			if (_owner == chart)
			{
				_owner.WindowRectChanged -= Owner_WindowRectChanged;
				_owner.SizeChanged -= Owner_SizeChanged;
				_owner.Axes.CollectionChanged -= Axes_CollectionChanged;
				_owner.Axes.CollectionResetting -= Axes_CollectionResetting;
				GetAxes(out var xAxis, out var yAxis);
				if (xAxis != null && yAxis != null)
				{
					ClearExisting(xAxis);
					_owner = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void Owner_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RefreshStrips();
		}

		private void Owner_WindowRectChanged(object sender, RectChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RefreshStrips();
		}

		private void Axis_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RefreshStrips();
		}

		private void Axes_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (Axis oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					oldItem.SizeChanged -= Axis_SizeChanged;
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (Axis newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.SizeChanged += Axis_SizeChanged;
				}
			}
			RefreshStrips();
		}

		private void Axes_CollectionResetting(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (Axis axis in _owner.Axes)
			{
				axis.SizeChanged -= Axis_SizeChanged;
			}
			RefreshStrips();
		}

		private void GetAxes(out Axis xAxis, out Axis yAxis)
		{
			if (_owner == null)
			{
				xAxis = null;
				yAxis = null;
				return;
			}
			xAxis = _owner.Axes.Where((Axis axis) => axis is NumericXAxis || axis is CategoryXAxis || axis is CategoryDateTimeXAxis).FirstOrDefault();
			yAxis = _owner.Axes.Where((Axis axis) => axis is NumericYAxis).FirstOrDefault();
		}

		private void ClearExisting(Axis xAxis)
		{
			if (xAxis.RootCanvas != null)
			{
				(from child in xAxis.RootCanvas.Children.OfType<UIElement>()
					where child is ContentControl && (child as ContentControl).Content != null && (child as ContentControl).Content is InfoStrip
					select child).ToList().ForEach(delegate(UIElement ele)
				{
					xAxis.RootCanvas.Children.Remove(ele);
				});
			}
		}

		private void RefreshStrips()
		{
			GetAxes(out var xAxis, out var yAxis);
			if (xAxis == null || yAxis == null || xAxis.RootCanvas == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ClearExisting(xAxis);
			Rect viewportRect = GetViewportRect(xAxis);
			Rect windowRect = _owner.WindowRect;
			foreach (InfoStrip infoStrip2 in InfoStrips)
			{
				InfoStrip infoStrip = infoStrip2.Clone();
				bool isInverted = xAxis.IsInverted;
				ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, isInverted);
				if (!infoStrip.UseDates)
				{
					if (double.IsNaN(infoStrip.StartX))
					{
						infoStrip.StartX = viewportRect.Left;
					}
					else
					{
						infoStrip.StartX = xAxis.GetScaledValue(infoStrip.StartX, p);
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(infoStrip.EndX))
					{
						infoStrip.EndX = viewportRect.Right;
					}
					else
					{
						infoStrip.EndX = xAxis.GetScaledValue(infoStrip.EndX, p);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					infoStrip.StartX = xAxis.GetScaledValue(infoStrip.StartDate.Ticks, p);
					infoStrip.EndX = xAxis.GetScaledValue(infoStrip.EndDate.Ticks, p);
				}
				isInverted = yAxis.IsInverted;
				p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewportRect, isInverted);
				if (double.IsNaN(infoStrip.StartY))
				{
					infoStrip.StartY = viewportRect.Top;
				}
				else
				{
					infoStrip.StartY = yAxis.GetScaledValue(infoStrip.StartY, p);
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(infoStrip.EndY))
				{
					infoStrip.EndY = viewportRect.Bottom;
				}
				else
				{
					infoStrip.EndY = yAxis.GetScaledValue(infoStrip.EndY, p);
				}
				if (infoStrip.StripTemplate == null)
				{
					infoStrip.StripTemplate = InfoStripTemplate;
				}
				if (infoStrip.StripTemplate != null && !double.IsNaN(infoStrip.StartY) && !double.IsInfinity(infoStrip.StartY) && !double.IsNaN(infoStrip.StartX) && !double.IsInfinity(infoStrip.StartX))
				{
					ContentControl contentControl = new ContentControl();
					contentControl.ContentTemplate = infoStrip.StripTemplate;
					contentControl.Content = infoStrip;
					Canvas.SetLeft(contentControl, infoStrip.StartX);
					Canvas.SetTop(contentControl, infoStrip.StartY);
					xAxis.RootCanvas.Children.Add(contentControl);
				}
			}
		}

		private Rect GetViewportRect(Axis axis)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double actualHeight = axis.ActualHeight;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = axis.ActualWidth - num2;
			double num4 = actualHeight - num;
			if (num3 > 0.0 && num4 > 0.0)
			{
				return new Rect(num2, num, num3, num4);
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}
	}
	public class InfoStrip : DependencyObject, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private Guid _id;

		private string _startDateString;

		private string _endDateString;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LabelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Label", typeof(string), typeof(InfoStrip), new PropertyMetadata(OnLabelChanged));

		public Guid Id
		{
			get
			{
				return _id;
			}
			private set
			{
				_id = value;
			}
		}

		public double StartX { get; set; }

		public double EndX { get; set; }

		public double StartY { get; set; }

		public double EndY { get; set; }

		public string StartDateString
		{
			get
			{
				return _startDateString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					_startDateString = value;
					StartDate = DateTime.Parse(_startDateString);
				}
			}
		}

		public string EndDateString
		{
			get
			{
				return _endDateString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					_endDateString = value;
					EndDate = DateTime.Parse(_endDateString);
				}
			}
		}

		public DateTime StartDate { get; set; }

		public DateTime EndDate { get; set; }

		public bool UseDates { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush Fill { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate StripTemplate { get; set; }

		public string Label
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(LabelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LabelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double Width => Math.Abs(EndX - StartX);

		public double Height => Math.Abs(EndY - StartY);

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public InfoStrip()
		{
			_id = Guid.NewGuid();
			StartX = double.NaN;
			EndX = double.NaN;
			StartY = double.NaN;
			EndY = double.NaN;
		}

		private InfoStrip(Guid id)
		{
			_id = id;
			StartX = double.NaN;
			EndX = double.NaN;
			StartY = double.NaN;
			EndY = double.NaN;
		}

		private static void OnLabelChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((InfoStrip)obj).OnPropertyChanged("Label");
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string name)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
		}

		public InfoStrip Clone()
		{
			return new InfoStrip(_id)
			{
				StartX = StartX,
				StartY = StartY,
				EndX = EndX,
				EndY = EndY,
				Label = Label,
				StripTemplate = StripTemplate,
				Fill = Fill,
				UseDates = UseDates,
				StartDate = StartDate,
				EndDate = EndDate
			};
		}
	}
	public class InfoStripCollection : ObservableCollection<InfoStrip>
	{
	}
}

		public CaseDocument(string filePath = null)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath))
			{
				_filePath = filePath;
				LoadDocument(filePath);
			}
		}

		public string GetCaseFilePath(IUnityContainer container)
		{
			return UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).HYSYSFile;
		}

		private void LoadDocument(string filePath)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!_dictDoc.ContainsKey(filePath))
			{
				_dictDoc.Add(filePath, CreateDocument());
			}
			_doc = _dictDoc[filePath];
			if (File.Exists(filePath))
			{
				try
				{
					_doc.Load(filePath);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					try
					{
						_dictDoc.Remove(filePath);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
					_doc = null;
					return;
				}
			}
			if (_doc.DocumentElement != null && _doc.DocumentElement.Attributes["Version"] == null)
			{
				ConvertToNewVersionDocument(_doc);
			}
		}

		private void ConvertToNewVersionDocument(XmlDocument doc)
		{
			foreach (XmlNode childNode in doc.DocumentElement.ChildNodes)
			{
				if (childNode.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element)
				{
					XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = doc.CreateAttribute(null, "ProjectID", null);
					xmlAttribute.Value = EscapeXmlCharactors("Project 1");
					childNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute);
				}
			}
		}

		public object Read(string path)
		{
			if (_doc == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XmlNodeList xmlNodeList = _doc.DocumentElement.SelectNodes(path.Replace('.', '/'));
			if (xmlNodeList == null || xmlNodeList.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			foreach (XmlNode item in xmlNodeList)
			{
				arrayList.Add(item.FirstChild.Value);
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		public Dictionary<string, IList<string>> ReadEnergyStream()
		{
			Dictionary<string, IList<string>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, IList<string>>();
			if (_doc == null)
			{
				return dictionary;
			}
			XmlNodeList xmlNodeList = _doc.DocumentElement.SelectNodes("Flowsheet/SelectedFlowsheets/Flowsheet");
			if (xmlNodeList == null || xmlNodeList.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (XmlNode item in xmlNodeList)
			{
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(item.InnerText.GetHashCode().ToString()))
				{
					dictionary.Add((item.FirstChild ?? item).InnerText.GetHashCode().ToString(), (item.SelectSingleNode("UtiltiesType") ?? item.FirstChild ?? item).InnerText.Split(';'));
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public void RemoveCachedValues(string projKey)
		{
			if (_values == null || cachedKeys == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (string key in cachedKeys.Keys)
			{
				if (!key.Contains(projKey))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (_values.ContainsKey(cachedKeys[key]))
				{
					_values.Remove(cachedKeys[key]);
				}
				if (_doc == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				XmlNodeList xmlNodeList = _doc.DocumentElement.SelectNodes(key.Replace('.', '/'));
				if (xmlNodeList != null && xmlNodeList.Count != 0)
				{
					for (int num = xmlNodeList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
					{
						xmlNodeList[num].ParentNode.RemoveChild(xmlNodeList[num]);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemoveClosedFile(string filePath)
		{
			if (_dictDoc.ContainsKey(filePath))
			{
				_dictDoc.Remove(filePath);
			}
		}

		public Dictionary<string, string> GetValue(string path, bool isResultXmlSection = false)
		{
			path = path.Replace('.', '/');
			int hashCode = path.GetHashCode();
			if (_values.ContainsKey(hashCode))
			{
				return _values[hashCode];
			}
			if (_doc == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XmlNodeList xmlNodeList = _doc.DocumentElement.SelectNodes(path);
			if (xmlNodeList == null || xmlNodeList.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < xmlNodeList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!isResultXmlSection)
				{
					if (!dictionary.Keys.Contains((xmlNodeList[i].FirstChild ?? xmlNodeList[i]).InnerText))
					{
						dictionary.Add((xmlNodeList[i].FirstChild ?? xmlNodeList[i]).InnerText, (xmlNodeList[i].LastChild ?? xmlNodeList[i]).InnerText);
					}
				}
				else if (!dictionary.Keys.Contains(xmlNodeList[i].InnerXml))
				{
					dictionary.Add(xmlNodeList[i].InnerXml, xmlNodeList[i].OuterXml);
				}
			}
			_values.Add(hashCode, dictionary);
			return dictionary;
		}

		public void Save(IUnityContainer container, string saveToPath = null)
		{
			string filePath = GetFilePath(container, saveToPath);
			try
			{
				NavigatorTreeNodeCollection navigatorTreeNodeCollection = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<NavigatorTreeNodeCollection>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (navigatorTreeNodeCollection == null || navigatorTreeNodeCollection.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < navigatorTreeNodeCollection.Count; i++)
				{
					foreach (EACTreeNode child in navigatorTreeNodeCollection[i].Children)
					{
						foreach (EACTreeNode child2 in child.Children)
						{
							UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UITreeNodeSelectionEvent>().Publish(new UITreeNodeSelectionArgs
							{
								NodeKey = child2.Key,
								State = new object[3]
								{
									true,
									OperationEnum.Save,
									child2.OwnedRetorfitIndex
								}
							});
						}
						UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UITreeNodeSelectionEvent>().Publish(new UITreeNodeSelectionArgs
						{
							NodeKey = child.Key,
							State = new object[3]
							{
								true,
								OperationEnum.Save,
								child.OwnedRetorfitIndex
							}
						});
					}
				}
				SaveNavigationTree(container);
				IEnumerable<HYSYSEnergyStream> enumerable = null;
				Dictionary<string, List<Subflowsheet>> subflowsheetDict = FlowsheetDataSource.SubflowsheetDict;
				HYSYSParameters hYSYSParameters = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (hYSYSParameters != null && hYSYSParameters.EnergyStreams != null && hYSYSParameters.EnergyStreams.Count() > 0)
				{
					enumerable = hYSYSParameters.EnergyStreams.Where((HYSYSEnergyStream item) => item.IsDisplay);
				}
				foreach (NavigatorTreeNode item in navigatorTreeNodeCollection)
				{
					string keyReadOnly = item.KeyReadOnly;
					if (!subflowsheetDict.ContainsKey(keyReadOnly))
					{
						continue;
					}
					List<Subflowsheet> list = subflowsheetDict[keyReadOnly];
					string text = "";
					string text2 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_Flowsheets, keyReadOnly);
					foreach (Subflowsheet item2 in list)
					{
						string name = item2.Name;
						string arg = (item2.IsSelected ? "1" : "0");
						text += $"{name},{arg}|";
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text.Length > 0)
					{
						string text3 = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 1);
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
						{
							Write(text2, text3);
						}
						if (_doc != null && _doc.DocumentElement != null)
						{
							XmlNodeList xmlNodeList = _doc.DocumentElement.SelectNodes(text2.Replace('.', '/'));
							if (xmlNodeList != null && xmlNodeList.Count > 0)
							{
								XmlNode xmlNode = xmlNodeList[0];
								if (xmlNode != null)
								{
									xmlNode.InnerText = text3;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					foreach (Subflowsheet fl in list)
					{
						if (enumerable != null)
						{
							IEnumerable<string> value = from item in enumerable
								where fl.IsSelected && item.FlowSheetName.Equals(fl.Name)
								select item.UtilityName;
							Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
							dictionary.Add("ID", fl.Name.GetHashCode().ToString());
							Write(text2, fl.Name, isRepeated: true, dictionary);
							Write(text2 + "[@ID=\"" + fl.Name.GetHashCode() + "\"].UtiltiesType", value, isRepeated: true);
						}
					}
					Collection<BackDoorMessage> heatExchangerModelBackDoorMessages = Project_Setup_HeatExchangerCost.HeatExchangerModelBackDoorMessages;
					RecordBackDoorMessage(heatExchangerModelBackDoorMessages, keyReadOnly);
				}
				int num = 0;
				string text4;
				do
				{
					Thread.Sleep(500);
					text4 = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IDataResolver>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).Save();
					num++;
				}
				while (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4) && num < 6);
				Write("EnginData", Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text4)));
				if (_doc != null)
				{
					_doc.Save(filePath);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		private string GetFilePath(IUnityContainer container, string newFilePath)
		{
			string text = newFilePath;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(System.IO.Path.GetFileName(text).Trim()))
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_filePath))
				{
					HYSYSParameters hYSYSParameters = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
					if (hYSYSParameters != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(hYSYSParameters.CasePath))
					{
						_filePath = System.IO.Path.ChangeExtension(hYSYSParameters.CasePath, GetXmlExtension(hYSYSParameters.CasePath));
					}
				}
				return _filePath;
			}
			return System.IO.Path.ChangeExtension(text, GetXmlExtension(text));
		}

		private void SaveNavigationTree(IUnityContainer container)
		{
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UpdateTreeEvent>().Publish(new UpdateTreeEventArgs
			{
				Action = OperationEnum.Save
			});
			IDataResolver dataResolver = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IDataResolver>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (dataResolver == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = dataResolver.ResolveData<string>("NavigationTree");
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				UINavigatorViewModel uINavigatorViewModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<UINavigatorViewModel>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (uINavigatorViewModel != null)
				{
					int num = 0;
					do
					{
						Thread.Sleep(500);
						text = uINavigatorViewModel.SavedResult;
					}
					while (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && num < 6);
				}
			}
			Write("Navigation.Tree", Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text)));
		}

		private bool IsHysysBk(string casefile)
		{
			string extension = System.IO.Path.GetExtension(casefile);
			if (!extension.StartsWith(".bk") || !(extension != ".bkp"))
			{
				if (extension.StartsWith(".xm"))
				{
					return extension != ".xml";
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private string GetXmlExtension(string casefile)
		{
			if (IsHysysBk(casefile))
			{
				return System.IO.Path.GetExtension(casefile).Replace(".bk", ".xm").Substring(1);
			}
			return "xml";
		}

		public void Restore(IUnityContainer container, string filePath, bool isBackground = false, bool isEALaunched = true)
		{
			string text = System.IO.Path.ChangeExtension(filePath, GetXmlExtension(filePath));
			if (_values != null && !isEALaunched)
			{
				_values.Clear();
			}
			if (!File.Exists(text) && !isEALaunched)
			{
				FilePath = null;
				_doc = null;
				IDataResolver dataResolver = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IDataResolver>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (dataResolver != null && !isEALaunched)
				{
					dataResolver.Load(null);
				}
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UpdateTreeEvent>().Publish(new UpdateTreeEventArgs
				{
					Action = OperationEnum.CreateDefault,
					State = ThreadOption.BackgroundThread
				});
				return;
			}
			FilePath = text;
			if (Read("EnginData") is ArrayList { Count: >0 } arrayList)
			{
				IDataResolver dataResolver2 = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IDataResolver>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (dataResolver2 != null)
				{
					dataResolver2.Active(text);
					dataResolver2.Load(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(Convert.FromBase64String(arrayList[0].ToString())));
				}
			}
			if (Read("Navigation.Tree") is ArrayList { Count: >0 } arrayList2)
			{
				string text2 = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(Convert.FromBase64String(arrayList2[0].ToString()));
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UpdateTreeEvent>().Publish(new UpdateTreeEventArgs
				{
					Action = OperationEnum.Restore,
					State = new object[2] { isBackground, text2 }
				});
			}
		}

		public void Active(IUnityContainer container, string casePath)
		{
			IDataResolver dataResolver = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IDataResolver>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			dataResolver.Active(System.IO.Path.ChangeExtension(casePath, GetXmlExtension(casePath)));
			string text = dataResolver.ResolveData<string>("NavigationTree");
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UpdateTreeEvent>().Publish(new UpdateTreeEventArgs
			{
				Action = OperationEnum.Restore,
				State = new object[2] { false, text }
			});
		}

		public void Write(string path, object value, bool isRepeated = false, Dictionary<string, string> attributes = null)
		{
			int hashCode = path.Replace('.', '/').GetHashCode();
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			if (value != null)
			{
				dictionary.Add(value.ToString(), value.ToString());
			}
			if (_values.ContainsKey(hashCode))
			{
				_values[hashCode] = dictionary;
			}
			else
			{
				_values.Add(hashCode, dictionary);
			}
			if (cachedKeys.ContainsKey(path))
			{
				cachedKeys[path] = hashCode;
			}
			else
			{
				cachedKeys.Add(path, hashCode);
			}
			if (isRepeated)
			{
				ProceedRepeatedNode(path, value, attributes);
			}
			else
			{
				ProceedUniqueNode(path, value);
			}
		}

		private void RecordBackDoorMessage(IEnumerable<BackDoorMessage> messages, string projectKey)
		{
			Parallel.ForEach(messages, delegate(BackDoorMessage msg)
			{
				RecordHeatExchangerCostModels(msg.State as IEnumerable<IList<string>>, projectKey);
			});
		}

		private void RecordHeatExchangerCostModels(IEnumerable<IList<string>> models, string projectKey)
		{
			if (models == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string modelNode = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_HeatExchangerModel, projectKey);
			foreach (IList<string> model in models)
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				dictionary.Add("ID", model[0].GetHashCode().ToString());
				Write(modelNode, null, isRepeated: true, dictionary);
				Parallel.For(0, model.Count, delegate(int indexer)
				{
					string text = string.Empty;
					switch (indexer)
					{
					case 0:
						text = "Name";
						break;
					case 1:
						text = "VariableA";
						break;
					case 3:
						text = "VariableB";
						break;
					case 4:
						text = "HTConfiguration";
						break;
					case 2:
						text = "VariableC";
						break;
					}
					lock (modelNode)
					{
						Write(modelNode + "[@ID=\"" + model[0].GetHashCode() + "\"]." + text, model[indexer], isRepeated: true);
					}
				});
			}
		}

		private void ProceedUniqueNode(string path, object value)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (value is IEnumerable<string>)
			{
				foreach (string item in value as IEnumerable<string>)
				{
					text = item + ";";
				}
				text = text.TrimEnd(';');
			}
			else
			{
				text = (value ?? string.Empty).ToString();
			}
			XmlNode xmlNode = FindNode(path);
			if (xmlNode != null)
			{
				xmlNode.InnerText = EscapeXmlCharactors(text);
			}
		}

		private void ProceedRepeatedNode(string path, object value, Dictionary<string, string> attributes = null)
		{
			if (_doc == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (value is IEnumerable<string>)
			{
				foreach (string item in value as IEnumerable<string>)
				{
					text = text + item + ";";
				}
				text = text.TrimEnd(';');
			}
			else
			{
				text = (value ?? string.Empty).ToString();
			}
			XmlNode xmlNode = FindNode(path.Substring(0, path.LastIndexOf('.')));
			XmlNode node = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (attributes != null && attributes.Keys.Count > 0)
			{
				string text2 = attributes.Keys.First();
				string xpath = path.Replace('.', '/') + "[@" + text2 + "=\"" + new Regex("\\s+").Replace(EscapeXmlCharactors(attributes[text2]), string.Empty) + "\"]";
				node = _doc.DocumentElement.SelectSingleNode(xpath);
				flag = node != null;
				if (node == null)
				{
					node = _doc.CreateNode(XmlNodeType.Element, path.Substring(path.LastIndexOf('.') + 1), null);
				}
				try
				{
					Parallel.ForEach(attributes.Keys, delegate(string key)
					{
						XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = _doc.CreateAttribute(key, null);
						xmlAttribute.Value = new Regex("\\s+").Replace(EscapeXmlCharactors(attributes[key]), string.Empty);
						node.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute);
					});
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					ex.ToString();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				node = _doc.CreateNode(XmlNodeType.Element, path.Substring(path.LastIndexOf('.') + 1), null);
			}
			node.InnerText = EscapeXmlCharactors(text);
			if (!flag)
			{
				xmlNode.AppendChild(node);
			}
		}

		private XmlNode FindNode(string path)
		{
			if (_doc == null || _doc.DocumentElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XmlNodeList xmlNodeList = _doc.DocumentElement.SelectNodes(path.Replace('.', '/'));
			XmlNode xmlNode = null;
			if (xmlNodeList == null || xmlNodeList.Count == 0)
			{
				XmlNode xmlNode2 = ((path.IndexOf('.') < 0) ? _doc.DocumentElement : FindNode(path.Substring(0, path.LastIndexOf('.'))));
				Regex regex = new Regex("\\[.+\\]");
				string input = path.Substring(path.LastIndexOf('.') + 1);
				xmlNode = _doc.CreateNode(XmlNodeType.Element, regex.Replace(input, string.Empty), null);
				if (regex.IsMatch(input))
				{
					regex = new Regex("@(.+?)='(.+?)'");
					foreach (Match item in regex.Matches(input))
					{
						XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = _doc.CreateAttribute(null, item.Groups[1].Value, null);
						xmlAttribute.Value = item.Groups[2].Value;
						xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute);
					}
				}
				xmlNode2.AppendChild(xmlNode);
			}
			else
			{
				xmlNode = xmlNodeList[xmlNodeList.Count - 1];
			}
			return xmlNode;
		}

		private static string EscapeXmlCharactors(string input)
		{
			return input.Replace("<", "&lt;").Replace(">", "&gt;").Replace("&", "&amp;")
				.Replace("'", "&apos;")
				.Replace("\"", "&quot;");
		}

		private static string UnescapeXmlCharactors(string input)
		{
			return input.Replace("&lt;", "<").Replace("&gt;", ">").Replace("&amp;", "&")
				.Replace("&apos;", "'")
				.Replace("&quot;", "\"");
		}
	}
	public static class GlobalProjectDeltaMinTemperature
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _projectMinTemperatureDict = new Dictionary<string, string>();

		public static void ResolveTemperatures(DataVariable dataVariable, IUnityContainer container)
		{
			if (dataVariable == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dataVariable");
			}
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			EACFormFactory.EACTreeNodeRibbonInfo eACRibbonInfo = EACFormFactory.GetEACRibbonInfo(dataVariable.ProjectKey);
			if (eACRibbonInfo != null && eACRibbonInfo.Status == EACFormFactory.EACTreeNodeRibbonStatus.Initialized)
			{
				RemoveProjectTemperatureItem(dataVariable.ProjectKey, container);
			}
			try
			{
				if (!_projectMinTemperatureDict.ContainsKey(dataVariable.ProjectKey))
				{
					_projectMinTemperatureDict.Add(dataVariable.ProjectKey, "");
				}
			}
			catch (TargetInvocationException)
			{
			}
		}

		public static void SetValue(string key, string temperature)
		{
			if (!_projectMinTemperatureDict.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				_projectMinTemperatureDict.Add(key, temperature);
			}
			else
			{
				_projectMinTemperatureDict[key] = temperature;
			}
		}

		public static string GetValue(string key)
		{
			if (_projectMinTemperatureDict.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return _projectMinTemperatureDict[key];
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, string> GetValue(string path, IUnityContainer container)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CaseDocument>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>())?.GetValue(path);
				return (dictionary == null || dictionary.Count == 0) ? null : dictionary;
			}
			catch (ResolutionFailedException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveProjectTemperatureItem(string projKey, IUnityContainer container)
		{
			if (_projectMinTemperatureDict != null && _projectMinTemperatureDict.Count != 0 && !(projKey == "Project 1"))
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> value = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_GlobalDTmin, projKey), container);
				if (_projectMinTemperatureDict.ContainsKey(projKey) && value == null)
				{
					_projectMinTemperatureDict.Remove(projKey);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class DataResolver
	{
		private IUnityContainer _container;

		private string _projectKey;

		private IDataResolver _dataResolver => UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IDataResolver>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());

		public DataResolver(IUnityContainer container, string projectKey)
		{
			_container = container;
			_projectKey = projectKey;
		}

		public ScenarioComparationCollection GetData(string path)
		{
			if (_container == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_projectKey))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetScenarioComparationData(path);
		}

		private ScenarioComparationCollection GetScenarioComparationData(string path)
		{
			ScenarioComparationCollection scenarioComparationCollection = new ScenarioComparationCollection();
			try
			{
				NavigatorTreeNodeCollection navigatorTreeNodeCollection = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<NavigatorTreeNodeCollection>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (navigatorTreeNodeCollection == null || navigatorTreeNodeCollection.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				Collection<string> collection = new Collection<string>();
				int num = navigatorTreeNodeCollection.Count();
				int index = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					if (navigatorTreeNodeCollection[i].ToString() == _projectKey)
					{
						index = i;
						break;
					}
				}
				NavigatorTreeNode navigatorTreeNode = navigatorTreeNodeCollection[index];
				Regex regex = new Regex("Scenario\\s*\\(\\s*(\\d+)\\s*\\)$");
				foreach (NavigatorTreeNode child in navigatorTreeNode.Children)
				{
					if (regex.IsMatch(child.KeyReadOnly))
					{
						collection.Add("Scenario " + regex.Match(child.KeyReadOnly).Groups[1].Value);
					}
				}
				bool flag = false;
				string baseColdUtilitiesSummary;
				string baseHotUtilitiesSummary = (baseColdUtilitiesSummary = string.Empty);
				foreach (string item in collection)
				{
					string[] array = item.Split(' ');
					if (array.Length != 2)
					{
						continue;
					}
					string text = array[1] + " " + array[0];
					IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> enumerable = null;
					SummaryUtilities summaryUtilities = _dataResolver.ResolveData<SummaryUtilities>(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_Scenario, _projectKey, text));
					int lastSelectedDesignIndex;
					try
					{
						enumerable = summaryUtilities.Where((SummaryUtilityInformationView item) => item.IsSelected);
						if (summaryUtilities.Count() < 4)
						{
							enumerable = FilterByPayback(enumerable, text, out lastSelectedDesignIndex) ?? enumerable;
						}
						else
						{
							RetriveData(text, out lastSelectedDesignIndex);
							if (enumerable.Count() <= 2)
							{
								IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> second = summaryUtilities.Where((SummaryUtilityInformationView item) => item.DesignIndex == lastSelectedDesignIndex);
								enumerable = enumerable.Union(second);
							}
						}
					}
					catch (ResolutionFailedException)
					{
						enumerable = summaryUtilities;
						enumerable = FilterByPayback(enumerable, text, out lastSelectedDesignIndex) ?? enumerable;
					}
					int num2 = 0;
					if (enumerable != null)
					{
						num2 = enumerable.Count();
					}
					if (num2 <= 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					SummaryUtilityInformationView summaryUtilityInformationView = enumerable.ElementAt(0);
					if (!flag)
					{
						flag = true;
						baseHotUtilitiesSummary = summaryUtilityInformationView.Hot;
						baseColdUtilitiesSummary = summaryUtilityInformationView.Cold;
					}
					IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> basicData;
					if (enumerable.Count() <= 2)
					{
						IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> enumerable2 = new Collection<SummaryUtilityInformationView>();
						basicData = enumerable2;
					}
					else
					{
						basicData = enumerable.Where((SummaryUtilityInformationView item) => item.RetrofitIndex > 0);
					}
					ScenarioComparationView scenarioComparationView = new ScenarioComparationView(basicData, lastSelectedDesignIndex, summaryUtilityInformationView);
					scenarioComparationView.ScenarioIdentifier = text;
					try
					{

		private IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> FilterByPayback(IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> summaries, string scenarioIdentifyer, out int lastSelectedDesignIndex)
		{
			lastSelectedDesignIndex = 0;
			try
			{
				if (summaries == null || summaries.Count() < 3)
				{
					return null;
				}
				IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> enumerable = new SummaryUtilities();
				IEnumerable<IGrouping<int, SummaryUtilityInformationView>> enumerable2 = from item in summaries
					group item by item.RetrofitIndex;
				IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> source = null;
				foreach (IGrouping<int, SummaryUtilityInformationView> item in enumerable2)
				{
					if (item.Key == 0)
					{
						source = item;
						continue;
					}
					IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> enumerable3 = FilterSummaryUtilityInformationView(item, item.Key, scenarioIdentifyer, _projectKey, out lastSelectedDesignIndex);
					if (enumerable3 != null)
					{
						enumerable = enumerable.Union(enumerable3);
					}
				}
				return new SummaryUtilityInformationView[1] { source.FirstOrDefault() }.Union(enumerable).Union(new SummaryUtilityInformationView[1] { source.LastOrDefault() });
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> FilterSummaryUtilityInformationView(IEnumerable<SummaryUtilityInformationView> summaries, int retrofitIndex, string scenarioID, string projectKey, out int lastSelectedDesign)
		{
			lastSelectedDesign = 0;
			if (summaries == null || summaries.Count() == 0)
			{
				return summaries;
			}
			string text = retrofitIndex.ToString();
			SummaryUtilityInformationView summaryUtilityInformationView = summaries.ElementAt(0);
			_ = scenarioID + "RetrofitIndex" + text;
			SummaryUtilities summaryUtilities = new SummaryUtilities();
			try
			{
				switch (summaryUtilityInformationView.BelongTo)
				{
				case UtilityBelongTo.AddHeatExchanger:
				{
					string text2 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_AddHeatExchanger, projectKey, scenarioID, text);
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = _dataResolver.ResolveData(text2);
					if (dictionary == null || !dictionary.ContainsKey(text2))
					{
						return summaries;
					}
					if (!(dictionary[text2] is NewHeatExchangerViewCollection { Count: not 0 } newHeatExchangerViewCollection))
					{
						return null;
					}
					NewHeatExchangerView newHeatExchangerView = newHeatExchangerViewCollection.FirstOrDefault((NewHeatExchangerView newItem) => newItem.IsSelected);
					SummaryUtilityInformationView selectedHXSummary = summaries.FirstOrDefault((SummaryUtilityInformationView srItem) => srItem.IsSelected);
					NewHeatExchangerView newHX = null;
					if (newHeatExchangerView != null)
					{
						newHX = newHeatExchangerView;
					}
					else if (selectedHXSummary != null)
					{
						newHX = newHeatExchangerViewCollection.FirstOrDefault((NewHeatExchangerView nxHXItem) => nxHXItem.DesignIndex == selectedHXSummary.DesignIndex);
					}
					else
					{
						newHX = newHeatExchangerViewCollection.OrderBy((NewHeatExchangerView tmp) => double.Parse(tmp.Payback)).ElementAt(0);
					}
					if (newHX == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					lastSelectedDesign = newHX.DesignIndex;
					summaryUtilities.Add(summaries.FirstOrDefault((SummaryUtilityInformationView tmpItem) => tmpItem.DesignIndex == newHX.DesignIndex));
					string key2 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_AddHeatExchanger_Item, projectKey, scenarioID, null, newHX.DesignIndex.ToString());
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(key2))
					{
						break;
					}
					SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection3 = dictionary[key2] as SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection;
					string moniker9 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_PaybackPeriod, _projectKey, scenarioID);
					_dataResolver.Write(moniker9, double.Parse(newHX.Payback));
					if (surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection3 != null)
					{
						string moniker10 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_TotalCapitalCost, _projectKey, scenarioID);
						_dataResolver.Write(moniker10, surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection3.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView mdItem) => mdItem.ExtraCapitalCost));
						string moniker11 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_NewSurfaceArea, _projectKey, scenarioID);
						_dataResolver.Write(moniker11, surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection3.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView mdItem) => mdItem.OriginalNewAea));
					}
					break;
				}
				case UtilityBelongTo.RelocateHeatExchanger:
				{
					string text2 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_RelocateHeatExchanger, projectKey, scenarioID, text);
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = _dataResolver.ResolveData(text2);
					if (dictionary == null || !dictionary.ContainsKey(text2))
					{
						return summaries;
					}
					if (!(dictionary[text2] is RelocateHeatExchangerViewCollection { Count: not 0 } relocateHeatExchangerViewCollection))
					{
						return null;
					}
					RelocateHeatExchangerView relocateHeatExchangerView = relocateHeatExchangerViewCollection.FirstOrDefault((RelocateHeatExchangerView newHXItem) => newHXItem.IsSelected);
					SummaryUtilityInformationView selectedRelocateSummary = summaries.FirstOrDefault((SummaryUtilityInformationView srItem) => srItem.IsSelected);
					RelocateHeatExchangerView relocateHX = null;
					if (relocateHeatExchangerView != null)
					{
						relocateHX = relocateHeatExchangerView;
					}
					else if (selectedRelocateSummary != null)
					{
						relocateHX = relocateHeatExchangerViewCollection.FirstOrDefault((RelocateHeatExchangerView rxHXItem) => rxHXItem.DesignIndex == selectedRelocateSummary.DesignIndex);
					}
					else
					{
						relocateHX = relocateHeatExchangerViewCollection.OrderBy((RelocateHeatExchangerView tmp) => double.Parse(tmp.Payback)).ElementAt(0);
					}
					if (relocateHX == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					lastSelectedDesign = relocateHX.DesignIndex;
					summaryUtilities.Add(summaries.FirstOrDefault((SummaryUtilityInformationView tmpItem) => tmpItem.DesignIndex == relocateHX.DesignIndex));
					string key = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_RelocateHeatExchanger_Item, projectKey, scenarioID, null, relocateHX.DesignIndex.ToString());
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						break;
					}
					SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection2 = dictionary[key] as SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection;
					string moniker6 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_PaybackPeriod, _projectKey, scenarioID);
					_dataResolver.Write(moniker6, double.Parse(relocateHX.Payback));
					if (surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection2 != null)
					{
						string moniker7 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_TotalCapitalCost, _projectKey, scenarioID);
						_dataResolver.Write(moniker7, surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection2.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView mdItem) => mdItem.ExtraCapitalCost));
						string moniker8 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_NewSurfaceArea, _projectKey, scenarioID);
						_dataResolver.Write(moniker8, surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection2.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView mdItem) => mdItem.OriginalNewAea));
					}
					break;
				}
				case UtilityBelongTo.ModifyHeatExchanger:
				{
					string text2 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_ModifyHeatExchanger, projectKey, scenarioID, text);
					dynamic val = _dataResolver.ResolveData(text2);
					SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection = null;
					double result;
					if (val.GetType() == typeof(SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection))
					{
						surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection = val as SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection;
						string moniker = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Payback_ModifyHeatExchanger, _projectKey, scenarioID, text);
						dynamic val2 = _dataResolver.ResolveData(moniker);
						result = ((val2.GetType() == typeof(double)) ? ((double)val2) : ((!((val2.GetType() == typeof(double?) && (val2 as double?).HasValue) ? true : false)) ? 0.0 : (val2 as double?).Value));
					}
					else if (val.GetType() == typeof(Dictionary<string, object>))
					{
						surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection = val[text2];
						string moniker2 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Payback_ModifyHeatExchanger, _projectKey, scenarioID, text);
						result = _dataResolver.ResolveData<double>(moniker2);
					}
					else
					{
						Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = val;
						if (dictionary == null || !dictionary.ContainsKey(text2))
						{
							return summaries;
						}
						if (!double.TryParse(dictionary["PaybackPeriod"] as string, out result))
						{
							result = 0.0;
						}
					}
					string moniker3 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_PaybackPeriod, _projectKey, scenarioID);
					_dataResolver.Write(moniker3, result);
					if (surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection != null)
					{
						string moniker4 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_TotalCapitalCost, _projectKey, scenarioID);
						_dataResolver.Write(moniker4, surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView mdItem) => mdItem.ExtraCapitalCost));
						string moniker5 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_NewSurfaceArea, _projectKey, scenarioID);
						_dataResolver.Write(moniker5, surfaceAreanEntityViewCollection.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView mdItem) => mdItem.OriginalNewAea));
					}
					return summaries;
				}
				default:
					return summaries;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				return summaries;
			}
			return summaryUtilities;
		}

		private void RetriveData(string scenarioIdentifyer, out int lastSelectedDesignIndex)
		{
			lastSelectedDesignIndex = 0;
			try
			{
				bool flag = false;
				SummaryUtilities source = _dataResolver.ResolveData<SummaryUtilities>(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_Scenario, _projectKey, scenarioIdentifyer));
				int DesignIndex = _dataResolver.ResolveData<int>(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_DesignIndex, _projectKey, scenarioIdentifyer));
				if (DesignIndex <= 0)
				{
					flag = true;
					DesignIndex = 1;
				}
				lastSelectedDesignIndex = DesignIndex;
				UtilityBelongTo belongTo = source.First((SummaryUtilityInformationView item) => item.DesignIndex == DesignIndex).BelongTo;
				string text = BuildBelongToMoniker(scenarioIdentifyer, DesignIndex, belongTo);
				dynamic val = _dataResolver.ResolveData(text);
				if (val == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				string moniker = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_PaybackPeriod, _projectKey, scenarioIdentifyer);
				string moniker2 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_TotalCapitalCost, _projectKey, scenarioIdentifyer);
				string moniker3 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_NewSurfaceArea, _projectKey, scenarioIdentifyer);
				switch (belongTo)
				{
				case UtilityBelongTo.ModifyHeatExchanger:
				{
					lastSelectedDesignIndex = 0;
					SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection source4 = val as SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection;
					_dataResolver.Write(moniker2, source4.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView surfaceItem) => surfaceItem.ExtraCapitalCost));
					_dataResolver.Write(moniker3, source4.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView surfaceItem) => surfaceItem.OriginalNewAea));
					break;
				}
				case UtilityBelongTo.AddHeatExchanger:
				{
					if (!(val is Dictionary<string, object> dictionary2) || !dictionary2.ContainsKey(text))
					{
						break;
					}
					NewHeatExchangerViewCollection source5 = dictionary2[text] as NewHeatExchangerViewCollection;
					NewHeatExchangerView newHeatExchangerView = null;
					if (flag)
					{
						newHeatExchangerView = source5.OrderBy((NewHeatExchangerView item) => double.Parse(item.Payback)).First();
						lastSelectedDesignIndex = newHeatExchangerView.DesignIndex;
					}
					else
					{
						newHeatExchangerView = source5.FirstOrDefault((NewHeatExchangerView surfaceItem) => surfaceItem.DesignIndex == DesignIndex);
					}
					string key2 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_AddHeatExchanger_Item, _projectKey, scenarioIdentifyer, null, newHeatExchangerView.DesignIndex.ToString());
					if (dictionary2.ContainsKey(key2))
					{
						SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection source6 = dictionary2[key2] as SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection;
						_dataResolver.Write(moniker, double.Parse(newHeatExchangerView.Payback));
						_dataResolver.Write(moniker2, source6.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView surfaceItem) => surfaceItem.ExtraCapitalCost));
						_dataResolver.Write(moniker3, source6.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView surfaceItem) => surfaceItem.OriginalNewAea));
					}
					break;
				}
				case UtilityBelongTo.RelocateHeatExchanger:
				{
					if (!(val is Dictionary<string, object> dictionary) || !dictionary.ContainsKey(text))
					{
						break;
					}
					RelocateHeatExchangerViewCollection source2 = dictionary[text] as RelocateHeatExchangerViewCollection;
					RelocateHeatExchangerView relocateHeatExchangerView = null;
					if (flag)
					{
						relocateHeatExchangerView = source2.OrderBy((RelocateHeatExchangerView item) => double.Parse(item.Payback)).First();
						lastSelectedDesignIndex = relocateHeatExchangerView.DesignIndex;
					}
					else
					{
						relocateHeatExchangerView = source2.FirstOrDefault((RelocateHeatExchangerView surfaceItem) => surfaceItem.DesignIndex == DesignIndex);
					}
					string key = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_RelocateHeatExchanger_Item, _projectKey, scenarioIdentifyer, null, relocateHeatExchangerView.DesignIndex.ToString());
					if (dictionary.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection source3 = dictionary[key] as SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection;
						_dataResolver.Write(moniker, double.Parse(relocateHeatExchangerView.Payback));
						_dataResolver.Write(moniker2, source3.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView surfaceItem) => surfaceItem.ExtraCapitalCost));
						_dataResolver.Write(moniker3, source3.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView surfaceItem) => surfaceItem.OriginalNewAea));
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private string BuildBelongToMoniker(string scenarioID, int DesignIndex, UtilityBelongTo belongingTo)
		{
			DataMonikerType? dataMonikerType = null;
			string result = string.Empty;
			dataMonikerType = belongingTo switch
			{
				UtilityBelongTo.AddHeatExchanger => DataMonikerType.EnginData_AddHeatExchanger, 
				UtilityBelongTo.ModifyHeatExchanger => DataMonikerType.EnginData_ModifyHeatExchanger, 
				UtilityBelongTo.RelocateHeatExchanger => DataMonikerType.EnginData_RelocateHeatExchanger, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(belongingTo.ToString() + " is not a valid utility type"), 
			};
			string moniker = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.CachedData_RetrofitIndex, _projectKey, scenarioID);
			int num = _dataResolver.ResolveData<int>(moniker);
			if (dataMonikerType.HasValue)
			{
				result = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(dataMonikerType.Value, _projectKey, scenarioID, num.ToString(), DesignIndex.ToString());
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public static class Extensions
	{
		public static void AppendChild(this XElement element, string childName, string childValue)
		{
			element?.Add(new XElement(childName, childValue));
		}

		public static void AppendChild(this XElement element, string childName, double childValue)
		{
			element.AppendChild(childName, XmlConvert.ToString(childValue));
		}

		public static void AppendChild(this XElement element, string childName, bool childValue)
		{
			element.AppendChild(childName, XmlConvert.ToString(childValue));
		}

		public static void AppendChild(this XElement element, string childName, object childValue)
		{
			if (childValue != null)
			{
				element.AppendChild(childName, childValue.ToString());
			}
		}

		public static string GetChildValue(this XElement element, string childName, string defaultValue = null)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			XElement xElement = element.Element(childName);
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return xElement.Value;
		}

		public static double GetChildValueAsDouble(this XElement element, string childName, double defaultValue = 0.0)
		{
			string childValue = element.GetChildValue(childName);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(childValue))
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return XmlConvert.ToDouble(childValue);
		}

		public static bool GetChildValueAsBoolean(this XElement element, string childName, bool defaultValue = false)
		{
			string childValue = element.GetChildValue(childName);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(childValue))
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return XmlConvert.ToBoolean(childValue);
		}

		public static T GetChildValueAsEnum<T>(this XElement element, string childName, T defaultValue) where T : struct
		{
			string childValue = element.GetChildValue(childName);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(childValue))
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			T result = defaultValue;
			if (Enum.TryParse<T>(childValue, out result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}
	}
	public static class FlowsheetDataSource
	{
