		public static List<Subflowsheet> Flowsheets => _flowsheets;

		public static IList<string> SelectedItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (_flowsheets == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (from item in _flowsheets
					where item.IsSelected
					select item.Name).ToList();
			}
		}

		public static IList<string> AllFSItems => _flowsheets.Select((Subflowsheet item) => item.Name).ToList();

		public static void ResolveFlowSheets(DataVariable dataVariable, IUnityContainer container, IEnumerable<HYSYSEnergyStream> allEnergyStreams = null, Action initializeStreamsAction = null, Action<string, bool, bool> updateDisplaySourceWithEnergyStreamAction = null)
		{
			if (dataVariable == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dataVariable");
			}
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			HYSYSParameters hYSYSParameters = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (hYSYSParameters == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (hYSYSParameters.SimulatorName == "hysys" && hYSYSParameters.EnergyStreams == null)
			{
				initializeStreamsAction?.Invoke();
			}
			EACFormFactory.EACTreeNodeRibbonInfo eACRibbonInfo = EACFormFactory.GetEACRibbonInfo(dataVariable.ProjectKey);
			if (eACRibbonInfo != null && eACRibbonInfo.Status == EACFormFactory.EACTreeNodeRibbonStatus.Initialized)
			{
				RemoveProjectFlowsheetItem(dataVariable.ProjectKey, container);
			}
			if (!(hYSYSParameters.FlowsheetsName is IList list))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (!IsSameCaseFile(list))
				{
					Dictionary<string, string> value = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_Flowsheets, dataVariable.ProjectKey), container);
					if (!_projectSubflowSheetDict.ContainsKey(dataVariable.ProjectKey))
					{
						_projectSubflowSheetDict.Add(dataVariable.ProjectKey, new List<Subflowsheet>());
					}
					else
					{
						_projectSubflowSheetDict[dataVariable.ProjectKey] = new List<Subflowsheet>();
					}
					_flowsheets = _projectSubflowSheetDict[dataVariable.ProjectKey];
					Dictionary<string, string> value2 = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_Flowsheets, dataVariable.ProjectKey), container);
					Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
					if (value2 != null)
					{
						string text = "";
						string text2 = "";
						string text3 = "";
						using (Dictionary<string, string>.Enumerator enumerator = value2.GetEnumerator())
						{
							if (enumerator.MoveNext())
							{
								text = enumerator.Current.Value;
								text2 = text;
								text3 = text;
								string text4 = "<Flowsheet>";
								string text5 = "</Flowsheet>";
								if (text.Contains(text4))
								{
									text2 = text.Remove(0, text4.Length);
								}
								if (text2.Contains(text5))
								{
									text3 = text2.Remove(text2.Length - text5.Length, text5.Length);
								}
							}
						}
						string[] array = text3.Split('|');
						foreach (string text6 in array)
						{
							if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text6))
							{
								string[] array2 = text6.Split(',');
								if (array2.Count() > 1 && !dictionary.ContainsKey(array2[0]))
								{
									dictionary.Add(array2[0], array2[1]);
								}
							}
						}
					}
					foreach (string item3 in list)
					{
						bool flag = false;
						flag = ((!dictionary.ContainsKey(item3)) ? (value == null || value.ContainsKey(item3) || dictionary.Count != list.Count) : (dictionary[item3] == "1"));
						Subflowsheet item = new Subflowsheet(item3, flag, updateDisplaySourceWithEnergyStreamAction);
						_flowsheets.Add(item);
					}
					foreach (Subflowsheet flowsheet in _flowsheets)
					{
						updateDisplaySourceWithEnergyStreamAction?.Invoke(flowsheet.Name, flowsheet.IsSelected, arg3: false);
					}
					RefreshStreams(dictionary, allEnergyStreams);
					return;
				}
				if (_projectSubflowSheetDict.ContainsKey(dataVariable.ProjectKey))
				{
					_flowsheets = _projectSubflowSheetDict[dataVariable.ProjectKey];
					foreach (Subflowsheet flowsheet2 in _flowsheets)
					{
						if (updateDisplaySourceWithEnergyStreamAction != null)
						{
							updateDisplaySourceWithEnergyStreamAction(flowsheet2.Name, flowsheet2.IsSelected, arg3: false);
							flowsheet2.SelectedChangeEvent = updateDisplaySourceWithEnergyStreamAction;
						}
					}
					Dictionary<string, string> value3 = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_Flowsheets, dataVariable.ProjectKey), container);
					Dictionary<string, string> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, string>();
					if (value3 != null)
					{
						string text8 = "";
						string text9 = "";
						string text10 = "";
						using (Dictionary<string, string>.Enumerator enumerator = value3.GetEnumerator())
						{
							if (enumerator.MoveNext())
							{
								text8 = enumerator.Current.Value;
								text9 = text8;
								text10 = text8;
								string text11 = "<Flowsheet>";
								string text12 = "</Flowsheet>";
								if (text8.Contains(text11))
								{
									text9 = text8.Remove(0, text11.Length);
								}
								if (text9.Contains(text12))
								{
									text10 = text9.Remove(text9.Length - text12.Length, text12.Length);
								}
							}
						}
						string[] array = text10.Split('|');
						foreach (string text13 in array)
						{
							if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text13))
							{
								string[] array3 = text13.Split(',');
								if (array3.Count() > 1 && !dictionary2.ContainsKey(array3[0]))
								{
									dictionary2.Add(array3[0], array3[1]);
								}
							}
						}
					}
					RefreshStreams(dictionary2, allEnergyStreams);
					return;
				}
				Dictionary<string, string> value4 = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_Flowsheets, dataVariable.ProjectKey), container);
				_projectSubflowSheetDict[dataVariable.ProjectKey] = new List<Subflowsheet>();
				_flowsheets = _projectSubflowSheetDict[dataVariable.ProjectKey];
				Dictionary<string, string> value5 = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_Flowsheets, dataVariable.ProjectKey), container);
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary3 = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				if (value5 != null)
				{
					string text14 = "";
					string text15 = "";
					string text16 = "";
					using (Dictionary<string, string>.Enumerator enumerator = value5.GetEnumerator())
					{
						if (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							text14 = enumerator.Current.Value;
							text15 = text14;
							text16 = text14;
							string text17 = "<Flowsheet>";
							string text18 = "</Flowsheet>";
							if (text14.Contains(text17))
							{
								text15 = text14.Remove(0, text17.Length);
							}
							if (text15.Contains(text18))
							{
								text16 = text15.Remove(text15.Length - text18.Length, text18.Length);
							}
						}
					}
					string[] array = text16.Split('|');
					foreach (string text19 in array)
					{
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text19))
						{
							string[] array4 = text19.Split(',');
							if (array4.Count() > 1 && !dictionary3.ContainsKey(array4[0]))
							{
								dictionary3.Add(array4[0], array4[1]);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (string item4 in list)
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					flag2 = ((!dictionary3.ContainsKey(item4)) ? (value4?.ContainsKey(item4) ?? true) : (dictionary3[item4] == "1"));
					Subflowsheet item2 = new Subflowsheet(item4, flag2, updateDisplaySourceWithEnergyStreamAction);
					_flowsheets.Add(item2);
				}
				foreach (Subflowsheet flowsheet3 in _flowsheets)
				{
					updateDisplaySourceWithEnergyStreamAction?.Invoke(flowsheet3.Name, flowsheet3.IsSelected, arg3: false);
				}
				RefreshStreams(dictionary3, allEnergyStreams);
			}
			catch (TargetInvocationException)
			{
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveProjectFlowsheetItem(string projKey, IUnityContainer container)
		{
			if (_projectSubflowSheetDict != null && _projectSubflowSheetDict.Count != 0 && !(projKey == "Project 1"))
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> value = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_Flowsheets, projKey), container);
				if (_projectSubflowSheetDict.ContainsKey(projKey) && value == null)
				{
					_projectSubflowSheetDict.Remove(projKey);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void RefreshStreams(Dictionary<string, string> dctSelected, IEnumerable<HYSYSEnergyStream> allStreams)
		{
			if (dctSelected == null || allStreams == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (HYSYSEnergyStream allStream in allStreams)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(allStream.FlowSheetName))
				{
					allStream.IsDisplay = false;
				}
				else if (dctSelected.ContainsKey(allStream.FlowSheetName))
				{
					if (dctSelected[allStream.FlowSheetName] == "1")
					{
						allStream.IsDisplay = true;
					}
					else
					{
						allStream.IsDisplay = false;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					allStream.IsDisplay = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool IsSameCaseFile(IList flowsheetNames)
		{
			if (flowsheetNames == null || _flowsheets == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (flowsheetNames.Count != _flowsheets.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (Subflowsheet flowsheet in _flowsheets)
			{
				if (!flowsheetNames.Contains(flowsheet.Name))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, string> GetValue(string path, IUnityContainer container)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CaseDocument>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>())?.GetValue(path);
				return (dictionary == null || dictionary.Count == 0) ? null : dictionary;
			}
			catch (ResolutionFailedException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class Helper
	{
		internal static void SelectAll(XamDataGrid grid)
		{
			if (grid == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("grid");
			}
			if (((Collection<FieldLayout>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)grid).FieldLayouts).Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ClearSelection(grid);
			foreach (Field item in (Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)grid).DefaultFieldLayout.Fields)
			{
				if (((FieldItem)item).VisibilityResolved == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					((DataPresenterBase)grid).SelectedItems.Fields.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsAllSelected(XamDataGrid grid)
		{
			if (grid == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("grid");
			}
			if (((Collection<FieldLayout>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)grid).FieldLayouts).Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (Field item in (Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)grid).DefaultFieldLayout.Fields)
				{
					if (((FieldItem)item).VisibilityResolved == Visibility.Visible && !((DataPresenterBase)grid).SelectedItems.Fields.Contains(item))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void ClearSelection(XamDataGrid grid)
		{
			if (grid == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("grid");
			}
			((DataPresenterBase)grid).SelectedItems.Fields.Clear();
			((DataPresenterBase)grid).SelectedItems.Cells.Clear();
			((DataPresenterBase)grid).SelectedItems.Records.Clear();
		}

		public static void DoClipboardOperations(DataRecordPresenter drp, ContextMenuEventArgs args)
		{
			if (drp == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("drp");
			}
			if (args == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("args");
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = args.OriginalSource as DependencyObject;
			if (((RecordPresenter)drp).IsHeaderRecord && (!(dependencyObject is Border border) || border.Name != "fill"))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (((RecordPresenter)drp).IsHeaderRecord)
			{
				CreateContextmenusForHeaderPrefixArea(drp, args);
				return;
			}
			if (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(dependencyObject, typeof(RecordSelector), allowSubclassOfType: true) is RecordSelector)
			{
				CreateContextmenusForRow(drp, args);
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject ancestorFromType = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(dependencyObject, typeof(CellValuePresenter), allowSubclassOfType: true);
			CellValuePresenter val = (CellValuePresenter)(object)((ancestorFromType is CellValuePresenter) ? ancestorFromType : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				CreateContextmenusForCell(val, args);
			}
		}

		private static void CopyXamDataGridToClipboard(XamDataGrid grid)
		{
			//IL_00a6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ad: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string text = "";
			for (int i = 0; i < ((IEnumerable<Field>)((DataPresenterBase)grid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields).Count(); i++)
			{
				string text2 = ((FieldItem)((Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)grid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields)[i]).Label.ToString().Replace("\r\n", " ");
				text += text2;
				if (i + 1 < ((IEnumerable<Field>)((DataPresenterBase)grid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields).Count())
				{
					text += "\t";
				}
			}
			text += "\r\n";
			for (int j = 0; j < ((IEnumerable<Record>)((DataPresenterBase)grid).Records).Count(); j++)
			{
				DataRecord val = (DataRecord)((DataPresenterBase)grid).Records[j];
				for (int k = 0; k < ((IEnumerable<Cell>)val.Cells).Count(); k++)
				{
					Cell val2 = val.Cells[k];
					if (((FieldItem)val2.Field).Name == "UnityTypeField")
					{
						HYSYSEnergyStream hYSYSEnergyStream = val2.Record.DataItem as HYSYSEnergyStream;
						text += ((hYSYSEnergyStream.UtilityName != null) ? hYSYSEnergyStream.UtilityName.ToString() : string.Empty);
					}
					else
					{
						text += ((val2.Value != null) ? val2.Value.ToString() : string.Empty);
					}
					if (k + 1 < ((IEnumerable<Cell>)val.Cells).Count())
					{
						text += "\t";
					}
				}
				text += "\r\n";
			}
			Clipboard.Clear();
			Clipboard.SetText(text);
		}

		private static void CreateContextmenusForCell(CellValuePresenter cvp, ContextMenuEventArgs args)
		{

				Header = UIResources.Cut_MenuItem,

				{
					textBox.Text = null;
					textBox.Focus();
				}
			};
			contextMenu.Items.Add(menuItem);
			MenuItem menuItem2 = new MenuItem
			{
				Header = UIResources.Copy_MenuItem,
				IsEnabled = true,
				Icon = new System.Windows.Controls.Image
				{
					Source = ImageResources.Copy
				}
			};
			menuItem2.Click += delegate
			{

				XamDataGrid val = (XamDataGrid)(object)((ancestorFromType is XamDataGrid) ? ancestorFromType : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					if (((SelectedItemCollectionBase)((DataPresenterBase)val).SelectedItems.Fields).Count > 0 || ((SelectedItemCollectionBase)((DataPresenterBase)val).SelectedItems.Cells).Count > 1 || ((SelectedItemCollectionBase)((DataPresenterBase)val).SelectedItems.Records).Count > 0)
					{
						ApplicationCommands.Copy.Execute(null, (IInputElement)val);
					}
					else
					{
						Clipboard.SetText((cvp.Value == null) ? string.Empty : cvp.Value.ToString());
					}
				}
			};
			contextMenu.Items.Add(menuItem2);
			MenuItem menuItem3 = new MenuItem
			{
				Header = UIResources.Paste_MenuItem,
				IsEnabled = (((DataItemPresenter)cvp).Field != null && ((DataItemPresenter)cvp).Field.AllowEditResolved),
				Icon = new System.Windows.Controls.Image
				{
					Source = ImageResources.Paste
				}
			};
			menuItem3.Click += delegate
			{

				if (Utilities.GetDescendantFromType((DependencyObject)(object)cvp, typeof(TextBox), allowSubclassOfType: true) is TextBox textBox)
				{
					textBox.Text = Clipboard.GetText();
					textBox.Focus();
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(textBox.Text))
					{
						textBox.SelectionStart = textBox.Text.Length;
					}
				}
			};
			contextMenu.Items.Add(menuItem3);
			contextMenu.IsOpen = true;
			args.Handled = true;
		}

	public class DoubleSortComparer : IComparer
	{
		public int Compare(object x, object y)
		{
			if (x == null && y == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (x == null && y != null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (y == null && x != null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (double.TryParse(x.ToString(), out var result) && double.TryParse(y.ToString(), out var result2))
			{
				if (result > result2)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (result == result2)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}

			ListSortDirection num = ((e.FieldLayout.SortedFields.Count > 0) ? e.FieldLayout.SortedFields[0].Direction : ListSortDirection.Ascending);
			e.FieldLayout.SortedFields.Clear();

				});
			}
			((CancelableRoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
		}

				DetailsItems = UpdateSummaryTable(BasisSelection);
			}

		public void Update()
		{
			IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = null;
			try
			{
				energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					result = energyAnalysisAgent.RetrieveActivationResult();
					if (result != null)
					{
						UpdateColumnCharts();
						DetailsItems = UpdateSummaryTable(BasisSelection);
					}
					if (Type.GetTypeFromProgID("Excel.Application") == null)
					{
						SendToExcelTip = UIResources.LandingSummarySendToExcelDisableTip;
					}
					else
					{
						SendToExcelTip = UIResources.LandingSummarySendToExcelTip;
					}
					if (_commandSendToExcel != null)
					{
						_commandSendToExcel.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		private string CalculateDisplayText(string input)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(input))
			{
				return input;
			}
			if (double.TryParse(input, out var num))
			{
				if (num >= DisplayFormatDividingPoint)
				{
					return num.ToString("0.###E0");
				}
				if (num < DisplayFormatDividingPoint)
				{
					return num.ToString("F2");
				}
			}
			return input;
		}

		public ObservableCollection<DetailItem> UpdateSummaryTable(int selection)
		{
			ObservableCollection<DetailItem> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<DetailItem>();
			if (selection == 0)
			{
				DetailItem detailItem = new DetailItem();
				detailItem.ItemValue = $"{UIResources.LandingSummaryTotalUntility} [{result.TotalUnits.TrimStart().TrimEnd()}]";
				detailItem.Actual = result.TotalCurrentValue;
				detailItem.Target = result.TotalTargetValue;
				string totalFlowDifference = result.TotalFlowDifference;
				string input = result.TotalFlowSavingPercent.TrimEnd('%').TrimEnd();
				detailItem.Difference = CalculateDisplayText(totalFlowDifference);
				detailItem.Saving = CalculateDisplayText(input);
				observableCollection.Add(detailItem);
				DetailItem detailItem2 = new DetailItem();
				detailItem2.ItemValue = $"{UIResources.LandingSummaryHeatUntility} [{result.HeatingUnits.TrimStart().TrimEnd()}]";
				detailItem2.Actual = result.HeatingCurrentValue;
				detailItem2.Target = result.HeatingTotalValue;
				detailItem2.Difference = CalculateDisplayText(result.HeatingFlowDifference);
				detailItem2.Saving = CalculateDisplayText(result.HeatingFlowSavingPercent.TrimEnd('%').TrimEnd());
				observableCollection.Add(detailItem2);
				DetailItem detailItem3 = new DetailItem();

			workbooks.GetType().InvokeMember("Add", BindingFlags.InvokeMethod, null, workbooks, null, new CultureInfo("en-US"));
			Sheets worksheets = workbooks.get_Item((object)1).Worksheets;
			for (int num = worksheets.Count - 1; num > 0; num--)
			{
				((Worksheet)(dynamic)worksheets.get_Item((object)num)).Delete();
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = (Worksheet)(dynamic)worksheets.get_Item((object)1);
			ObservableCollection<DetailItem> curItems = UpdateSummaryTable(0);

		}

	[ValueConversion(typeof(int), typeof(bool))]
	public class BoolToIntConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return (int)value == int.Parse(parameter.ToString());
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return parameter;
		}

		public string GlobalMinDetaTemperature
		{
			get
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> value = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_GlobalDTmin, (base.Variable != null) ? base.Variable.ProjectKey : "Project 1"));
				string value2 = GlobalProjectDeltaMinTemperature.GetValue((base.Variable != null) ? base.Variable.ProjectKey : "Project 1");
				string empty = string.Empty;
				empty = ((value != null) ? (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2) ? value.First().Value : value2) : (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2) ? globalDTmin.ToString("G4") : value2));
				IValueUnit valueUnit = UnitValueFactory.Create(UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).SimulatorName);
				if (valueUnit != null)
				{
					((double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(globalDTmin, PropertyEnum.DeltaTemperature)).ToString("G4");
					if (value != null)
					{
						empty = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2)) ? ((double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(Convert.ToDouble(value2, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), PropertyEnum.DeltaTemperature)).ToString("G4") : ((double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(Convert.ToDouble(value.First().Value.ToString(), CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), PropertyEnum.DeltaTemperature)).ToString("G4"));
					}
				}
				if (base.ViewModel is Landing_Configuration_vm landing_Configuration_vm)
				{
					ComboxItemData selectedProcesstype = landing_Configuration_vm.GetSelectedProcesstype();
					if (selectedProcesstype != null && valueUnit != null && ((double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(selectedProcesstype.Value, PropertyEnum.DeltaTemperature)).ToString("G4") != empty)
					{
						appTinput.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold;
						appTinput.FontStyle = FontStyles.Normal;
					}
				}
				return empty;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!double.TryParse(value, out var result) || result <= 0.0)
				{
					return;
				}
				HYSYSParameters hYSYSParameters = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (hYSYSParameters == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(hYSYSParameters.SimulatorName))
				{
					return;
				}
				IValueUnit valueUnit = UnitValueFactory.Create(hYSYSParameters.SimulatorName);
				if (valueUnit == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				double num = (double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(result, PropertyEnum.ToDeltaTemperature);
				if (0.01 > num || 100.0 < num)
				{
					return;
				}
				UtilityView utilityView = null;
				IDataResolver dataResolver = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IDataResolver>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (dataResolver != null)
				{
					utilityView = dataResolver.ResolveData<UtilityView>(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_UtilityView));
				}
				if (utilityView != null)
				{
					utilityView.GlobalMinDeltaTemperature = num;
				}
				SetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_GlobalDTmin, (base.Variable != null) ? base.Variable.ProjectKey : "Project 1"), num.ToString("G4"));
				GlobalProjectDeltaMinTemperature.SetValue((base.Variable != null) ? base.Variable.ProjectKey : "Project 1", num.ToString("G4"));
				Dictionary<string, string> value2 = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CaseDocument>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_ExchangerMinApproachTemperature, (base.Variable != null) ? base.Variable.ProjectKey : "Project 1"));
				if (value2 != null && value2.Count > 0 && double.TryParse(value2.First().Value, out var result2) && result < result2)
				{
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CaseDocument>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).Write(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_ExchangerMinApproachTemperature, (base.Variable != null) ? base.Variable.ProjectKey : "Project 1"), num);
				}
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Publish(new WorkflowControlStateArgs
				{
					ControlType = WorkflowControl.Tranfer,
					State = true
				});
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UpdateFormEvent>().Publish(new UpdateFormArgs
				{
					SpecifiedParas = new object[1] { "GlobalMinDetaTemperature" }
				});
				if (base.Container != null && utilityView != null)
				{
					IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
					if (energyAnalysisAgent != null && !energyAnalysisAgent.NeedsEARerun && energyAnalysisAgent.IsAutoRun())
					{
						energyAnalysisAgent.ShowDashboardResults();
						energyAnalysisAgent.RaiseAnalysisComplete(EAOperations.UpdateView);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public string CarbonFeeValue
		{
			get
			{
				HYSYSParameters hYSYSParameters = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				double? num = hYSYSParameters.CarbonFee as double?;
				if (!num.HasValue)
				{
					num = 0.0;
				}
				IValueUnit valueUnit = UnitValueFactory.Create(hYSYSParameters.SimulatorName);
				if (valueUnit != null)
				{
					num = (double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(num, PropertyEnum.ToCostPerMass);
				}
				return num.Value.ToString("G6");
			}
			set
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && double.TryParse(value, out var result) && !(result < 0.0))
				{
					if (!string.Equals(CarbonFeeValue, value) && base.Container != null)
					{
						UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>())?.UpdateDashboardStatus(new UpdateDashboardStatusArgs
						{
							Mode = StatusControlDisplayMode.TextWithWarning,
							Hint = "ConfigurationChanged"
						});
					}
					HYSYSParameters hYSYSParameters = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
					IValueUnit valueUnit = UnitValueFactory.Create(hYSYSParameters.SimulatorName);
					if (valueUnit != null)
					{
						result = (double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(result, PropertyEnum.FromCostPerMass);
					}
					hYSYSParameters.CarbonFee = result;
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UpdateFormEvent>().Publish(new UpdateFormArgs
					{
						SpecifiedParas = new object[1] { "CarbonFeeValue" }
					});
				}
			}
		}

		private void Landing_Configuration_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Landing_Configuration_vm landing_Configuration_vm = base.ViewModel as Landing_Configuration_vm;
			if (e.HeightChanged && landing_Configuration_vm != null)

				UpdateLayout();
			}

		private void Landing_Configuration_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.IsLoaded)
			{
				return;
			}
			Landing_Configuration_vm landing_Configuration_vm = base.ViewModel as Landing_Configuration_vm;
			landing_Configuration_vm?.Update();
			if (landing_Configuration_vm != null)
			{
				landing_Configuration_vm.IsFormLoading = true;
			}
			DataVariable dataVariable = new DataVariable
			{
				ProjectKey = "Project 1"
			};
			if (FlowsheetDataSource.Flowsheets == null || base.Variable == null)
			{
				if (landing_Configuration_vm == null)
				{
					FlowsheetDataSource.ResolveFlowSheets(dataVariable, base.Container);
				}
				else
				{
					FlowsheetDataSource.ResolveFlowSheets(dataVariable, base.Container, landing_Configuration_vm.AllEnergyStreams, landing_Configuration_vm.InitializeStreams, landing_Configuration_vm.UpdateDisplaySourceWithEnergyStream);
				}
			}
			GlobalProjectDeltaMinTemperature.ResolveTemperatures(dataVariable, base.Container);
			if (landing_Configuration_vm != null)
			{
				landing_Configuration_vm.IsFormLoading = false;
			}
			UpdateEnergyStreamColumnVisibility();
			if (!FirstUse)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)energyStream).Focus();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUnityContainerChanged(IUnityContainer oldValue, IUnityContainer newValue)
		{
			base.OnUnityContainerChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					energyAnalysisAgent.AnalysisCompleteEvent += agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent;
					energyAnalysisAgent.RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent += agent_RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent;
				}
			}
		}

		public void UnRegisterEvents()
		{
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					energyAnalysisAgent.AnalysisCompleteEvent -= agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent;
					energyAnalysisAgent.RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent -= agent_RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent;
				}
			}
			if (TryFindResource("GridResource") is LandingFormGridResource landingFormGridResource)
			{
				landingFormGridResource.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (e is EAUpdateEventArgs e2 && (e2.opt == EAOperations.UpdateView || e2.opt == EAOperations.RefreshConfigOnly))
			{
				bool force = false;
				if (e2.opt == EAOperations.UpdateView)
				{
					force = true;
				}
				Update((base.Variable == null) ? new DataVariable
				{
					ProjectKey = "Project 1"
				} : base.Variable);
				if (base.ViewModel is Landing_Configuration_vm landing_Configuration_vm)
				{
					landing_Configuration_vm.Update(force);
				}
			}
		}

		private void Update(DataVariable dataVariable)
		{
			if (!(base.ViewModel is Landing_Configuration_vm landing_Configuration_vm))
			{
				FlowsheetDataSource.ResolveFlowSheets(dataVariable, base.Container);
			}
			else
			{
				FlowsheetDataSource.ResolveFlowSheets(dataVariable, base.Container, landing_Configuration_vm.AllEnergyStreams, landing_Configuration_vm.InitializeStreams, landing_Configuration_vm.UpdateDisplaySourceWithEnergyStream);
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("FlowsheetItems");
			OnPropertyChanged("GlobalMinDetaTemperature");
			OnPropertyChanged("DetaTMinTip");
			OnPropertyChanged("EnergyStreams");
			OnPropertyChanged("DetaTMinTipVisible");
			OnPropertyChanged("CarbonFeeValue");
		}

		}

		private void Part_Control_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (e != null)
			{
				if ((e.RemovedItems.Count > 0 && e.RemovedItems[0] is string && (e.RemovedItems[0] as string).Equals(UIResources.AddNew)) || !(sender is ComboBox comboBox))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!comboBox.IsFocused)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				object dataContext = comboBox.DataContext;
				DataRecord val = (DataRecord)((dataContext is DataRecord) ? dataContext : null);
				if (val == null || !(val.DataItem is HYSYSEnergyStream hYSYSEnergyStream))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (e.AddedItems.Count > 0 && e.AddedItems[0] is string && (e.AddedItems[0] as string).Equals(UIResources.AddNew))
				{
					if (e != null && e.RemovedItems != null && e.RemovedItems.Count != 0)
					{
						string selectedValue = (hYSYSEnergyStream.UtilityName = e.RemovedItems[0] as string);
						comboBox.SelectedValue = selectedValue;
					}
					else
					{
						comboBox.SelectedValue = null;
					}
					hYSYSEnergyStream.TransitionToUtilityManager();
					hYSYSEnergyStream.IsUtilityTypeChanged = false;
					(base.ViewModel as Landing_Configuration_vm).Update(force: true);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UpdateFormEvent>().Publish(null);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnXamDataGridClipboardCopying(object sender, ClipboardCopyingEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnXamDataGridClipboardCopying(sender, e);
			if (((DataPresenterBase)energyStream).DefaultFieldLayout != null && ((DataPresenterBase)energyStream).DefaultFieldLayout.Fields != null && _indexFieldsMap.Count > 0)
			{
				FieldCollection fields = ((DataPresenterBase)energyStream).DefaultFieldLayout.Fields;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<int, Field> item in _indexFieldsMap.Reverse())
				{
					((Collection<Field>)(object)fields).Insert(item.Key, item.Value);
				}
				_indexFieldsMap.Clear();
			}
			if (((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Handled || ((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).Values == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).FieldCount; i++)
			{
				Field sourceField = e.GetSourceField(i);
				if (sourceField != null && ((FieldItem)sourceField).Name == "UnityTypeField")
				{
					num = i;
				}
			}
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (TryFindResource("GridResource") is LandingFormGridResource landingFormGridResource)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < ((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).FieldCount; j++)
				{
					Field sourceField2 = e.GetSourceField(j);
					if (sourceField2 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (((FieldItem)sourceField2).Name == "inlet1" || ((FieldItem)sourceField2).Name == "outlet1")
					{
						CellValueHolder labelValueHolder = e.GetLabelValueHolder(sourceField2);
						if (labelValueHolder != null)
						{
							labelValueHolder.Value = landingFormGridResource.EnergyStreamTemperatureHeader + Environment.NewLine + labelValueHolder.Value;
						}
					}
					else if (((FieldItem)sourceField2).Name == "inlet2" || ((FieldItem)sourceField2).Name == "outlet2")
					{
						CellValueHolder labelValueHolder2 = e.GetLabelValueHolder(sourceField2);
						if (labelValueHolder2 != null)
						{
							labelValueHolder2.Value = landingFormGridResource.EnergyUnityTemperatureHeader + Environment.NewLine + labelValueHolder2.Value;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < ((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).RecordCount; k++)
			{
				DataRecord sourceRecord = e.GetSourceRecord(k);
				if (sourceRecord != null && sourceRecord.DataItem is HYSYSEnergyStream hYSYSEnergyStream)
				{
					((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).Values[k, num].Value = hYSYSEnergyStream.UtilityName;
				}
			}
		}

		private void energyStream_ExecutingCommand(object sender, ExecutingCommandEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Command == ApplicationCommands.Copy && ((DataPresenterBase)energyStream).DefaultFieldLayout != null && ((DataPresenterBase)energyStream).DefaultFieldLayout.Fields != null)
			{
				FieldCollection fields = ((DataPresenterBase)energyStream).DefaultFieldLayout.Fields;
				Field val = ((IEnumerable<Field>)fields).FirstOrDefault((Field p) => ((FieldItem)p).Name == "mergedHeader1");
				Field val2 = ((IEnumerable<Field>)fields).FirstOrDefault((Field p) => ((FieldItem)p).Name == "mergedHeader2");
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					_indexFieldsMap.Add(((Collection<Field>)(object)fields).IndexOf(val2), val2);
					((Collection<Field>)(object)fields).Remove(val2);
				}
				if (val != null)
				{
					_indexFieldsMap.Add(((Collection<Field>)(object)fields).IndexOf(val), val);
					((Collection<Field>)(object)fields).Remove(val);
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<SurfaceAreanBaseView> HeatExchangerDetails
		{
			get
			{
				SurfaceAreanBaseViewCollection surfaceAreanBaseViewCollection = DataResolver.ResolveData<SurfaceAreanBaseViewCollection>(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_SavingPotentailsHX));
				if (surfaceAreanBaseViewCollection != null)
				{
					return surfaceAreanBaseViewCollection.OrderByDescending((SurfaceAreanBaseView item) => item.CPDutyValue);
				}
				UtilityView utilityView = DataResolver.ResolveData<UtilityView>("UtilityView");
				if (utilityView == null || utilityView.UtilityItems == null || utilityView.UtilityItems.Count == 0)
				{
					return new SurfaceAreanBaseView[1]
					{
						new SurfaceAreanBaseView(new SurfaceAreanBaseEntity())
					};
				}
				return utilityView.UtilityItems.SelectMany((UtilityInformationView item) => item.HeatExchangers);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<Field> HeatExchangerGridFields
		{
			get
			{
				if (_surfaceAreaFields == null)
				{
					int num = 0;
					List<Field> list = new List<Field>();
					for (int i = 1; i < ((Collection<Field>)(object)((DataPresenterBase)HeatExchangerStatusGrid).FieldLayouts[0].Fields).Count; i++)
					{
						if (num == 0)

		public static string GetPreviewInputStringWhenAddText(TextBox tb, string previewAddingText)
		{
			string text = tb.Text;
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (text != null)
			{
				int selectionStart = tb.SelectionStart;
				selectionStart = ((selectionStart > text.Length) ? text.Length : selectionStart);
				int selectionLength = tb.SelectionLength;
				int num = selectionStart + selectionLength;
				num = ((num > tb.Text.Length) ? tb.Text.Length : num);
				string obj = ((selectionStart == 0) ? string.Empty : text.Substring(0, selectionStart));
				string text2 = ((num >= text.Length) ? string.Empty : text.Substring(selectionStart + selectionLength));
				return obj + previewAddingText + text2;
			}
			return previewAddingText;
		}

		public static string GetSystemDecimalSymbol()
		{
			return 0.1.ToString().Replace("0", string.Empty).Replace("1", string.Empty);
		}

		public static bool maskDoubleValue(string testString, int MaxLength)
		{
			testString = testString.Replace(GetSystemDecimalSymbol(), ".");
			if (!maskDoubleRegex.IsMatch(testString) || (MaxLength != 0 && testString.Length > MaxLength))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(testString) && (testString.Contains("e") || testString.Contains("E")))
			{
				if (double.TryParse(testString, out var result))
				{
					if (result < -1E+300 || result > 1E+300)
					{
						return false;
					}
					int num = result.ToString().IndexOf("e", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
					if (num > -1 && num > 0 && int.TryParse(result.ToString().Substring(num + 1), out var result2) && (result2 < -300 || result2 > 300))
					{
						return false;
					}
					num = testString.IndexOf("e", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
					if (result == 0.0 && double.TryParse(testString.Substring(0, num), out var result3) && result3 != 0.0)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!double.TryParse(testString, out result) && validDoubleRegex.IsMatch(testString))
				{
					int num2 = testString.IndexOf("e", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
					if (num2 > -1 && int.TryParse(testString.Substring(num2 + 1), out var result4) && result4 >= -300 && result4 <= 300)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CrossPinchCompare(Field currentField, bool? isHotStream, HeatExchangerPinchValueComparison comparison)
		{
			syncContext.Post(delegate
			{
				DataPresenterBase dataPresenter = ((FieldItem)currentField).Owner.DataPresenter;
				if (dataPresenter != null)
				{
					RecordCollectionBase records = dataPresenter.Records;
					IEnumerable<SurfaceAreanBaseView> enumerable = new SurfaceAreanBaseViewCollection();
					enumerable = HeatExchangerDetails;
					if (enumerable != null)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < enumerable.Count(); i++)
						{
							Record obj = records[i];
							DataRecord val = (DataRecord)(object)((obj is DataRecord) ? obj : null);
							SurfaceAreanBaseView surfaceAreanBaseView = val.DataItem as SurfaceAreanBaseView;
							if (comparison == HeatExchangerPinchValueComparison.UnKnow)
							{
								((Record)val).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
							}
							else if (isHotStream.Value)
							{
								((Record)val).Visibility = ((surfaceAreanBaseView.HotStreamPinchValueComparison != comparison) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
							}
							else
							{
								((Record)val).Visibility = ((surfaceAreanBaseView.ColdStreamPinchValueComparison != comparison) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
							}
						}
						switch (comparison)
						{
						case HeatExchangerPinchValueComparison.Above:
							if (isHotStream.Value)
							{
								SetHotFilterCheck(0);
							}
							else
							{
								SetColdFilterCheck(0);
							}
							break;
						case HeatExchangerPinchValueComparison.Below:
							if (isHotStream.Value)
							{
								SetHotFilterCheck(1);
							}
							else
							{
								SetColdFilterCheck(1);
							}
							break;
						case HeatExchangerPinchValueComparison.Across:
							if (isHotStream.Value)
							{
								SetHotFilterCheck(2);
							}
							else
							{
								SetColdFilterCheck(2);
							}
							break;
						default:
							if (isHotStream.Value)
							{
								SetHotFilterCheck(3);
							}
							else
							{
								SetColdFilterCheck(3);
							}
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}, null);
		}

				((DataPresenterBase)HeatExchangerStatusGrid).FieldPositionChanged += HeatExchangerDetailsGrid_FieldPositionChanged;
				break;
			default:
				_contentLoaded = true;
				break;
			}
		}
	}

		public DelegateCommand<object> SuggestImprovements
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SuggestImprovements == null)
				{
					_SuggestImprovements = new DelegateCommand<object>(delegate
					{
						IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = null;
						try
						{
							energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
						if (energyAnalysisAgent != null && !(energyAnalysisAgent.IsFindingDesignChanges ?? false) && energyAnalysisAgent.CanDoGeneration())
						{
							_processedStep = -1;
							IsSummaryVisible = true;
							GeneratingStatus[0].StepResult = "";
							GeneratingStatus[0].State = GeneratingRecordState.NotRun;
							GeneratingStatus[1].StepResult = "";
							GeneratingStatus[1].State = GeneratingRecordState.NotRun;
							GeneratingStatus[2].StepResult = "";
							GeneratingStatus[2].State = GeneratingRecordState.NotRun;
							energyAnalysisAgent.SetGenerateUpperLimit(nAddHX, nRelocateHX);
							energyAnalysisAgent.DoGeneration();
						}
					}, delegate
					{
						if (isGenerateButtonEnabled)
						{
							btnsp.ToolTip = UIResources.SuggestImprovementsTip;
						}
						else
						{
							btnsp.ToolTip = UIResources.SuggestImprovementsDisableTip;
						}
						return isGenerateButtonEnabled;
					});
				}
				return _SuggestImprovements;
			}
		}

		public Landing_SImprovements()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
		}

		[InjectionConstructor]
		public Landing_SImprovements(IUnityContainer container)
			: base(container)
		{
			_container = container;
			InitializeComponent();
			sAddTitle = "0" + UIResources.GridTitle2;
			sRelocateTitle = "0" + UIResources.GridTitle2;
			NotifyPropertyChanged("AddTitle");
			NotifyPropertyChanged("RelocateTitle");
			sAddTitleH = UIResources.AddTitleH;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(addHXKey))
			{
				string[] array = addHXKey.Split(' ');
				sAddTitleH += array[array.Length - 1];
			}
			sRelocateTitleH = UIResources.RelocateTitleH;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(relocateHXKey))
			{
				string[] array2 = relocateHXKey.Split(' ');
				sRelocateTitleH += array2[array2.Length - 1];
			}
			NotifyPropertyChanged("AddTitleH");
			NotifyPropertyChanged("RelocateTitleH");
			UpdateGenerateScenarioIDs();
			UpdateModifyHXSource(ModifyHXID + " Scenario", "");
			UpdateNewHXSource(AddHXID + " Scenario");
			UpdateRelcoateHXSource(RelocHXID + " Scenario");
			GeneratingStatus.Add(new GeneratingStatusRecord
			{
				State = GeneratingRecordState.NotRun,
				StepName = UIResources.StatusModifyExchangers
			});
			GeneratingStatus.Add(new GeneratingStatusRecord
			{
				State = GeneratingRecordState.NotRun,
				StepName = UIResources.StatusAddExchangers
			});
			GeneratingStatus.Add(new GeneratingStatusRecord
			{
				State = GeneratingRecordState.NotRun,
				StepName = UIResources.StatusRelocateExchangers
			});
			int num = 0;
			foreach (NewHeatExchangerView item in NewHXCollection)
			{
				_ = item;
				num++;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					TableVisible1 = Visibility.Visible;
					Expander_1.IsExpanded = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			num = 0;
			foreach (RelocateHeatExchangerView item2 in RelcoateHXCollection)
			{
				_ = item2;
				num++;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					TableVisible3 = Visibility.Visible;
					Expander_3.IsExpanded = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			base.HelpId = 13102;
			base.Loaded += Landing_SImprovements_Loaded;
		}

		private void UpdateGenerateScenarioIDs()
		{
			int num = 0;
			IEnergyAnalysisMessenger energyAnalysisMessenger = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisMessenger>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			try
			{
				if (energyAnalysisMessenger != null)
				{
					NavigatorTreeNodeCollection navigatorTreeNodeCollection = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<NavigatorTreeNodeCollection>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
					if (navigatorTreeNodeCollection != null && navigatorTreeNodeCollection.Count > 0)
					{
						foreach (NavigatorTreeNode child in navigatorTreeNodeCollection[0].Children)
						{
							if (string.Compare(((EACTreeNode)child).SpecialFlag, "dashboard", ignoreCase: true) != 0 || !new Regex("Scenario\\(\\d+\\)$").IsMatch(child.KeyReadOnly))
							{
								if (string.Compare(((EACTreeNode)child).SpecialFlag, "dashboard", ignoreCase: true) != 0 && new Regex("Scenario\\(\\d+\\)$").IsMatch(child.KeyReadOnly))
								{
									num++;
								}
								continue;
							}
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num != 0)
				{
					ModifyHXID = (num + 1).ToString();
					AddHXID = (num + 2).ToString();
					RelocHXID = (num + 3).ToString();
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				ModifyHXID = (num + 1).ToString();
				AddHXID = (num + 2).ToString();
				RelocHXID = (num + 3).ToString();
			}
		}

		private void Landing_SImprovements_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null && (energyAnalysisAgent.IsUtilitiesWarning || energyAnalysisAgent.IsExchangerWarning || !energyAnalysisAgent.CanDoGeneration()))
				{
					bCanGenerate = false;
					isGenerateButtonEnabled = bCanGenerate;
					SuggestImprovements.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
				}
			}
			addExchangers.Focus();
		}

		private void agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (DesignChanges != null && DesignChanges.Count > 0)
			{
				text = DesignChanges[0].NavigationPath;
				DesignChanges.Clear();
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = "";
			}
			UpdateModifyHXSource(ModifyHXID + " Scenario", text);
			UpdateNewHXSource(AddHXID + " Scenario");
			UpdateRelcoateHXSource(RelocHXID + " Scenario");
		}

		protected override void OnUnityContainerChanged(IUnityContainer oldValue, IUnityContainer newValue)
		{
			base.OnUnityContainerChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					energyAnalysisAgent.RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent += agent_RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent;
					energyAnalysisAgent.EAGenerateStateReported += agent_EAGenerateStateReported;
					energyAnalysisAgent.AnalysisCompleteEvent += agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent;
				}
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<EARuningStatusEvent>().Subscribe(RunningStatus);
			}
		}

		public void UnRegisterEvents()
		{
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					energyAnalysisAgent.RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent -= agent_RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent;
					energyAnalysisAgent.EAGenerateStateReported -= agent_EAGenerateStateReported;
					energyAnalysisAgent.AnalysisCompleteEvent -= agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent;
				}
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<EARuningStatusEvent>().Unsubscribe(RunningStatus);
			}
			if (TryFindResource("GridResource") is AddHeatExchangerGridLocalizationResource addHeatExchangerGridLocalizationResource)
			{
				addHeatExchangerGridLocalizationResource.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void agent_RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent(object sender, IsAnalysisButtonEnabledEventArgs e)
		{
			bEAButtonEnabled = e.IsEnabled;
			if (bEAButtonEnabled)
			{
				isGenerateButtonEnabled = bCanGenerate;
				SuggestImprovements.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			}
			else
			{
				isGenerateButtonEnabled = false;
				SuggestImprovements.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			}
		}

		private void RunningStatus(EARuningStatusEventArgs args)
		{
			bCanGenerate = args.CanGenerate;
			if (bEAButtonEnabled)
			{
				isGenerateButtonEnabled = args.CanGenerate;
			}
			else
			{
				isGenerateButtonEnabled = false;
			}
			SuggestImprovements.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		private static GeneratingRecordState ConvertTo(EAGenerateState state)
		{
			return state switch
			{
				EAGenerateState.NotRun => GeneratingRecordState.NotRun, 
				EAGenerateState.Running => GeneratingRecordState.Running, 
				EAGenerateState.Failed => GeneratingRecordState.Failed, 
				EAGenerateState.Clear => GeneratingRecordState.Clear, 
				_ => GeneratingRecordState.Succeeded, 
			};
		}

		private void TimerReadTempLogFile(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if ((_processedStep != 0 && _processedStep != 1 && _processedStep != 2) || nCancelGenerateProcessStep == _processedStep || GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].State != GeneratingRecordState.Running)
			{
				return;
			}
			int result = -1;
			if (_processedStep == 0)
			{
				string stepResult = "";
				if (GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].State == GeneratingRecordState.Running)
				{
					stepResult = UIResources.StatusModifySearchingSolution;
				}
				else if (GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].State == GeneratingRecordState.Failed || GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].State == GeneratingRecordState.NotRun)
				{
					stepResult = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, new Regex(5 + "\\s*([\\s\\S]*?)(((-\\d)|(\\d))+[^}])", RegexOptions.Singleline).Match(UIResources.Progressbar_SolutionSeachResult).Groups[1].Value, 0, UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSolutionCount(_processedStep));
					stepResult = stepResult.Replace("\r", "").Replace("\n", "");
				}
				else if (GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].State == GeneratingRecordState.Succeeded)
				{
					stepResult = UIResources.StatusModifySolutionFound;
				}
				GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].StepResult = stepResult;
			}
			else if (ExtractCurrentDesignIndex(out result))
			{
				if (nOldGenStep + 2 < result)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
				if (nOldGenStep != result)
				{
					nOldGenStep = result;
				}
				int num = ((_processedStep == 0) ? 5 : 37);
				string text = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, new Regex(num + "\\s*([\\s\\S]*?)(((-\\d)|(\\d))+[^}])", RegexOptions.Singleline).Match(UIResources.Progressbar_SolutionSeachResult).Groups[1].Value, result, UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSolutionCount(_processedStep));
				text = text.Replace("\r", "").Replace("\n", "");
				GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].StepResult = text;
			}
		}

		private static bool ExtractCurrentDesignIndex(out int result)
		{
			result = -1;
			try
			{
				string path = System.IO.Path.Combine(System.IO.Path.GetTempPath(), "Retrofit.log");
				if (File.Exists(path))
				{
					string text = null;
					using (FileStream stream = File.Open(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite | FileShare.Delete))
					{
						using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream);
						text = streamReader.ReadToEnd();
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && int.TryParse(text, out result))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void agent_EAGenerateStateReported(object sender, EAGenerateStateEventArgs e)
		{
			IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (e.State == EAGenerateState.Clear)
			{
				ClearDesignMatrixFor(e.Operation);
			}
			if (e.Operation == EAGenerateOperation.Modify)
			{
				_processedStep = 0;
				nOldGenStep = 1;
				GeneratingStatus[0].State = ConvertTo(e.State);
				if (GeneratingStatus[0].State == GeneratingRecordState.Succeeded)
				{
					string statusModifySolutionFound = UIResources.StatusModifySolutionFound;
					statusModifySolutionFound = statusModifySolutionFound.Replace("\r", "").Replace("\n", "");
					GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].StepResult = statusModifySolutionFound;
				}
				else if (GeneratingStatus[0].State == GeneratingRecordState.Failed)
				{
					string statusModifyNoSolution = UIResources.StatusModifyNoSolution;
					GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].StepResult = statusModifyNoSolution;
				}
				else if (GeneratingStatus[0].State == GeneratingRecordState.Running)
				{
					string statusModifySearchingSolution = UIResources.StatusModifySearchingSolution;
					GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].StepResult = statusModifySearchingSolution;
				}
				if (e.State == EAGenerateState.Running)
				{
					Mouse.SetCursor(Cursors.Wait);
					energyAnalysisAgent.IsFindingDesignChanges = true;
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisMessenger>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).BlockFlowsheetUI();
					ReadProgress(bStart: true);
				}
				else if (e.State == EAGenerateState.Succeeded)
				{
					UpdateModifyHXSource(ModifyHXID + " Scenario", e.Result.NavigationPath);
					ReadProgress(bStart: false);
					Mouse.SetCursor(Cursors.Arrow);
					energyAnalysisAgent.IsFindingDesignChanges = false;
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisMessenger>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).UnblockFlowsheetUI();
				}
				else if (e.State == EAGenerateState.Failed)
				{
					ReadProgress(bStart: false);
					Mouse.SetCursor(Cursors.Arrow);
					energyAnalysisAgent.IsFindingDesignChanges = false;
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisMessenger>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).UnblockFlowsheetUI();
				}
			}
			else if (e.Operation == EAGenerateOperation.Add)
			{
				if (nCancelGenerateProcessStep == 1)
				{
					ReadProgress(bStart: false);
					Mouse.SetCursor(Cursors.Arrow);
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisMessenger>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).UnblockFlowsheetUI();
					return;
				}
				nOldGenStep = 1;
				_processedStep = 1;
				GeneratingStatus[1].State = ConvertTo(e.State);
				if (GeneratingStatus[1].State == GeneratingRecordState.Succeeded)
				{
					string stepResult = ((UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSolutionCount(_processedStep) == 0) ? UIResources.Progressbar_SolutionSeachResult_0 : ((UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSolutionCount(_processedStep) != 1) ? string.Format(UIResources.Progressbar_SolutionSeachResult_2, UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSolutionCount(_processedStep)) : UIResources.Progressbar_SolutionSeachResult_1));
					GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].StepResult = stepResult;
					string[] array = e.Result.DesignChange.Split(' ');
					sAddTitleH = UIResources.AddTitleH + ((array.Length > 1) ? array[1] : array[0]);
					NotifyPropertyChanged("AddTitleH");
					addHXKey = e.Result.NavigationPath;
				}
				else if (GeneratingStatus[1].State == GeneratingRecordState.Failed)
				{
					string progressbar_SolutionSeachResult_ = UIResources.Progressbar_SolutionSeachResult_0;
					GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].StepResult = progressbar_SolutionSeachResult_;
				}
				if (e.State == EAGenerateState.Running)
				{
					Mouse.SetCursor(Cursors.Wait);
					energyAnalysisAgent.IsFindingDesignChanges = true;
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisMessenger>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).BlockFlowsheetUI();
					ReadProgress(bStart: true);
				}
				else if (e.State == EAGenerateState.Succeeded)
				{
					UpdateNewHXSource(AddHXID + " Scenario");
				}
				if (e.State == EAGenerateState.Succeeded || e.State == EAGenerateState.Failed)
				{
					ReadProgress(bStart: false);
					Mouse.SetCursor(Cursors.Arrow);
					energyAnalysisAgent.IsFindingDesignChanges = false;
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisMessenger>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).UnblockFlowsheetUI();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (e.Operation != EAGenerateOperation.Relocate)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (nCancelGenerateProcessStep == 2)
				{
					SuggestImprovements.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
					ReadProgress(bStart: false);
					Mouse.SetCursor(Cursors.Arrow);
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisMessenger>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).UnblockFlowsheetUI();
					return;
				}
				_processedStep = 2;
				nOldGenStep = 1;
				GeneratingStatus[2].State = ConvertTo(e.State);
				if (GeneratingStatus[2].State == GeneratingRecordState.Succeeded)
				{
					string stepResult2 = ((UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSolutionCount(_processedStep) == 0) ? UIResources.Progressbar_SolutionSeachResult_0 : ((UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSolutionCount(_processedStep) != 1) ? string.Format(UIResources.Progressbar_SolutionSeachResult_2, UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSolutionCount(_processedStep)) : UIResources.Progressbar_SolutionSeachResult_1));
					GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].StepResult = stepResult2;
					string[] array2 = e.Result.DesignChange.Split(' ');
					sRelocateTitleH = UIResources.RelocateTitleH + ((array2.Length > 1) ? array2[1] : array2[0]);
					NotifyPropertyChanged("RelocateTitleH");
					relocateHXKey = e.Result.NavigationPath;
				}
				else if (GeneratingStatus[2].State == GeneratingRecordState.Failed)
				{
					string progressbar_SolutionSeachResult_2 = UIResources.Progressbar_SolutionSeachResult_0;
					GeneratingStatus[_processedStep].StepResult = progressbar_SolutionSeachResult_2;
				}
				if (e.State == EAGenerateState.Running)
				{
					Mouse.SetCursor(Cursors.Wait);
					energyAnalysisAgent.IsFindingDesignChanges = true;
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisMessenger>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).BlockFlowsheetUI();
					ReadProgress(bStart: true);
				}
				else if (e.State == EAGenerateState.Succeeded)
				{
					UpdateRelcoateHXSource(RelocHXID + " Scenario");
				}
				if (e.State == EAGenerateState.Succeeded || e.State == EAGenerateState.Failed)
				{
					ReadProgress(bStart: false);
					Mouse.SetCursor(Cursors.Arrow);
					energyAnalysisAgent.IsFindingDesignChanges = false;
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisMessenger>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).UnblockFlowsheetUI();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRelcoateHXSource(object scenarioIdentifer)
		{
			List<RelocateHeatExchangerView> relcoateHXCollection = new List<RelocateHeatExchangerView>();
			RelcoateHXCollection = relcoateHXCollection;
			if (scenarioIdentifer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = BuildRelocateMoniker(scenarioIdentifer.ToString(), "1");
			_resolvedData = dataResolver.ResolveData(text);
			if (((_resolvedData != null && _resolvedData.ContainsKey(text)) ? _resolvedData[text] : null) is RelocateHeatExchangerViewCollection relocateHeatExchangerViewCollection && relocateHeatExchangerViewCollection.Count() > 0)
			{
				RelcoateHXCollection = relocateHeatExchangerViewCollection.OrderBy((RelocateHeatExchangerView item) => double.Parse(item.Payback));
				sRelocateTitle = relocateHeatExchangerViewCollection.Count + ((relocateHeatExchangerViewCollection.Count == 1) ? UIResources.GridTitle2 : UIResources.GridTitle1);
				NotifyPropertyChanged("RelocateTitle");
				if (!Expander_3.IsExpanded)
				{
					TableVisible3 = Visibility.Visible;
					Expander_3.IsExpanded = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private string BuildAddMoniker(string scenarioKey, string retrofitIndex)
		{
			return DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_AddHeatExchanger, base.ProjejectKey, scenarioKey, "1");
		}

		private string BuildRelocateMoniker(string scenarioKey, string retrofitIndex)
		{
			return DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_RelocateHeatExchanger, scenarioKey: scenarioKey, retrofitIndex: retrofitIndex.ToString(), projectKey: base.ProjejectKey);
		}

		private void UpdateNewHXSource(object scenarioIdentifer)
		{
			List<NewHeatExchangerView> newHXCollection = new List<NewHeatExchangerView>();
			NewHXCollection = newHXCollection;
			if (scenarioIdentifer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = BuildAddMoniker(scenarioIdentifer.ToString(), "1");
			_resolvedData = base.DataResolver.ResolveData(text);
			if (((_resolvedData != null && _resolvedData.ContainsKey(text)) ? _resolvedData[text] : null) is NewHeatExchangerViewCollection newHeatExchangerViewCollection && newHeatExchangerViewCollection.Count() > 0)
			{
				sAddTitle = newHeatExchangerViewCollection.Count + ((newHeatExchangerViewCollection.Count == 1) ? UIResources.GridTitle2 : UIResources.GridTitle1);
				NotifyPropertyChanged("AddTitle");
				NewHXCollection = newHeatExchangerViewCollection.OrderBy((NewHeatExchangerView item) => double.Parse(item.Payback));
				if (!Expander_1.IsExpanded)
				{
					TableVisible1 = Visibility.Visible;
					Expander_1.IsExpanded = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearDesignMatrixFor(EAGenerateOperation operation)
		{
			switch (operation)
			{
			case EAGenerateOperation.Modify:
			{
				string moniker = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_Scenario, "Project 1", "1 Scenario");
				SummaryUtilities summaryUtilities = base.DataResolver.ResolveData<SummaryUtilities>(moniker);
				string scenarioIdentifer = ModifyHXID + " Scenario";
				if (summaryUtilities.Count >= 3)
				{
					SummaryUtilityInformationView item = summaryUtilities.FirstOrDefault((SummaryUtilityInformationView summaryUtilityInformationView) => summaryUtilityInformationView.DesignIndex == 0);
					summaryUtilities.Remove(item);
				}
				UpdateModifyHXSource(scenarioIdentifer, "");
				TableVisible2 = Visibility.Hidden;
				Expander_2.IsExpanded = false;
				break;
			}
			case EAGenerateOperation.Add:
			{
				string text2 = BuildAddMoniker("2 Scenario", "1");
				dynamic val2 = dataResolver.ResolveData(text2);
				if (val2 != null && val2.ContainsKey(text2))
				{
					val2[text2] = null;
				}
				UpdateNewHXSource(AddHXID + " Scenario");
				TableVisible1 = Visibility.Hidden;
				Expander_1.IsExpanded = false;
				break;
			}
			case EAGenerateOperation.Relocate:
			{
				string text = BuildRelocateMoniker("3 Scenario", "1");
				dynamic val = dataResolver.ResolveData(text);
				if (val != null && val.ContainsKey(text))
				{
					val[text] = null;
				}
				UpdateRelcoateHXSource(RelocHXID + " Scenario");
				TableVisible3 = Visibility.Hidden;
				Expander_3.IsExpanded = false;
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateModifyHXSource(object scenarioIdentifer, string sNavigateKey)
		{
			string moniker = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_Scenario, "Project 1", scenarioIdentifer.ToString());
			SummaryUtilities summaryUtilities = base.DataResolver.ResolveData<SummaryUtilities>(moniker);
			if (summaryUtilities != null && summaryUtilities.Count >= 3)
			{
				SummaryUtilityInformationView summaryUtilityInformationView = summaryUtilities.ElementAt(1);
				string energyCost = (Convert.ToDouble(summaryUtilities.ElementAt(0).Cost, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) - Convert.ToDouble(summaryUtilityInformationView.Cost, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)).ToString("N0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).Replace(",", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.NumberFormat.NumberGroupSeparator);
				DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_ModifyHeatExchanger, "Project 1", scenarioIdentifer.ToString(), "1");
				SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection source = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IDataResolver>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ResolveData<SurfaceAreanEntityViewCollection>(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_ModifyHeatExchanger, "Project 1", scenarioIdentifer.ToString(), "1"));
				string moniker2 = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Payback_ModifyHeatExchanger, "Project 1", scenarioIdentifer.ToString(), "1");
				double num = Math.Round(base.DataResolver.ResolveData<double>(moniker2), 4);
				string[] array = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(summaryUtilityInformationView.Name) ? new string[0] : summaryUtilityInformationView.Name.Split('–'));
				DesignChanges.Clear();
				DesignChanges.Add(new DesignChangeRecord(UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()))
				{
					DesignChange = ((array.Length < 2) ? string.Empty : array[1]),
					EnergySaving = Convert.ToDouble(summaryUtilityInformationView.Reduction, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture).ToString("F2"),
					EnergyCost = energyCost,
					CapitalCost = source.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView item) => item.ExtraCapitalCost).ToString("N0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).Replace(",", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.NumberFormat.NumberGroupSeparator),
					NewArea = source.Sum((SurfaceAreanEntityView item) => item.NewArea).ToString("G4"),
					Payback = num.ToString("G4", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture),
					NavigationPath = sNavigateKey,
					OperationType = EAGenerateOperation.Modify
				});
				NotifyPropertyChanged("DesignChanges");
				if (!Expander_2.IsExpanded)
				{
					TableVisible2 = Visibility.Visible;
					Expander_2.IsExpanded = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ReadProgress(bool bStart)
		{
			if (bStart)
			{
				_timer.Interval = new TimeSpan(750000L);
				_timer.Tick += TimerReadTempLogFile;
				_timer.Start();
			}
			else
			{
				_timer.Tick -= TimerReadTempLogFile;
				_timer.Stop();
			}
		}

		public void RunSIFromSummary()
		{
			IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = null;
			try
			{
				energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			if (energyAnalysisAgent != null && energyAnalysisAgent.CanDoGeneration())
			{
				_processedStep = -1;
				IsSummaryVisible = true;
				GeneratingStatus[0].StepResult = "";
				GeneratingStatus[0].State = GeneratingRecordState.NotRun;
				GeneratingStatus[1].StepResult = "";
				GeneratingStatus[1].State = GeneratingRecordState.NotRun;
				GeneratingStatus[2].StepResult = "";
				GeneratingStatus[2].State = GeneratingRecordState.NotRun;
				energyAnalysisAgent.SetGenerateUpperLimit(nAddHX, nRelocateHX);
				energyAnalysisAgent.DoGeneration();
			}
		}

		void IPersistent.Restore(object state)
		{
			if (state is SImprovementsPageState sImprovementsPageState)
			{
				AddHX = int.Parse(sImprovementsPageState.AddExchangersTopLimit);
				RelocateHX = int.Parse(sImprovementsPageState.RelocateExchangersTopLimit);
				GeneratingStatus = new ObservableCollection<GeneratingStatusRecord>(sImprovementsPageState.GenerationStatus);
				_DesignChanges = new ObservableCollection<DesignChangeRecord>(sImprovementsPageState.DesignChanges);
			}
		}

		object IPersistent.Save()
		{
			return new SImprovementsPageState(GeneratingStatus, DesignChanges)
			{
				AddExchangersTopLimit = nAddHX.ToString(),
				RelocateExchangersTopLimit = nRelocateHX.ToString()
			};
		}

		protected internal override void OnXamDataGridClipboardCopying(object sender, ClipboardCopyingEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnXamDataGridClipboardCopying(sender, e);
			if (((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Handled || ((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).Values == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).FieldCount; i++)
			{
				Field sourceField = e.GetSourceField(i);
				if (sourceField != null && ((FieldItem)sourceField).Name == "RowNameField")
				{
					num = i;
				}
			}
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamDataGrid val = (XamDataGrid)((sender is XamDataGrid) ? sender : null);
			if (((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Name == "surfaceAreaGrid0")
			{
				e.GetLabelValueHolder(0).Value = AddTitleH;
			}
			else if (((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Name == "surfaceAreaGrid2")
			{
				e.GetLabelValueHolder(0).Value = RelocateTitleH;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < ((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).RecordCount; j++)
			{
				Cell sourceCell = e.GetSourceCell(j, num);
				if (sourceCell != null)
				{
					CellValuePresenter val2 = CellValuePresenter.FromCell(sourceCell);
					if (val2 != null && Utilities.GetDescendantFromType((DependencyObject)(object)val2, typeof(TextBlock), allowSubclassOfType: false) is TextBlock textBlock)
					{
						((ClipboardOperationEventArgs)e).Values[j, num].Value = textBlock.Text;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		void IComponentConnector.Connect(int connectionId, object target)

			case 3:
				relocateExchangers = (NumericSpinBox)target;
				break;
			case 4:
				Expander_2 = (Expander)target;
				break;
			case 5:
				surfaceAreaGrid1 = (XamDataGrid)target;
				break;
			case 6:
				Expander_1 = (Expander)target;
				break;
			case 7:
				surfaceAreaGrid0 = (XamDataGrid)target;
				break;
			case 8:
				Expander_3 = (Expander)target;
				break;
			case 9:
				surfaceAreaGrid2 = (XamDataGrid)target;
				break;
			default:
				_contentLoaded = true;
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	public class BoolVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return Visibility.Visible;
			}
			if (!bool.TryParse(value.ToString(), out var result))
			{
				return Visibility.Visible;
			}
			if (result)
			{
				return Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class IsRunningConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Visibility visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
			if (value == null || parameter == null)
			{
				return visibility;
			}
			if (!bool.TryParse(value.ToString(), out var result))
			{
				return visibility;
			}
			if ((result && string.Equals(parameter.ToString(), "RunningIcon", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)) || (!result && string.Equals(parameter.ToString(), "Histograms", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)))
			{
				return Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return visibility;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class BoolNotVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return Visibility.Visible;
			}
			if (!bool.TryParse(value.ToString(), out var result))
			{
				return Visibility.Visible;
			}
			if (result)
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			return Visibility.Visible;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class StatusIconConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null || value.GetType() != typeof(GeneratingRecordState))
			{
				return null;
			}
			GeneratingRecordState generatingRecordState = (GeneratingRecordState)value;
			string text = null;
			switch (generatingRecordState)
			{
			case GeneratingRecordState.Failed:
			case GeneratingRecordState.Clear:
				text = "StatusFailed.16.png";
				break;
			case GeneratingRecordState.NotRun:
				text = "StatusNotRun.16.png";
				break;
			case GeneratingRecordState.Running:
				text = "StatusRunning.16.png";
				break;
			case GeneratingRecordState.Succeeded:
				text = "StatusSucceeded.16.png";
				break;
			}
			return new BitmapImage(new Uri("pack://application:,,,/Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface;component/Images/" + text));
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class StatusFontWeightConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null || value.GetType() != typeof(GeneratingRecordState))
			{
				return FontWeights.Normal;
			}
			if ((GeneratingRecordState)value == GeneratingRecordState.Running)
			{
				return FontWeights.Bold;
			}
			return FontWeights.Normal;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class StatusForegroundConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null || value.GetType() != typeof(GeneratingRecordState))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if ((GeneratingRecordState)value == GeneratingRecordState.NotRun)
			{
				return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Gray;
			}
			return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	public class RowNumberConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values != null && values[0] != null)
			{
				object obj = values[0];
				Record val = (Record)((obj is Record) ? obj : null);
				return UIResources.Solution + (val.VisibleIndex + 1);
			}
			return null;
		}

		{
