	public class Landing_Summary : MMTabPage, IComponentConnector
	{
		private int nExistedChild;

		private bool bEAButtonEnabled = true;

		private bool bCanGenerate = true;

		internal Grid ColumnChartGrid;

		internal XamDataGrid xdg;

		internal Button btnSuggestImprovement;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public Landing_Summary()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
		}

		[InjectionConstructor]
		public Landing_Summary(IUnityContainer container)
			: base(container)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			base.HelpId = 13101;
			Landing_Summary_vm landing_Summary_vm = new Landing_Summary_vm(container);
			landing_Summary_vm.PlotBarChartEvent += vm_PlotBarChartEvent;
			nExistedChild = ColumnChartGrid.Children.Count;
			landing_Summary_vm.Update();
			base.ViewModel = landing_Summary_vm;
			base.Loaded += Landing_Summary_Loaded;
		}

		private void Landing_Summary_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null && (energyAnalysisAgent.IsUtilitiesWarning || energyAnalysisAgent.IsExchangerWarning || !energyAnalysisAgent.CanDoGeneration()))
				{
					bCanGenerate = false;
					btnSuggestImprovement.IsEnabled = false;
					SetSPButtonTip();
				}
			}
			((UIElement)(object)xdg).Focus();
		}

		protected override void OnUnityContainerChanged(IUnityContainer oldValue, IUnityContainer newValue)
		{
			base.OnUnityContainerChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					energyAnalysisAgent.AnalysisCompleteEvent += agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent;
					energyAnalysisAgent.RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent += agent_RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent;
				}
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<EARuningStatusEvent>().Subscribe(RunningStatus);
			}
		}

		public void UnRegisterEvents()
		{
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					energyAnalysisAgent.AnalysisCompleteEvent -= agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent;
					energyAnalysisAgent.RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent -= agent_RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent;
				}
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<EARuningStatusEvent>().Unsubscribe(RunningStatus);
			}
		}

		private void vm_PlotBarChartEvent(object sender, PlotBarChartArgs e)
		{
			if (ColumnChartGrid.Children.Count > nExistedChild)
			{
				ColumnChartGrid.Children.RemoveRange(nExistedChild, ColumnChartGrid.Children.Count - nExistedChild);
			}
			double num = 160.0;
			double width = 36.0;
			int num2 = 4;
			int num3 = 6;
			int num4 = 1;
			ObservableCollection<ChartItem> datas = e.ChartData;
			double num5 = (from item in datas.Where((ChartItem item, int i) => i < datas.Count - 2)
				select Math.Abs(item.Value)).Max();
			int num6;
			for (num6 = 0; num6 < datas.Count; num6++)
			{
				ChartItem chartItem = datas[num6];
				ChartItem chartItem2 = datas[++num6];
				double num7 = Math.Max(Math.Abs(chartItem.Value), Math.Abs(chartItem2.Value));
				double num8 = Math.Min(Math.Abs(chartItem.Value), Math.Abs(chartItem2.Value));
				double num9 = ((num5 == 0.0) ? 0.0 : (num * num7 / num5));
				if (num6 == datas.Count - 1)
				{
					num9 = num;
				}
				double num10 = ((num7 == 0.0) ? 0.0 : (num8 / num7));
				double num11 = ((Math.Abs(chartItem.Value) == num7) ? num9 : (num9 * num10));
				double num12 = ((Math.Abs(chartItem2.Value) == num7) ? num9 : (num9 * num10));
				TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock
				{
					Text = chartItem.StringValue,
					HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch,
					TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Center
				};
				System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle element = new System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle
				{
					Fill = chartItem.FillWith,
					Width = width,
					Height = ((Math.Abs(chartItem.Value) < 1E-08) ? 0.0 : num11),
					HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center
				};
				DockPanel dockPanel = new DockPanel
				{
					LastChildFill = true
				};
				dockPanel.Children.Add(textBlock);
				dockPanel.Children.Add(element);
				dockPanel.SetValue(Grid.ColumnProperty, num4);
				TextBlock textBlock2 = new TextBlock
				{
					Text = chartItem.Label,
					HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch,
					TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Center
				};
				textBlock2.SetValue(Grid.ColumnProperty, num4);
				if (chartItem.Value < 0.0)
				{
					dockPanel.SetValue(Grid.RowProperty, num3);
					textBlock2.SetValue(Grid.RowProperty, num2);
					textBlock2.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Bottom;
					textBlock.SetValue(DockPanel.DockProperty, Dock.Bottom);
					textBlock.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, 2.0, 0.0, 0.0);
					dockPanel.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
				}
				else
				{
					dockPanel.SetValue(Grid.RowProperty, num2);
					textBlock2.SetValue(Grid.RowProperty, num3);
					textBlock.SetValue(DockPanel.DockProperty, Dock.Top);
					textBlock.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 2.0);
					dockPanel.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Bottom;
				}
				num4 += 2;
				TextBlock textBlock3 = new TextBlock
				{
					Text = chartItem2.StringValue,
					HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch,
					TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Center
				};
				textBlock3.SetValue(DockPanel.DockProperty, Dock.Top);
				System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle element2 = new System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle
				{
					Fill = chartItem2.FillWith,
					Width = width,
					Height = ((Math.Abs(chartItem2.Value) < 1E-08) ? 0.0 : num12),
					HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center
				};
				DockPanel dockPanel2 = new DockPanel
				{
					LastChildFill = true
				};
				dockPanel2.Children.Add(textBlock3);
				dockPanel2.Children.Add(element2);
				dockPanel2.SetValue(Grid.ColumnProperty, num4);
				TextBlock textBlock4 = new TextBlock
				{
					Text = chartItem2.Label,
					HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch,
					TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Center
				};
				textBlock4.SetValue(Grid.ColumnProperty, num4);
				if (chartItem2.Value < 0.0)
				{
					dockPanel2.SetValue(Grid.RowProperty, num3);
					textBlock4.SetValue(Grid.RowProperty, num2);
					textBlock4.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Bottom;
					textBlock3.SetValue(DockPanel.DockProperty, Dock.Bottom);
					textBlock3.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, 2.0, 0.0, 0.0);
					dockPanel2.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
				}
				else
				{
					dockPanel2.SetValue(Grid.RowProperty, num2);
					textBlock4.SetValue(Grid.RowProperty, num3);
					textBlock3.SetValue(DockPanel.DockProperty, Dock.Top);
					textBlock3.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 2.0);
					dockPanel2.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Bottom;
				}
				num4 += 4;
				ColumnChartGrid.Children.Add(dockPanel);
				ColumnChartGrid.Children.Add(textBlock2);
				ColumnChartGrid.Children.Add(dockPanel2);
				ColumnChartGrid.Children.Add(textBlock4);
			}
		}

		private void agent_RefreshIsAnalysisButtonEnabledEvent(object sender, IsAnalysisButtonEnabledEventArgs e)
		{
			bEAButtonEnabled = e.IsEnabled;
			if (bEAButtonEnabled)
			{
				btnSuggestImprovement.IsEnabled = bCanGenerate;
			}
			else
			{
				btnSuggestImprovement.IsEnabled = false;
			}
			SetSPButtonTip();
		}

		private void SetSPButtonTip()
		{
			if (btnSuggestImprovement.IsEnabled)
			{
				btnSuggestImprovement.ToolTip = UIResources.SuggestImprovementsTip;
			}
			else
			{
				btnSuggestImprovement.ToolTip = UIResources.SuggestImprovementsDisableTip;
			}
		}

		private void RunningStatus(EARuningStatusEventArgs args)
		{
			bCanGenerate = args.CanGenerate;
			if (bEAButtonEnabled)
			{
				btnSuggestImprovement.IsEnabled = args.CanGenerate;
			}
			else
			{
				btnSuggestImprovement.IsEnabled = false;
			}
			SetSPButtonTip();
		}

	public class PercentageConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is double num && parameter is string s)
			{
				double num2 = double.Parse(s, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				return num * num2;
			}
			return Binding.DoNothing;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

		public string GlobalMinDetaTemperature
		{
			get
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> value = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_GlobalDTmin, (base.Variable != null) ? base.Variable.ProjectKey : "Project 1"));
				string value2 = GlobalProjectDeltaMinTemperature.GetValue((base.Variable != null) ? base.Variable.ProjectKey : "Project 1");
				string empty = string.Empty;
				empty = ((value != null) ? (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2) ? value.First().Value : value2) : (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2) ? globalDTmin.ToString("G4") : value2));
				IValueUnit valueUnit = UnitValueFactory.Create(UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).SimulatorName);
				if (valueUnit != null)
				{
					((double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(globalDTmin, PropertyEnum.DeltaTemperature)).ToString("G4");
					if (value != null)
					{
						empty = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2)) ? ((double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(Convert.ToDouble(value2, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), PropertyEnum.DeltaTemperature)).ToString("G4") : ((double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(Convert.ToDouble(value.First().Value.ToString(), CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), PropertyEnum.DeltaTemperature)).ToString("G4"));
					}
				}
				if (base.ViewModel is Landing_Configuration_vm landing_Configuration_vm)
				{
					ComboxItemData selectedProcesstype = landing_Configuration_vm.GetSelectedProcesstype();
					if (selectedProcesstype != null && valueUnit != null && ((double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(selectedProcesstype.Value, PropertyEnum.DeltaTemperature)).ToString("G4") != empty)
					{
						appTinput.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold;
						appTinput.FontStyle = FontStyles.Normal;
					}
				}
				return empty;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!double.TryParse(value, out var result) || result <= 0.0)
				{
					return;
				}
				HYSYSParameters hYSYSParameters = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (hYSYSParameters == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(hYSYSParameters.SimulatorName))
				{
					return;
				}
				IValueUnit valueUnit = UnitValueFactory.Create(hYSYSParameters.SimulatorName);
				if (valueUnit == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				double num = (double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(result, PropertyEnum.ToDeltaTemperature);
				if (0.01 > num || 100.0 < num)
				{
					return;
				}
				UtilityView utilityView = null;
				IDataResolver dataResolver = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IDataResolver>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (dataResolver != null)
				{
					utilityView = dataResolver.ResolveData<UtilityView>(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EnginData_UtilityView));
				}
				if (utilityView != null)
				{
					utilityView.GlobalMinDeltaTemperature = num;
				}
				SetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_GlobalDTmin, (base.Variable != null) ? base.Variable.ProjectKey : "Project 1"), num.ToString("G4"));
				GlobalProjectDeltaMinTemperature.SetValue((base.Variable != null) ? base.Variable.ProjectKey : "Project 1", num.ToString("G4"));
				Dictionary<string, string> value2 = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CaseDocument>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_ExchangerMinApproachTemperature, (base.Variable != null) ? base.Variable.ProjectKey : "Project 1"));
				if (value2 != null && value2.Count > 0 && double.TryParse(value2.First().Value, out var result2) && result < result2)
				{
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CaseDocument>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).Write(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_ExchangerMinApproachTemperature, (base.Variable != null) ? base.Variable.ProjectKey : "Project 1"), num);
				}
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Publish(new WorkflowControlStateArgs
				{
					ControlType = WorkflowControl.Tranfer,
					State = true
				});
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UpdateFormEvent>().Publish(new UpdateFormArgs
				{
					SpecifiedParas = new object[1] { "GlobalMinDetaTemperature" }
				});
				if (base.Container != null && utilityView != null)
				{
					IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
					if (energyAnalysisAgent != null && !energyAnalysisAgent.NeedsEARerun && energyAnalysisAgent.IsAutoRun())
					{
						energyAnalysisAgent.ShowDashboardResults();
						energyAnalysisAgent.RaiseAnalysisComplete(EAOperations.UpdateView);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateViewForCurveSelected()
		{
			if (HotSeries == null || ColdSeries == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (UpdateSharedChartDataDictionary())
			{
				CompositeMainGrid.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				CompositeRunAEAIsNeededGrid.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				switch (CurveTypeSelected)
				{
				case CurveTypes.CompositeCurve:
				{
					if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.COMPCURV, out var value2))
					{
						CompositeChartViewModel compositeChartViewModel2 = value2 as CompositeChartViewModel;
						HotSeries.Title = "Hot curve";
						HotSeries.LegendItemVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
						ColdSeries.Title = "Cold curve";
						ColdSeries.LegendItemVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
						ThePinchPointSerie.Title = "Pinch point";
						ThePinchPointSerie.LegendItemVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
						HotSeries.ItemsSource = compositeChartViewModel2.HotCurveView.Points;
						ColdSeries.ItemsSource = compositeChartViewModel2.ColdCurveView.Points;
						if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.PINCHLIST, out var value3) && value3 != null)
						{
							PinchListViewModel pinchListViewModel = value3 as PinchListViewModel;
							ThePinchPointSerie.ItemsSource = CompositeCurveUtilities.LocatePintchPointsBetweenCurves(pinchListViewModel, compositeChartViewModel2.HotCurveView.Points, compositeChartViewModel2.ColdCurveView.Points);
						}
						(IList<object>, IList<object>) dataGridInfoFromCurve2 = GetDataGridInfoFromCurve(compositeChartViewModel2);
						((DataPresenterBase)XamDataGrid_CompositeCurve_Hot).DataSource = dataGridInfoFromCurve2.Item1;
						((DataPresenterBase)XamDataGrid_CompositeCurve_Cold).DataSource = dataGridInfoFromCurve2.Item2;
						Composite_Curve_Grid.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
						Grand_Composite_Curve_Grid.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						Utility_Composite_Curve_Grid.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					}
					break;
				}
				case CurveTypes.GrandCompositeCurve:
				{
					if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.GRANDCOMPCURV, out var value4))
					{
						HotSeries.Title = "Grand composite curve";
						HotSeries.LegendItemVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
						ColdSeries.LegendItemVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						ThePinchPointSerie.LegendItemVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						CompositeChartViewModel compositeChartViewModel3 = value4 as CompositeChartViewModel;
						HotSeries.ItemsSource = compositeChartViewModel3.HotCurveView.Points;
						ColdSeries.ItemsSource = null;
						ThePinchPointSerie.ItemsSource = null;
						(IList<object>, IList<object>) dataGridInfoFromCurve3 = GetDataGridInfoFromCurve(compositeChartViewModel3);
						((DataPresenterBase)XamDataGrid_Grand_CompositeCurve).DataSource = dataGridInfoFromCurve3.Item1;
						Composite_Curve_Grid.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						Grand_Composite_Curve_Grid.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
						Utility_Composite_Curve_Grid.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					}
					break;
				}
				case CurveTypes.UtilityCompositeCurve:
				{
					if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.UTILCOMPCUR, out var value))
					{
						HotSeries.Title = "Hot curve";
						HotSeries.LegendItemVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
						ColdSeries.Title = "Cold curve";
						ColdSeries.LegendItemVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
						ThePinchPointSerie.LegendItemVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						CompositeChartViewModel compositeChartViewModel = value as CompositeChartViewModel;
						HotSeries.ItemsSource = compositeChartViewModel.HotCurveView.Points;
						ColdSeries.ItemsSource = compositeChartViewModel.ColdCurveView.Points;
						ThePinchPointSerie.ItemsSource = null;
						(IList<object>, IList<object>) dataGridInfoFromCurve = GetDataGridInfoFromCurve(compositeChartViewModel);
						((DataPresenterBase)XamDataGrid_Utility_CompositeCurve_Hot).DataSource = dataGridInfoFromCurve.Item1;
						((DataPresenterBase)XamDataGrid_Utility_CompositeCurve_Cold).DataSource = dataGridInfoFromCurve.Item2;
						Composite_Curve_Grid.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						Grand_Composite_Curve_Grid.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						Utility_Composite_Curve_Grid.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				LandingFormGridResource landingFormGridResource = TryFindResource("GridResource") as LandingFormGridResource;
				Chart.Axes.First((Axis c) => c.Name == "yAxis").Title = landingFormGridResource.TemperatureChartHeader;
				Axis axis = Chart.Axes.First((Axis c) => c.Name == "xAxis");
				axis.Title = landingFormGridResource.EnthalpyChartHeader;
				axis.Label = "{0:E3}";
			}
			else
			{
				CompositeMainGrid.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				CompositeRunAEAIsNeededGrid.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
		}

			((DataPresenterBase)XamDataGrid_CompositeCurve_Hot).DataSource = TheNullObject;

				base.Variable = new DataVariable

					ProjectKey = "Project 1"
				};
			}
		}

			((DataPresenterBase)XamDataGrid_CompositeCurve_Hot).DataSource = TheNullObject;

			((DataPresenterBase)XamDataGrid_Grand_CompositeCurve).DataSource = TheNullObject;

					{

						ControlType = WorkflowControl.ModifyHeatExchanger_ProcessBar

			base.HelpId = 13108;
			base.Loaded += Landing_Curves_Loaded;
		}

		protected override void OnUnityContainerChanged(IUnityContainer oldValue, IUnityContainer newValue)
		{
			base.OnUnityContainerChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					energyAnalysisAgent.AnalysisCompleteEvent += agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent;
				}
			}
		}

		public void UnRegisterEvents()
		{
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					energyAnalysisAgent.AnalysisCompleteEvent -= agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent;
				}
				if (_token != null)
				{
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<DataSourceChangedEvent>().Unsubscribe(_token);
				}
			}
			if (TryFindResource("GridResource") is LandingFormGridResource landingFormGridResource)
			{
				landingFormGridResource.Dispose();
			}
		}

		{
			ChangeStyleSetForLandingPage();
		}

		public void agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EAUpdateEventArgs e2 = e as EAUpdateEventArgs;
			if (e2 != null && (e2.opt == EAOperations.UpdateView || e2.opt == EAOperations.RunCompleted))
			{
				UpdateCurvesContent();
				UpdateViewForCurveSelected();
				SharedChartData.TriggerUpdateChartEvent();
			}
			else if (e2 != null && e2.opt == EAOperations.EAOff)
			{
				CloseScreen(base.Container, "Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.ItemPages.ActivationCompositeFactory.Key");
				CloseScreen(base.Container, "Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.ItemPages.ActivationGrandFactory.Key");
				CloseScreen(base.Container, "Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.ItemPages.ActivationUtilityFactory.Key");
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCurvesContent()
		{
			OnPropertyChanged("GlobalDTMinLabel");
			if (!UpdateSharedChartDataDictionary())
			{
				return;
			}
			if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.COMPCURV, out var value))
			{
				CompositeChartViewModel compositeChartViewModel = value as CompositeChartViewModel;
				if (compositeChartViewModel._updateContent != null)
				{
					compositeChartViewModel._updateContent();
				}
			}
			if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.GRANDCOMPCURV, out var value2))
			{
				CompositeChartViewModel compositeChartViewModel2 = value2 as CompositeChartViewModel;
				if (compositeChartViewModel2._updateContent != null)
				{
					compositeChartViewModel2._updateContent();
				}
			}
			if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.UTILCOMPCUR, out var value3))
			{
				CompositeChartViewModel compositeChartViewModel3 = value3 as CompositeChartViewModel;
				if (compositeChartViewModel3._updateContent != null)
				{
					compositeChartViewModel3._updateContent();
				}
			}
			if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.PINCHLIST, out var value4))
			{
				PinchListViewModel pinchListViewModel = value4 as PinchListViewModel;
				if (pinchListViewModel._updateContent != null)
				{
					pinchListViewModel._updateContent();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnVariableChanged(DataVariable dataVariable, bool bIsBackground)
		{
			UpdateViewForCurveSelected();
		}

		private (IList<object>, IList<object>) GetDataGridInfoFromCurve(CompositeChartViewModel vmcurve)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			if (vmcurve.HotCurveView.Points != null)
			{
				foreach (CompositeCurvePoint point in vmcurve.HotCurveView.Points)
				{
					var item = new { point.Enthalpy, point.Temperature };
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			if (vmcurve.ColdCurveView.Points != null)
			{
				foreach (CompositeCurvePoint point2 in vmcurve.ColdCurveView.Points)
				{
					var item2 = new { point2.Enthalpy, point2.Temperature };
					list2.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			return (list, list2);
		}

		private bool UpdateSharedChartDataDictionary()
		{
			string moniker = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.EngineData_Curves, base.Variable.ProjectKey);
			SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary = base.DataResolver.ResolveData<Dictionary<CurveDataType, object>>(moniker);
			if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.Count > 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void selectedCurveGroup_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (CompositeCurveSelect.IsChecked == true)
			{
				CurveTypeSelected = CurveTypes.CompositeCurve;
			}
			else if (GrandCompositeCurveSelect.IsChecked == true)
			{
				CurveTypeSelected = CurveTypes.GrandCompositeCurve;
			}
			else if (UtilityCompositeCurveSelect.IsChecked == true)
			{
				CurveTypeSelected = CurveTypes.UtilityCompositeCurve;
			}
		}

		{
			return new CompositeCurvesPageState();
		}

		void IPersistent.Restore(object state)
		{
			_ = state is CompositeCurvesPageState;
		}

		private void Chart_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			HotSeries = Chart.Series.First((Infragistics.Controls.Charts.Series c) => c.Name == "HotCurveSeries");

		public static void CloseScreen(IUnityContainer container, string screenFactoryKey)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(screenFactoryKey))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Parameter screenFactoryKey cannot be null or empty.");
			}
			IShellApplication shellApplication = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellApplication>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (shellApplication != null && shellApplication.ActiveWindow != null)
			{
				ScreenContentControl screenContentControl = shellApplication.ActiveWindow.FindScreen((ScreenContentControl x) => string.Equals(x.ScreenFactoryKey, screenFactoryKey, StringComparison.InvariantCulture));
				if (screenContentControl != null)
				{
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellMainWindow>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>())?.CloseScreen(screenContentControl);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ShowOrActivateScreen(IUnityContainer container, string screenFactoryKey)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(screenFactoryKey))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Parameter screenFactoryKey cannot be null or empty.");
			}
			IShellApplication shellApplication = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellApplication>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (shellApplication != null && shellApplication.ActiveWindow != null)
			{
				ScreenContentControl screenContentControl = shellApplication.ActiveWindow.FindScreen((ScreenContentControl x) => string.Equals(x.ScreenFactoryKey, screenFactoryKey, StringComparison.InvariantCulture));
				if (screenContentControl != null)

				shellApplication.ActiveWindow.ShowScreen(new ShowScreenEventArgs

					CreateNewTab = true
				});
			}
		}

		private int? GetFirstIndex(List<CompositeCurvePoint> data, double Ent, double Temp)
		{
			double num = Math.Round(Ent, 2);
			double num2 = Math.Round(Temp, 2);
			double num3 = 0.05;
			int? result = null;
			int count = data.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (i + 1 >= count)
				{
					continue;
				}
				double num4 = Math.Round(data[i].Enthalpy, 2);
				double num5 = Math.Round(data[i].Temperature, 2);
				double num6 = Math.Round(data[i + 1].Enthalpy, 2);
				double num7 = Math.Round(data[i + 1].Temperature, 2);
				if ((1.0 + num3) * num4 >= num && num >= (1.0 - num3) * num6)
				{
					if ((1.0 + num3) * num5 >= num2 && num2 >= (1.0 - num3) * num7)
					{
						result = i;
						break;
					}
					if ((1.0 + num3) * num7 >= num2 && num2 >= (1.0 - num3) * num5)
					{
						result = i;
						break;
					}
				}
				else if ((1.0 + num3) * num6 >= num && num >= (1.0 - num3) * num4)
				{
					if ((1.0 + num3) * num5 >= num2 && num2 >= (1.0 - num3) * num7)
					{
						result = i;
						break;
					}
					if ((1.0 + num3) * num7 >= num2 && num2 >= (1.0 - num3) * num5)
					{
						result = i;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

	public static class CompositeCurveUtilities
	{
		public static List<CompositeCurvePoint> LocatePintchPointsBetweenCurves(PinchListViewModel pinchListViewModel, List<CompositeCurvePoint> HotPoints, List<CompositeCurvePoint> ColdPoints)
		{
			List<CompositeCurvePoint> list = new List<CompositeCurvePoint>();
			List<CompositeCurvePoint> list2 = new List<CompositeCurvePoint>();
			List<CompositeCurvePoint> list3 = new List<CompositeCurvePoint>();
			if (pinchListViewModel.PinchListView != null && pinchListViewModel.PinchListView.PinchPoints != null)
			{
				foreach (PinchPoint pinchPoint in pinchListViewModel.PinchListView.PinchPoints)
				{
					double? num = FindPintchPointEnthalpy(pinchPoint.HotTemp, HotPoints);
					double? num2 = FindPintchPointEnthalpy(pinchPoint.ColdTemp, ColdPoints);
					if (num.HasValue && num2.HasValue)
					{
						list2.Add(new CompositeCurvePoint
						{
							Enthalpy = num.Value,
							Temperature = pinchPoint.HotTemp
						});
						list3.Add(new CompositeCurvePoint
						{
							Enthalpy = num2.Value,
							Temperature = pinchPoint.ColdTemp
						});
					}
				}
				if (list2.Count == list3.Count)
				{
					double num3 = double.MaxValue;
					int num4 = -1;
					for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
					{
						double num5 = Math.Abs(list2[i].Enthalpy - list3[i].Enthalpy);
						if (num3 > num5)
						{
							num4 = i;
							num3 = num5;
						}
					}
					if (num4 >= 0)
					{
						list.Add(new CompositeCurvePoint
						{
							Enthalpy = list2[num4].Enthalpy,
							Temperature = list2[num4].Temperature
						});
						list.Add(new CompositeCurvePoint
						{
							Enthalpy = list3[num4].Enthalpy,
							Temperature = list3[num4].Temperature
						});
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count != 2)
			{
				return new List<CompositeCurvePoint>();
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static double? FindPintchPointEnthalpy(double PinchtPointTemp, IList<CompositeCurvePoint> Points)
		{
			double? result = null;
			var anon = (from pair in Points.Zip(Points.Skip(1), (CompositeCurvePoint a, CompositeCurvePoint b) => new
				{
					FirtsPoint = a,
					SecondPoint = b
				})
				where (pair.FirtsPoint.Temperature <= PinchtPointTemp && pair.SecondPoint.Temperature >= PinchtPointTemp) || (pair.FirtsPoint.Temperature >= PinchtPointTemp && pair.SecondPoint.Temperature <= PinchtPointTemp)
				select pair).FirstOrDefault();
			if (anon != null)
			{
				return Interpolation(PinchtPointTemp, anon.FirtsPoint.Enthalpy, anon.FirtsPoint.Temperature, anon.SecondPoint.Enthalpy, anon.SecondPoint.Temperature);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static double? Interpolation(double Y, double X1, double Y1, double X2, double Y2)
		{
			double? result = null;
			if (Y1 != Y2)
			{
				double num = (Y2 - Y1) / (X2 - X1);
				result = X1 + (Y - Y1) / num;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		private static Regex _maskDoubleRegex;

		private SubscriptionToken _token;

		internal XamDataGrid xdg;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public static Regex validDoubleRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (_validDoubleRegex == null)
				{
					_validDoubleRegex = new Regex("^$|^[+-]?\\d*(\\.\\d*)?([Ee][+-]?\\d+)?$");
				}
				return _validDoubleRegex;
			}
		}

		public static Regex maskDoubleRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (_maskDoubleRegex == null)
				{
					_maskDoubleRegex = new Regex("^[+-]?\\d*(\\.)?\\d*([eE][+-]?\\d*)?$");
				}
				return _maskDoubleRegex;
			}
		}

		public Landing_Utilities()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			((DataPresenterBase)xdg).DataSource = new object[1] { "" };
			((DataPresenterBase)xdg).FieldSettings.SortComparer = new UtilityCompare();
			syncContext = SynchronizationContext.Current;
			if (base.Variable == null)
			{
				base.Variable = new DataVariable
				{
					ProjectKey = "Project 1"
				};
			}
		}

		public static string GetSystemDecimalSymbol()
		{
			return 0.1.ToString().Replace("0", string.Empty).Replace("1", string.Empty);
		}

		public static bool maskDoubleValue(string testString, int MaxLength)
		{
			testString = testString.Replace(GetSystemDecimalSymbol(), ".");
			if (!maskDoubleRegex.IsMatch(testString) || (MaxLength != 0 && testString.Length > MaxLength))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(testString) && (testString.Contains("e") || testString.Contains("E")))
			{
				if (double.TryParse(testString, out var result))
				{
					if (result < -1E+300 || result > 1E+300)
					{
						return false;
					}
					int num = result.ToString().IndexOf("e", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
					if (num > -1 && num > 0 && int.TryParse(result.ToString().Substring(num + 1), out var result2) && (result2 < -300 || result2 > 300))
					{
						return false;
					}
					num = testString.IndexOf("e", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
					if (result == 0.0 && double.TryParse(testString.Substring(0, num), out var result3) && result3 != 0.0)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!double.TryParse(testString, out result) && validDoubleRegex.IsMatch(testString))
				{
					int num2 = testString.IndexOf("e", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
					if (num2 > -1 && int.TryParse(testString.Substring(num2 + 1), out var result4) && result4 >= -300 && result4 <= 300)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

			syncContext = SynchronizationContext.Current;
			if (base.Variable == null)
			{
				base.Variable = new DataVariable
				{
					ProjectKey = "Project 1"
				};
			}
			if (_token != null)
			{
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<DataSourceChangedEvent>().Unsubscribe(_token);
			}
			_token = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<DataSourceChangedEvent>().Subscribe(delegate
			{
				landing_Utilities.Dispatcher.Invoke(delegate
				{
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Publish(new WorkflowControlStateArgs
					{

						ControlType = WorkflowControl.ModifyHeatExchanger_ProcessBar
					});
					landing_Utilities.UpdateUtilityTable();
				});
			}, ThreadOption.BackgroundThread, keepSubscriberReferenceAlive: true, (DataSourceChangedEventArgs filter) => filter.SourceType == DataSourceTypeEnum.UtilityView);
			base.HelpId = 13100;
			base.Loaded += Landing_Utilities_Loaded;
		}

		protected override void OnUnityContainerChanged(IUnityContainer oldValue, IUnityContainer newValue)
		{
			base.OnUnityContainerChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());

				{
					energyAnalysisAgent.AnalysisCompleteEvent += agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent;
				}
			}
		}

		public void UnRegisterEvents()

				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());

				}
			}

			{
				landingFormGridResource.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void xdg_Sorting(object sender, SortingEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0066: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ListSortDirection num = ((e.FieldLayout.SortedFields.Count > 0) ? e.FieldLayout.SortedFields[0].Direction : ListSortDirection.Ascending);
			e.FieldLayout.SortedFields.Clear();
			if (num == ListSortDirection.Descending)
			{
				e.FieldLayout.SortedFields.Add(new FieldSortDescription
				{
					FieldName = "sortField",
					Direction = ListSortDirection.Ascending
				});
			}
			else
			{
				e.FieldLayout.SortedFields.Add(new FieldSortDescription
				{
					FieldName = "sortField",
					Direction = ListSortDirection.Descending
				});
			}
			((CancelableRoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
		}

		private static void SwitchTwoCellValueHolders(CellValueHolder c1, CellValueHolder c2)
		{
			object value = c1.Value;
			bool isDisplayText = c1.IsDisplayText;
			c1.Value = c2.Value;
			c1.IsDisplayText = c2.IsDisplayText;
			c2.Value = value;
			c2.IsDisplayText = isDisplayText;
		}

		private void CellValuePresenter_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			CellValuePresenter val = (CellValuePresenter)((sender is CellValuePresenter) ? sender : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ValueEditor editor = ((ValuePresenter)(object)val).Editor;
			if (editor != null && !editor.IsReadOnly && Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(editor, typeof(TextBox), allowSubclassOfType: false) is TextBox textBox)
			{
				string empty = string.Empty;
				empty = ((e.Text == " ") ? GetPreviewInputStringWhenAddText(textBox, " ") : ((!(e.Text == ".")) ? GetPreviewInputStringWhenAddText(textBox, e.Text) : GetPreviewInputStringWhenAddText(textBox, GetSystemDecimalSymbol())));
				if (!maskDoubleValue(empty, 0))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				else if (e.Text == ".")
				{
					textBox.Text = empty;
					textBox.SelectionStart = empty.Length;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public static string GetPreviewInputStringWhenAddText(TextBox tb, string previewAddingText)
		{
			string text = tb.Text;
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (text != null)
			{
				int selectionStart = tb.SelectionStart;
				selectionStart = ((selectionStart > text.Length) ? text.Length : selectionStart);
				int selectionLength = tb.SelectionLength;
				int num = selectionStart + selectionLength;
				num = ((num > tb.Text.Length) ? tb.Text.Length : num);
				string obj = ((selectionStart == 0) ? string.Empty : text.Substring(0, selectionStart));
				string text2 = ((num >= text.Length) ? string.Empty : text.Substring(selectionStart + selectionLength));
				return obj + previewAddingText + text2;
			}
			return previewAddingText;
		}

		private void xdg_EditModeEnded(object sender, EditModeEndedEventArgs e)
		{
			Cell cell = ((EditModeEventArgs)e).Cell;
			if (cell == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Field field = cell.Field;
			if (field != null && ((FieldItem)field).Name == "DeltaT")
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					energyAnalysisAgent.ShowDashboardResults();
					energyAnalysisAgent.RaiseAnalysisComplete(EAOperations.UpdateView);
				}
			}
		}

		public void InitializeStreams()
		{
			HYSYSParameters hYSYSParameters = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (hYSYSParameters == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_isHYSYS = ((string.Equals(hYSYSParameters.SimulatorName, "aspenplus") || hYSYSParameters.EnergyStreams == null) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			bool flag = false;
			if (hYSYSParameters.EnergyStreams != null)
			{
				_streams.Clear();
				foreach (HYSYSEnergyStream energyStream in hYSYSParameters.EnergyStreams)
				{
					_streams.Add(energyStream);
					if (!flag && string.IsNullOrEmpty(energyStream.UtilityName))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<WindowStatusEvent>().Publish(new WindowStatusArgs
			{
				StatusLevel = ((!flag) ? 1 : 3),
				StatusText = (flag ? UIResources.EnergyStreamUnmappedStatus : UIResources.EnergyStreamMappedStatus)
			});
		}

		public void UpdateDisplaySourceWithEnergyStream(string flowsheetName, bool isDisplay, bool fsChanged)
		{
			if (fsChanged)
			{
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).topologyChanged = true;
				string hYSYSFile = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).HYSYSFile;
				if (string.Equals(UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).SimulatorName, "aspenplus") && base.Container.Parent != null)
				{
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IApplicationWrapper>(base.Container.Parent, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ResetTopologyFlaginSimulator(hYSYSFile, topologyFlag: true);
				}
				else
				{
					try
					{
						UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IApplicationWrapper>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ResetTopologyFlaginSimulator(hYSYSFile, topologyFlag: true);
					}
					catch (ResolutionFailedException)
					{
						UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IApplicationWrapper>(base.Container.Parent, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ResetTopologyFlaginSimulator(hYSYSFile, topologyFlag: true);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (HYSYSEnergyStream stream in _streams)
			{
				if (string.Compare(stream.FlowSheetName, flowsheetName) == 0 && stream.IsDisplay != isDisplay)
				{
					stream.IsDisplay = isDisplay;
					if (!IsFormLoading && base.Container != null)
					{
						UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>())?.UpdateDashboardStatus(new UpdateDashboardStatusArgs
						{
							Mode = StatusControlDisplayMode.TextWithWarning,
							Hint = "ConfigurationChanged"
						});
					}
				}
			}
			string path = DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_Flowsheets, (base.Key != null) ? base.Key : "Project 1");
			Dictionary<string, string> value = GetValue(path);
			string text = "";
			if (value != null)
			{
				using Dictionary<string, string>.Enumerator enumerator2 = value.GetEnumerator();
				if (enumerator2.MoveNext())
				{
					text = enumerator2.Current.Value;
				}
			}
			List<string[]> list = new List<string[]>();
			string[] array = text.Split('|');
			foreach (string text2 in array)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					string[] item = text2.Split(',');
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (list.Count > 1)
			{
				foreach (string[] item2 in list)
				{
					if (item2[0] == flowsheetName)
					{
						item2[1] = (isDisplay ? "1" : "0");
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				list.Add(new string[2]
				{
					flowsheetName,
					isDisplay ? "1" : "0"
				});
			}
			string text3 = "";
			foreach (string[] item3 in list)
			{
				if (item3.Count() > 1)
				{
					text3 += $"{item3[0]},{item3[1]}|";
				}
			}
			SetValue(path, text3.Substring(0, text3.Length - 1));
			UpdateForm();
		}

		public void SetControlStatus()
		{
			IEnumerable<HYSYSEnergyStream> source = _streams.Where((HYSYSEnergyStream item) => item.IsDisplay);
			HYSYSEnergyStream hYSYSEnergyStream = source.FirstOrDefault((HYSYSEnergyStream item) => string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.UtilityName));
			bool flag = source.Count() > 0 && hYSYSEnergyStream == null;
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<WindowStatusEvent>().Publish(new WindowStatusArgs
			{
				StatusLevel = (flag ? 1 : 3),
				StatusText = (flag ? UIResources.EnergyStreamMappedStatus : UIResources.EnergyStreamUnmappedStatus)
			});
		}

		private void SyncUpStream(bool withForce = false)
		{
			if (!withForce && !_streamsHaveChanged && _streams.Count != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = null;
			HYSYSParameters hYSYSParameters = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			IHostApplicationInfoMessenger hostApplicationInfoMessenger = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfoMessenger>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (hostApplicationInfoMessenger == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (hYSYSParameters != null)
			{
				if (!withForce && !_streamsHaveChanged && (hYSYSParameters.EnergyStreams == null || hYSYSParameters.EnergyStreams.Count() == 0))
				{
					return;
				}
				text = hostApplicationInfoMessenger.CurrentDocumentPath;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					text = hYSYSParameters.HYSYSFile;
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<SimulatorApplicationWrapper>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>())?.AppWrapStart(text, flag: false);
				InitializeStreams();
				bool isFormLoading = IsFormLoading;
				IsFormLoading = true;
				FlowsheetDataSource.ResolveFlowSheets(new DataVariable
				{
					ProjectKey = "Project 1"
				}, base.Container, AllEnergyStreams, InitializeStreams, UpdateDisplaySourceWithEnergyStream);
				IsFormLoading = isFormLoading;
				OnPropertyChanged("EnergyStreams");
				_streamsHaveChanged = false;
			}
		}

		private void processtypeExcute(bool processChange = false)
		{
			Dictionary<string, string> tmp = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_ProcessType, (base.Key != null) ? base.Key : "Project 1"));
			if (tmp != null)
			{
				UpdateProcessTypeAreaUI(_processTypeModel.FirstOrDefault((ComboxItemData item) => string.Compare(tmp.First().Value, item?.Item) == 0), processChange);
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UpdateFormEvent>().Publish(new UpdateFormArgs
				{
					SpecifiedParas = new object[4] { "DetaTMinTip", "DetaTMinTipVisible", "GlobalMinDetaTemperature", "CarbonFee" }
				});
			}
		}

		public ComboxItemData GetSelectedProcesstype()

			Dictionary<string, string> tmp = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_ProcessType, (base.Key != null) ? base.Key : "Project 1"));
			if (tmp == null)

			}
			return _processTypeModel.FirstOrDefault((ComboxItemData item) => string.Compare(tmp.First().Value, item?.Item) == 0);
		}

		private void UpdateProcessTypeAreaUI(ComboxItemData dataItem, bool processChange = false)
		{
			if (dataItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool num = string.Compare(UIResources.SubflowsheetSelection_ProcessType_Content_UserSpecified, dataItem.Item, ignoreCase: true) == 0 || string.Compare(dataItem.Item, UIResources.SubflowsheetSelection_ProcessTypeDropdownDefault, ignoreCase: true) == 0;
			string value = string.Empty;
			ApproachTempTip = null;
			if (!num)
			{
				string text = dataItem.ToolTip;
				string[] array = dataItem.ToolTip.Split(' ');
				IValueUnit valueUnit = UnitValueFactory.Create(UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).SimulatorName);
				if (array != null && valueUnit != null && double.TryParse(array[0], out var result))
				{
					result = Convert.ToDouble(array[0], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					string arg = ((double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(result, PropertyEnum.DeltaTemperature)).ToString("F1");
					if (array.Length > 2 && double.TryParse(array[2], out var result2))
					{
						result2 = Convert.ToDouble(array[2], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						string arg2 = ((double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(result2, PropertyEnum.DeltaTemperature)).ToString("F1");
						text = $"{arg} - {arg2} {SystemUnit_Label.Instance.TempUserUnit}";
					}
					else
					{
						text = $"{arg} {SystemUnit_Label.Instance.TempUserUnit}";
					}
				}
				value = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, UIResources.TypicalDTMinPrefix + text, dataItem.Item.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
				string arg3 = ((double)(object)valueUnit.Convert(dataItem.Value, PropertyEnum.DeltaTemperature)).ToString("F1");
				ApproachTempTip = string.Format(UIResources.ApproachTempTip, arg3, SystemUnit_Label.Instance.TempUserUnit, dataItem.Item);
			}
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Publish(new WorkflowControlStateArgs
			{
				ControlType = WorkflowControl.Tranfer,
				State = true
			});
			double num2 = 10.0;
			if (!processChange)
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> value2 = GetValue(DataMoniker.BuildMoniker(DataMonikerType.Constraint_GlobalDTmin, (base.Key != null) ? base.Key : "Project 1"));
				if (value2 != null)
				{
					num2 = Convert.ToDouble(value2.First().Value.ToString(), CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(num2) && num2 > 0.0)
				{
					dataItem.Value = num2;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = 10.0;
				}
			}

	public class EACTreeNode : SimpleNavigatorTreeNode
	{
		protected bool? HasDeleteOption;

		protected FormCategory _category = FormCategory.UnKnow;

		protected int _ownedRetrofitIndex = -1;

		protected bool _isNeedToPublished = true;

		private bool _hasDeleteOption
		{
			get
			{
				if (_category == FormCategory.Project)
				{
					if (base.Key == "Project 1")
					{
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (!HasDeleteOption.HasValue)
				{
					if (_category != FormCategory.SavingPotentials && _category != FormCategory.Setup)
					{
						return _category != FormCategory.Project;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return HasDeleteOption.Value;
			}
		}

		public FormCategory NodeForm
		{
			get
			{
				return _category;
			}
			set
			{
				_category = value;
			}
		}

		public int OwnedRetorfitIndex => _ownedRetrofitIndex;

		public string SpecialFlag { get; set; }

		public string TextFormat { get; set; }

		public string HeaderData { get; set; }

		public override void OnContextMenuOpening(ContextMenuEventArgs e, ContextMenu contextMenuToShow)
		{
			if (NodeForm == FormCategory.ResultComparison)
			{
				IEnumerable<MenuItem> enumerable = contextMenuToShow.Items.OfType<MenuItem>();
				if (enumerable != null)
				{
					MenuItem menuItem = enumerable.FirstOrDefault((MenuItem p) => p.Header != null && p.Header.ToString().ToLower() == "open in new tab");
					if (menuItem != null)
					{
						contextMenuToShow.Items.Remove(menuItem);
					}
				}
			}
			if (_hasDeleteOption)
			{
				MenuItem menuItem2 = new MenuItem();
				menuItem2.Header = UIResources.NavigationTreeView_NodeMenu_DeleteTitle;
				menuItem2.Click += delegate
				{
					if ((NodeForm != FormCategory.Project || UITreeNodeHelper.ConfirmDeleteProject()) && (NodeForm != FormCategory.Scenario || UITreeNodeHelper.ConfirmDeleteScenario()))
					{
						if (base.EventAggregator == null)
						{
							base.EventAggregator = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
						}
						if (_category == FormCategory.RelocateE108 || _category == FormCategory.AddNewE400 || _category == FormCategory.ModifyHeatExchanger || _category == FormCategory.Scenario || new Regex("Scenario\\((\\d+)\\)$").IsMatch(base.Key))
						{
							string text = new Regex("Scenario\\((\\d+)\\)").Match(base.Key).Groups[1].Value + " Scenario";
							base.EventAggregator.GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Publish(new WorkflowControlStateArgs
							{
								ControlType = WorkflowControl.ClearCachedData,
								State = new object[3] { text, _category, _ownedRetrofitIndex }
							});
							if (_category == FormCategory.Scenario)
							{
								base.EventAggregator.GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Publish(new WorkflowControlStateArgs
								{
									ControlType = WorkflowControl.NavigationTree,
									State = new object[2] { base.Key, "ScenarioNumber:-1" }
								});
							}
						}
						base.EventAggregator.GetEvent<UpdateTreeEvent>().Publish(new UpdateTreeEventArgs
						{
							Action = OperationEnum.Delete,
							State = base.Key,
							Category = _category
						});
						base.EventAggregator.GetEvent<UITreeNodeSelectionEvent>().Publish(new UITreeNodeSelectionArgs
						{
							NodeKey = base.Key,
							State = new object[3]
							{
								true,
								OperationEnum.Delete,
								_ownedRetrofitIndex.ToString()
							}
						});
					}
				};
				contextMenuToShow.Items.Add(menuItem2);
			}
			base.EventAggregator.GetEvent<RoutedCompositePresentationEvent<KeyValuePair<string, object>>>().Publish(new KeyValuePair<string, object>("NavigatorTreeNodeContextMenuEventKey", new object[2] { this, contextMenuToShow }));
			base.OnContextMenuOpening(e, contextMenuToShow);
		}

		protected override void OnIsSelectedChanged()
		{
			if (IsSelected && base.EventAggregator != null)
			{
				if (_category == FormCategory.Project)
				{
					if (!MMViewModelContainer.bIsBackground)
					{
						IsSelected = false;
						Children[0].IsSelected = true;
					}
					return;
				}
				OnSelected();
			}
			base.OnIsSelectedChanged();
		}

		public override bool ExpandToScreen(ScreenContentControl screen)
		{
			bool num = base.ExpandToScreen(screen);
			if (num && IsSelected)
			{
				OnSelected();
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelected()
		{
			if (_category != FormCategory.UnKnow && _isNeedToPublished)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				if (_category == FormCategory.Scenario && (Children.Count == 0 || (Children.Count == 1 && ((EACTreeNode)Children[0]).NodeForm == FormCategory.ModifyHeatExchanger)))
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				base.EventAggregator.GetEvent<UITreeNodeSelectionEvent>().Publish(new UITreeNodeSelectionArgs
				{
					NodeKey = (base.Key ?? string.Empty),
					State = new object[4]
					{
						false,
						_category,
						_category == FormCategory.Scenario && Children.Count() > 0,
						flag
					}
				});
			}
		}

		public void OnSelectedWithoutSideEffects()
		{
			if (_category != FormCategory.Project)
			{
				SetSelectedWithoutSideEffects(value: true);
				OnSelected();
			}
			else if (Children.Count != 0)
			{
				Children[0].SetSelectedWithoutSideEffects(value: true);
				((EACTreeNode)Children[0]).OnSelected();
			}
		}

		public static bool HasChildNodeSelected(NavigatorTreeNode parentNode)
		{
			if (parentNode == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parentNode.IsSelected)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (parentNode.Children != null && parentNode.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (NavigatorTreeNode child in parentNode.Children)
				{
					if (child.IsSelected)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (HasChildNodeSelected(child))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class EACRetrofitTreeNode : EACTreeNode
	{
		private SubscriptionToken _updateHeaderToken;

		private int _parentRetrofitsCounter = 1;

		public int ParentNodeRetrofitsCounter
		{
			get
			{
				return _parentRetrofitsCounter;
			}
			set
			{
				_parentRetrofitsCounter = value;
				HasDeleteOption = value <= _ownedRetrofitIndex;
			}
		}

		public EACRetrofitTreeNode(IUnityContainer container = null, string scenarioAndretrofitMixString = null)
		{
			EACRetrofitTreeNode eACRetrofitTreeNode = this;
			if (container == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEventAggregator evtAgg = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (evtAgg == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_updateHeaderToken = evtAgg.GetEvent<UITreeNodeEvent>().Subscribe(delegate(UITreeNodeArgs e)
			{
				IList<object> list = e.State as IList<object>;
				if (eACRetrofitTreeNode._category == (FormCategory)list[0] && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(eACRetrofitTreeNode.Text) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(eACRetrofitTreeNode.Text))
				{
					eACRetrofitTreeNode.Key = eACRetrofitTreeNode.Key + " " + e.NodeText;
					eACRetrofitTreeNode.Text = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, eACRetrofitTreeNode.TextFormat, e.NodeText);
					((UIScreenSubject)eACRetrofitTreeNode.ScreenSubject).Header = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0} - {1}", eACRetrofitTreeNode.HeaderData, eACRetrofitTreeNode.Text);
					eACRetrofitTreeNode.OnIsSelectedChanged();
					if (eACRetrofitTreeNode._updateHeaderToken != null)
					{
						evtAgg.GetEvent<UITreeNodeEvent>().Unsubscribe(eACRetrofitTreeNode._updateHeaderToken);
					}
					eACRetrofitTreeNode._updateHeaderToken = null;
				}
			}, ThreadOption.UIThread, keepSubscriberReferenceAlive: true, delegate(UITreeNodeArgs arg)
			{
				IList<object> list = arg.State as IList<object>;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(scenarioAndretrofitMixString) || list == null || list.Count < 3)
				{
					return false;
				}
				string[] array2 = scenarioAndretrofitMixString.Split('.');
				if (array2.Length < 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (string.Compare(array2[1], (list[2] ?? string.Empty).ToString(), StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) != 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				string value = new Regex("(\\d+)\\s*Scenario").Match((list[1] ?? string.Empty).ToString()).Groups[1].Value;
				return new Regex("Scenario\\s*\\(" + value + "\\s*\\)").IsMatch(eACRetrofitTreeNode.Key);
			});
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(scenarioAndretrofitMixString))
			{
				string[] array = scenarioAndretrofitMixString.Split('.');
				if (array.Length >= 2)
				{
					int.TryParse(array[1], out _ownedRetrofitIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsSelectedChanged()
		{
			if (base.EventAggregator != null)
			{
				if (IsSelected)
				{
					OnSelected();
				}
				base.OnIsSelectedChanged();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSelected()
		{
			base.EventAggregator.GetEvent<UITreeNodeSelectionEvent>().Publish(new UITreeNodeSelectionArgs
			{
				NodeKey = (base.Key ?? string.Empty),
				State = new object[4]
				{
					false,
					_category,
					true,
					_parentRetrofitsCounter > _ownedRetrofitIndex
				}
			});
			_isNeedToPublished = false;
			base.OnSelected();
		}
	}

		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			try
			{
				if (values.Length < 2)
				{
					return false;

				{
					return false;
				}
				if (parameter == null || !double.TryParse(parameter.ToString(), out var result3))
				{
					result3 = 0.0001;
				}
				return Math.Abs(result - result2) <= result3;
			}
			catch (NullReferenceException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

	internal class UtilityCompare : IComparer
	{
		public int Compare(object x, object y)
		{
			UtilityInformationView utilityInformationView = x as UtilityInformationView;
			UtilityInformationView utilityInformationView2 = y as UtilityInformationView;
			if (utilityInformationView == null && utilityInformationView2 == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (utilityInformationView == null && utilityInformationView2 != null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (utilityInformationView != null && utilityInformationView2 == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (utilityInformationView.UtilityType == UtilityType.NONE)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (utilityInformationView2.UtilityType == UtilityType.NONE)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			double num = Convert.ToDouble(utilityInformationView.Current, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) - Convert.ToDouble(utilityInformationView2.Current, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}

	internal class DataItemTypeConvert : IValueConverter
	{
		private static Regex _regex = new Regex(string.Format("^(\\s*-?\\d+({1}\\d+)*((\\s*%)|{0}\\d+)?)$", NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo.NumberDecimalSeparator, NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo.NumberGroupSeparator), RegexOptions.Compiled);

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null || value == DBNull.Value || string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.ToString()))
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				float result;
				return (_regex.IsMatch(value.ToString()) || float.TryParse(value.ToString(), out result)) ? HorizontalAlignment.Right : HorizontalAlignment.Left;
			}
			catch
			{
				return HorizontalAlignment.Right;
			}
		}

	internal class BulbTipConvert : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			if (values.Length < 15 || string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)values[0]))
			{
				return "";
			}
			if ((double)values[5] == 1.0)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, UIResources.BulbTipConvert_EliminatingHeatingBelow, (string)values[7], SystemUnit_Label.Instance.EnthalpyUserUnit, values[14], SystemUnit_Label.Instance.TempUserUnit);
			}
			if ((double)values[3] == 1.0)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, UIResources.BulbTipConvert_IncreasingHotOutletTemperatureAbove, (string)values[8], (string)values[10], SystemUnit_Label.Instance.TempUserUnit);
			}
			if ((double)values[4] == 1.0)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, UIResources.BulbTipConvert_EliminatingCoolingAbove, (string)values[7], SystemUnit_Label.Instance.EnthalpyUserUnit, values[13], SystemUnit_Label.Instance.TempUserUnit);
			}
			if ((double)values[6] == 1.0)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, UIResources.BulbTipConvert_ReducingColdOutletTemperatureBelow, (string)values[9], (string)values[11], SystemUnit_Label.Instance.TempUserUnit);
			}
			if ((double)values[12] == 1.0)
			{
				return "It is inefficient to have a column operating across the pinch from the perspective@of thermodynamics. Process changes such as adjusting column pressure,@preheating feeds to the column, installing side heaters/coolers may help@to eliminiate this inefficiency and thus save energy".Replace("@", Environment.NewLine);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	internal class OverallUCalcMethodConvert : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			if (value is UMethodType)
			{
				return (UMethodType)value switch
				{
					UMethodType.NONE => "", 
					UMethodType.AEA => UIResources.HeatTransCoeffMethods_Default, 
					UMethodType.Simulation => UIResources.HeatTransCoeffMethods_Simulation, 
					UMethodType.UserSpec => UIResources.HeatTransCoeffMethods_User, 
					_ => "", 
				};
			}
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			if (value is string)
			{
				string text = (string)value;
				if (text.Equals(UIResources.HeatTransCoeffMethods_Default, StringComparison.CurrentCulture))
				{
					return UMethodType.AEA;
				}
				if (text.Equals(UIResources.HeatTransCoeffMethods_Simulation, StringComparison.CurrentCulture))
				{
					return UMethodType.Simulation;
				}
				if (text.Equals(UIResources.HeatTransCoeffMethods_User, StringComparison.CurrentCulture))
				{
					return UMethodType.UserSpec;
				}
				return UMethodType.NONE;
			}
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	internal class OverallUCalcMethodItemSourceConvert : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			IEnumerable<string> enumerable = value as IEnumerable<string>;
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			foreach (string item in enumerable)
			{
				if (item.Equals("Default", StringComparison.CurrentCulture))
				{
					list.Add(UIResources.HeatTransCoeffMethods_Default);
				}
				else if (item.Equals("Simulation", StringComparison.CurrentCulture))
				{
					list.Add(UIResources.HeatTransCoeffMethods_Simulation);
				}
				else if (item.Equals("User", StringComparison.CurrentCulture))
				{
					list.Add(UIResources.HeatTransCoeffMethods_User);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return list;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	[ValueConversion(typeof(Visibility), typeof(bool))]
	public class VisibilityToBooleanConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is Visibility)
			{
				return (Visibility)value == Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is bool)
			{
				return (!(bool)value) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return Visibility.Collapsed;
		}
	}

	public class EACFormFactory
	{
		public enum EACTreeNodeRibbonStatus
		{
			Initialized,
			Analyzed,
			SavePotentialsed
		}

		public class EACTreeNodeRibbonInfo
		{
			private EACTreeNodeRibbonStatus _status;

			private int _scenarioCount;

			public EACTreeNodeRibbonStatus Status
			{
				get
				{
					return _status;
				}
				set
				{
					_status = value;
				}
			}

			public int ScenarioCount
			{
				get
				{
					return _scenarioCount;
				}
				set
				{
					_scenarioCount = value;
				}
			}

			public EACTreeNodeRibbonInfo()
			{
				_status = EACTreeNodeRibbonStatus.Initialized;
			}
		}

		private static EACFormFactory _instance = null;

		private static object _synLock = new object();

		private static IDictionary<string, EACTreeNodeRibbonInfo> dctProjects = new Dictionary<string, EACTreeNodeRibbonInfo>();

		public static bool CanCompareProjects
		{
			get
			{
				if (dctProjects.Count > 1)
				{
					int num = 0;
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, EACTreeNodeRibbonInfo> dctProject in dctProjects)
					{
						if (dctProject.Value.Status != EACTreeNodeRibbonStatus.Initialized)
						{
							num++;
						}
					}
					return num > 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static int ProjectCount => dctProjects.Count;

		public static string[] ProjectKeys
		{
			get
			{
				if (dctProjects.Count > 1)
				{
					List<string> list = new List<string>();
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, EACTreeNodeRibbonInfo> dctProject in dctProjects)
					{
						if (dctProject.Value.Status != EACTreeNodeRibbonStatus.Initialized)
						{
							list.Add(dctProject.Key);
						}
					}
					return list.ToArray();
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static string[] AllProjectKeys
		{
			get
			{
				if (dctProjects.Count > 0)
				{
					List<string> list = new List<string>();
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, EACTreeNodeRibbonInfo> dctProject in dctProjects)
					{
						list.Add(dctProject.Key);
					}
					return list.ToArray();
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private EACFormFactory()
		{
		}

		public static EACFormFactory CreateInstance()
		{
			if (_instance == null)
			{
				lock (_synLock)
				{
					_instance = new EACFormFactory();
				}
			}
			return _instance;
		}

		public string GetFormKey(FormCategory category)
		{
			return category switch
			{
				FormCategory.Project => "Project", 
				FormCategory.Setup => "Setup", 
				FormCategory.SavingPotentials => "Saving Potentials", 
				FormCategory.Scenario => "Scenario", 
				FormCategory.Summary => "Summary", 
				FormCategory.ModifyHeatExchanger => "Modify Heat Exchangers", 
				FormCategory.RelocateE108 => "Relocate", 
				FormCategory.AddNewE400 => "Add New", 
				FormCategory.ResultComparison => "Result Comparison", 
				FormCategory.ProjectComparison => "Project Comparison", 
				FormCategory.Curves => "Curves", 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		public string GetFormText(FormCategory category)
		{
			switch (category)
			{
			case FormCategory.Project:
				return UIResources.NavigationTreeView_Project_Title;
			case FormCategory.Setup:
				return UIResources.NavigationTreeView_Project_Setup_Title;
			case FormCategory.SavingPotentials:
				return UIResources.NavigationTreeView_Project_SavingPotentail_Title;
			case FormCategory.Summary:
			case FormCategory.Scenario:
				return UIResources.NavigationTreeView_Project_Scenario_Title;
			case FormCategory.ModifyHeatExchanger:
				return UIResources.NavigationTreeView_Project_ModifyHeatExchanger_Title;
			case FormCategory.RelocateE108:
				return UIResources.NavigationTreeView_Project_RelocateHeatExchanger_Title;
			case FormCategory.AddNewE400:
				return UIResources.NavigationTreeView_Project_AddHeatExchanger_Title;
			case FormCategory.ResultComparison:
				return UIResources.NavigationTreeView_Project_Compare_Title;
			case FormCategory.ProjectComparison:
				return UIResources.NavigationTreeView_Project_Compare_Project_Title;
			default:
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public static void AddEACProjectTreeNode(string sName)
		{
			if (!dctProjects.ContainsKey(sName))
			{
				dctProjects.Add(sName, new EACTreeNodeRibbonInfo());
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveEACProjectTreeNode(string sName)
		{
			if (dctProjects.ContainsKey(sName))
			{
				dctProjects.Remove(sName);
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveAllProjectsOnClosing()
		{
			if (dctProjects != null && dctProjects.Count > 0)
			{
				dctProjects.Clear();
			}
		}

		public static EACTreeNodeRibbonInfo GetEACRibbonInfo(string sProject)
		{
			if (dctProjects.ContainsKey(sProject))
			{
				return dctProjects[sProject];
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class UIModule : IModule
	{
		[Dependency]
		public IUnityContainer Container { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		public IScreenFactoryCatalog ScreenFactoryCatalog { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		public ICommonShellViewRegistry ViewRegistry { get; set; }

		public virtual void Initialize()
		{
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0086: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ViewRegistry.RegisterViewWithRegion(CommonShellRegions.NavigatorRegion, typeof(UINavigtorView));
			ScreenFactoryCatalog.RegisterScreenFactory(ActivationCompositeFactory.Default);
			ScreenFactoryCatalog.RegisterScreenFactory(ActivationGrandFactory.Default);
			ScreenFactoryCatalog.RegisterScreenFactory(ActivationUtilityFactory.Default);
			ScreenFactoryCatalog.RegisterScreenFactory(UIPageScreen.Key, typeof(UIPageScreen));
			SimulatorApplicationWrapper simulatorApplicationWrapper = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<SimulatorApplicationWrapper>(Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			UnityContainerExtensions.RegisterInstance<SimulatorApplicationWrapper>(Container, simulatorApplicationWrapper, (LifetimeManager)new ContainerControlledLifetimeManager());
		}
	}
	public class UINavigtorView : TreeNavigatorView
	{
		public UINavigtorView(UINavigatorViewModel viewModel)
		{
			base.ViewModel = viewModel;
			base.Header = UIResources.ModuleTitle;
			base.Key = "Energy Analysis";
			base.LargeImage = UIResources.EnergyAnalysis32.ToImageSource();
			base.SmallImage = UIResources.EnergyAnalysis32.ToImageSource();
		}
	}
	public class UINavigatorViewModel : SimpleTreeNavigatorViewModel
	{
		private class ScreenSubjectAdapter
		{
			public static string ParseScreenSubjectKey(FormCategory category, string nodeKey, string screenSubjectKey)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(nodeKey) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(screenSubjectKey))
				{
					return screenSubjectKey;
				}
				switch (category)
				{
				case FormCategory.Setup:
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0}.{1}", nodeKey.Split('.')[0], screenSubjectKey);
				case FormCategory.SavingPotentials:
				case FormCategory.ModifyHeatExchanger:
				case FormCategory.Scenario:
					if (screenSubjectKey.IndexOf(nodeKey) >= 0)
					{
						return screenSubjectKey;
					}
					return nodeKey;
				case FormCategory.RelocateE108:
				case FormCategory.AddNewE400:
					if (screenSubjectKey.Split('.').Length <= 2)
					{
						return string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0}.{1}", nodeKey.Substring(0, nodeKey.LastIndexOf('.')), screenSubjectKey);
					}
					return screenSubjectKey;
				default:
					return screenSubjectKey;
				}
			}

			public static string ParseScreenSubjectHeader(string originalText, FormCategory category)
			{
				string[] array = ParseNumber(originalText);
				if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
				{
					return originalText;
				}
				switch (array.Length)
				{
				case 1:
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0} - {1}", string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(FormCategory.Project), array[0]), EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(category));
				case 2:
				{
					string text = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(FormCategory.Project), array[0]);
					string text2 = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(FormCategory.Scenario), array[1]);
					string[] array2 = originalText.Split(new string[1] { " - " }, StringSplitOptions.None);
					return (array2.Length == 2) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0} - {1}", text, text2) : originalText.Replace(array2[0], text).Replace(array2[1], text2);
				}
				default:
					return originalText;
				}
			}
		}

		public static int ProjectNumber = 1;

		private IUnityContainer mContainer;

		private static bool _isLoaded = false;

		private static string _SavedData = null;

		private string _xmlNamespace = string.Empty;

		private Regex _regx = new Regex("(\\(\\d+)\\)", RegexOptions.Compiled);

		private static Regex _numberRegex = new Regex("\\d+", RegexOptions.Compiled);

		[Dependency]
		public IEventAggregator EventAggregator { get; set; }

		public EACTreeNode CurrentProjectNode
		{
			get
			{
				EACTreeNode selectedNode = SelectedNode;
				if (selectedNode == null)
				{
					if (Children.Count > 0)
					{
						return Children[0] as EACTreeNode;
					}
					return null;
				}
				EACTreeNode eACTreeNode = null;
				string strB = selectedNode.Key.Split('.')[0];
				foreach (NavigatorTreeNode child in Children)
				{
					if (string.Compare(child.KeyReadOnly, strB, ignoreCase: true) == 0)
					{
						eACTreeNode = child as EACTreeNode;
						break;
					}
				}
				return eACTreeNode ?? (Children[0] as EACTreeNode);
			}
		}

		public EACTreeNode SelectedNode => GetSelectedNode(Children);

		public string SavedResult
		{
			get
			{
				return _SavedData;
			}
			set
			{
				_SavedData = value;
			}
		}

		public UINavigatorViewModel(IUnityContainer container)
		{
			mContainer = container.Parent;
			EventAggregator = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(container.Parent ?? container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (!_isLoaded)
			{
				_isLoaded = true;
				EventAggregator.GetEvent<UpdateTreeEvent>().Subscribe(UpdateTree);
			}
		}

		private void CreateDefaultTreeView(bool isSetupNodeSelected = true)
		{
			Children.Clear();
			ProjectNumber = 1;
			string text = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(FormCategory.Project), ProjectNumber);
			EACFormFactory.AddEACProjectTreeNode(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}", EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormKey(FormCategory.Project), ProjectNumber));
			Children.Add(new EACTreeNode
			{
				Text = text,
				UnityContainer = mContainer,
				EventAggregator = EventAggregator,
				ScreenFactoryKey = UIPageScreen.Key,
				ScreenSubject = new UIScreenSubject
				{
					Key = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}", EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormKey(FormCategory.Project), ProjectNumber),
					Header = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0} - {1}", text, EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(FormCategory.Setup))
				},
				Children = { (NavigatorTreeNode)new EACTreeNode
				{
					Text = EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(FormCategory.Setup),
					EventAggregator = EventAggregator,
					ScreenFactoryKey = UIPageScreen.Key,
					ScreenSubject = new UIScreenSubject
					{
