						Header = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0} - {1}", text, EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(FormCategory.Setup))
					},
					Key = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}.{2}", "Project", ProjectNumber, "Setup"),
					NodeForm = FormCategory.Setup,
					IsSelected = isSetupNodeSelected
				} },
				IsExpanded = true,
				Key = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}", "Project", ProjectNumber),
				NodeForm = FormCategory.Project,
				IsSelected = false
			});
		}

		private void UpdateTree(UpdateTreeEventArgs arg)
		{
			if (arg.Action == OperationEnum.UnKnow)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			string specialFlag = null;
			if (arg.State != null)
			{
				try
				{
					ThreadOption option = ThreadOption.PublisherThread;
					if (arg.State is object[])
					{
						object[] array = arg.State as object[];
						if (array.Length == 2 && array[1] != null)
						{
							ConvertParameterToThreadOption(array[0], ref option);
							specialFlag = array[1].ToString();
						}
					}
					else if (arg.State is ThreadOption)
					{
						option = (ThreadOption)arg.State;
					}
					flag = option == ThreadOption.BackgroundThread;
				}
				catch (InvalidCastException)
				{
				}
			}
			switch (arg.Action)
			{
			case OperationEnum.CreateDefault:
				CreateDefaultTreeView(!flag);
				break;
			case OperationEnum.Add:
				AddTreeNode(arg.Category, flag, specialFlag);
				break;
			case OperationEnum.Delete:
			{
				if (arg.Category == FormCategory.Project)
				{
					string[] array2 = ((arg.State == null || !(arg.State is string)) ? SelectedNode.Key.Split('.') : new string[1] { arg.State.ToString() });
					string sOldKey = CurrentProjectNode.Key;
					if (sOldKey == array2[0])
					{
						sOldKey = "Project 1";
					}
					EventAggregator.GetEvent<UITreeNodeSelectionEvent>().Publish(new UITreeNodeSelectionArgs
					{
						NodeKey = array2[0],
						State = new object[2]
						{
							true,
							OperationEnum.Delete
						}
					});
					DeleteTreeNodeByPath(array2[0]);
					EventAggregator.GetEvent<UITreeNodeSelectionEvent>().Publish(new UITreeNodeSelectionArgs
					{
						NodeKey = sOldKey,
						State = new object[1] { true }
					});
					if (CurrentProjectNode != null)
					{
						CurrentProjectNode.IsSelected = false;
						CurrentProjectNode.IsSelected = true;
					}
					Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
					{
						if (CurrentProjectNode != null)
						{
							LocationTreeNode(sOldKey);
						}
					}, DispatcherPriority.Input);
					break;
				}
				string sOldKey2 = ((SelectedNode == null) ? "Project 1" : SelectedNode.Key);
				DeleteTreeNode(arg);
				if (CurrentProjectNode != null)
				{
					CurrentProjectNode.IsSelected = false;
					CurrentProjectNode.IsSelected = true;
				}
				Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					if (CurrentProjectNode != null)
					{
						LocationTreeNode(sOldKey2);
					}
				}, DispatcherPriority.Input);
				break;
			}
			case OperationEnum.Restore:
				Load(arg.State);
				break;
			case OperationEnum.Location:
				LocationTreeNode((arg.State == null) ? string.Empty : arg.State.ToString());
				break;
			}
			UnityContainerExtensions.RegisterInstance<NavigatorTreeNodeCollection>(mContainer, Children);
			RefreshTree();
			if (arg.Action != OperationEnum.UnKnow)
			{
				Save();
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IDataResolver>(mContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>())?.Write("NavigationTree", SavedResult);
			}
		}

		private static bool ConvertParameterToThreadOption(object parameter, ref ThreadOption option)
		{
			if (parameter == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parameter is ThreadOption)
			{
				option = (ThreadOption)parameter;
				return true;
			}
			if (Enum.TryParse<ThreadOption>(parameter.ToString(), out option))
			{
				return true;
			}
			option = ThreadOption.BackgroundThread;
			return false;
		}

		private void LocationTreeNode(string nodeKey)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(nodeKey))
			{
				if (Children.Count == 0 || Children[0].Children.Count == 0)
				{
					CreateDefaultTreeView();
				}
				else if (!MMViewModelContainer.bIsBackground)
				{
					(SelectedNode ?? Children[0].Children[0]).IsSelected = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				EACTreeNode eACTreeNode = FindNode(nodeKey, Children);
				if (eACTreeNode != null && !MMViewModelContainer.bIsBackground)
				{
					eACTreeNode.IsSelected = false;
					eACTreeNode.IsSelected = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public EACTreeNode FindNode(string key, NavigatorTreeNodeCollection node)
		{
			foreach (EACTreeNode item in node)
			{
				if (string.Compare(item.Key, key) == 0)
				{
					return item;
				}
				if (key.StartsWith(item.Key) && item.Children != null && item.Children.Count > 0)
				{
					return FindNode(key, item.Children);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void AddTreeNode(FormCategory category, bool isBackground = false, string specialFlag = null)
		{
			if (category != FormCategory.Project && Children.Count == 0)
			{
				CreateDefaultTreeView(isSetupNodeSelected: false);
			}
			string formKey = EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormKey(category);
			string[] array = (SelectedNode ?? (Children[0] as SimpleNavigatorTreeNode)).Key.Split('.');
			switch (category)
			{
			case FormCategory.Project:
				AddProjectNode();
				break;
			case FormCategory.Setup:
			case FormCategory.SavingPotentials:
			case FormCategory.ResultComparison:
				AddProjectChildNode(category, isBackground);
				break;
			case FormCategory.ProjectComparison:
				AddProjectComparisonNode();
				break;
			case FormCategory.Scenario:
				AddScenarioNode(formKey, array[0], isBackground, specialFlag);
				break;
			case FormCategory.Summary:
			case FormCategory.ModifyHeatExchanger:
			case FormCategory.RelocateE108:
			case FormCategory.AddNewE400:
				AddScenarioChildNode(category, isBackground, specialFlag);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void AddProjectComparisonNode()
		{
			string navigationTreeView_Project_Compare_Project_Title = UIResources.NavigationTreeView_Project_Compare_Project_Title;
			string headerKey = EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormKey(FormCategory.ProjectComparison);
			IEnumerable<NavigatorTreeNode> source = Children.Where((NavigatorTreeNode tmp) => ((EACTreeNode)tmp).Key == headerKey);
			EACTreeNode eACTreeNode;
			if (source.Count() > 0)
			{
				eACTreeNode = source.First() as EACTreeNode;
			}
			else
			{
				EACFormFactory.AddEACProjectTreeNode(headerKey);
				eACTreeNode = new EACTreeNode
				{
					Text = navigationTreeView_Project_Compare_Project_Title,
					EventAggregator = EventAggregator,
					ScreenFactoryKey = UIPageScreen.Key,
					ScreenSubject = new UIScreenSubject
					{
						Key = headerKey,
						Header = UIResources.NavigationTreeView_Project_Compare_Project_Title
					},
					Key = headerKey,
					NodeForm = FormCategory.ProjectComparison
				};
				UnselectAllNode();
				eACTreeNode.SetSelectedWithoutSideEffects(value: true);
				Children.Add(eACTreeNode);
			}
			eACTreeNode.IsSelected = false;
			eACTreeNode.IsSelected = true;
		}

		private int GetProjectComparisonIndex(string sHead)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (EACTreeNode child in Children)
			{
				if (string.Compare(child.Key, sHead) == 1)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private void AddProjectNode()
		{
			int num = 1;
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			string[] allProjectKeys = EACFormFactory.AllProjectKeys;
			if (allProjectKeys != null)
			{
				string[] array = allProjectKeys;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					string[] array2 = array[i].Split(' ');
					if (array2.Length > 1 && int.TryParse(array2[array2.Length - 1], out var result))
					{
						list.Add(result);
					}
				}
				list.Sort();
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (int item in list)
				{
					if (num == item)
					{
						num++;
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num++;
			}
			string text = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(FormCategory.Project), num);
			string text2 = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}", EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormKey(FormCategory.Project), num);
			ProjectNumber++;
			EACFormFactory.AddEACProjectTreeNode(text2);
			EACTreeNode eACTreeNode = new EACTreeNode
			{
				Text = text,
				EventAggregator = EventAggregator,
				ScreenFactoryKey = UIPageScreen.Key,
				ScreenSubject = new UIScreenSubject
				{
					Key = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}", EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormKey(FormCategory.Project), num),
					Header = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0} - {1}", text, "Setup")
				},
				Key = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}", "Project", num),
				NodeForm = FormCategory.Project
			};
			UnselectAllNode();
			eACTreeNode.SetSelectedWithoutSideEffects(value: true);
			int projectComparisonIndex = GetProjectComparisonIndex(text2);
			if (projectComparisonIndex == -1)
			{
				Children.Add(eACTreeNode);
			}
			else
			{
				Children.Insert(projectComparisonIndex, eACTreeNode);
			}
			AddProjectChildNode(FormCategory.Setup);
		}

		private void AddProjectChildNode(FormCategory category, bool isBackground = false)
		{
			EACTreeNode currentProjectNode = CurrentProjectNode;
			string newNodeKey = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}.{1}", currentProjectNode.Key, EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormKey(category));
			IEnumerable<NavigatorTreeNode> source = currentProjectNode.Children.Where((NavigatorTreeNode tmp) => ((EACTreeNode)tmp).Key == newNodeKey);
			EACTreeNode eACTreeNode;
			if (source.Count() > 0)
			{
				eACTreeNode = source.First() as EACTreeNode;
			}
			else
			{
				eACTreeNode = new EACTreeNode
				{
					Text = EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(category),
					EventAggregator = EventAggregator,
					ScreenFactoryKey = UIPageScreen.Key,
					ScreenSubject = new UIScreenSubject
					{
						Key = newNodeKey,
						Header = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0} - {1}", currentProjectNode.Text, EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(category))
					},
					Key = newNodeKey,
					NodeForm = category
				};
				currentProjectNode.Children.Add(eACTreeNode);
			}
			if (isBackground)
			{
				UnselectAllNode();
				eACTreeNode.OnSelectedWithoutSideEffects();
				return;
			}
			if (SelectedNode != null && category == FormCategory.ResultComparison)
			{
				SelectedNode.SetSelectedWithoutSideEffects(value: false);
			}
			eACTreeNode.IsSelected = false;
			eACTreeNode.IsSelected = true;
		}

		private void PublishTreeNodeSelectionEvent(string nodeKey)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nodeKey))
			{
				EventAggregator.GetEvent<UITreeNodeSelectionEvent>().Publish(new UITreeNodeSelectionArgs
				{
					NodeKey = nodeKey
				});
			}
		}

		private void AddScenarioChildNode(FormCategory category, bool isBackground = false, string specialFlag = null)
		{
			EACTreeNode eACTreeNode = FindScenarioNode(isBackground, specialFlag);
			if (eACTreeNode == null)
			{
				eACTreeNode = AddScenarioNode(EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormKey(FormCategory.Scenario), (SelectedNode ?? ((EACTreeNode)Children[0])).Key.Split('.')[0], isBackground, specialFlag);
			}
			string formKey = EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormKey(category);
			string key = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}.{1}", eACTreeNode.Key, formKey);
			int num = eACTreeNode.Children.Count + 1;
			string text = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0}.{1}", formKey, num);
			eACTreeNode.Key.Split('.');
			string formText = EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(category);
			EACRetrofitTreeNode eACRetrofitTreeNode = new EACRetrofitTreeNode(mContainer, text)
			{
				TextFormat = formText,
				HeaderData = ((UIScreenSubject)eACTreeNode.ScreenSubject).Header,
				Text = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, formText, string.Empty),
				EventAggregator = EventAggregator,
				ScreenFactoryKey = UIPageScreen.Key,
				ScreenSubject = new UIScreenSubject
				{
					Key = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0}.{1}", eACTreeNode.Key, text),
					Header = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0} - {1}", ((UIScreenSubject)eACTreeNode.ScreenSubject).Header, string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, formText, string.Empty))
				},
				Key = key,
				NodeForm = category,
				ParentNodeRetrofitsCounter = num
			};
			foreach (EACRetrofitTreeNode child in eACTreeNode.Children)
			{
				child.ParentNodeRetrofitsCounter = num;
			}
			eACTreeNode.SetSelectedWithoutSideEffects(value: false);
			eACTreeNode.Children.Add(eACRetrofitTreeNode);
			if (isBackground)
			{
				UnselectAllNode();
				eACRetrofitTreeNode.OnSelectedWithoutSideEffects();
			}
			else
			{
				eACRetrofitTreeNode.IsSelected = true;
			}
			if (isBackground && specialFlag == "dashboard")
			{
				eACRetrofitTreeNode.IsSelected = false;
			}
		}

		private EACTreeNode FindScenarioNode(bool isBackground = false, string specialFlag = null)
		{
			bool flag = isBackground && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(specialFlag);
			EACTreeNode eACTreeNode = (flag ? ((EACTreeNode)Children[0]) : (SelectedNode ?? ((EACTreeNode)Children[0])));
			string[] array = eACTreeNode.Key.Split('.');
			if (array.Length == 1 || array.Length == 2)
			{
				if (array.Length == 2 && array[1].StartsWith("Scenario", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return eACTreeNode;
				}
				EACTreeNode eACTreeNode2 = FindNode(array[0], Children);
				for (int num = eACTreeNode2.Children.Count - 1; num > 0; num--)
				{
					EACTreeNode eACTreeNode3 = eACTreeNode2.Children[num] as EACTreeNode;
					if (eACTreeNode3.Key.StartsWith(eACTreeNode2.Key + ".Scenario", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) && flag && string.Compare(specialFlag, eACTreeNode3.SpecialFlag, ignoreCase: true) == 0)
					{
						return eACTreeNode3;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			return FindNode(array[0] + "." + array[1], Children);
		}

		private EACTreeNode AddScenarioNode(string pageKey, string projectNodePath, bool isBackground = false, string specialFlag = null)
		{
			EACTreeNode eACTreeNode = FindNode(projectNodePath, Children);
			int num = GenerateScenarioNumber(eACTreeNode);
			string key = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}.{1}({2})", projectNodePath, "Scenario", num);
			string text = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(FormCategory.Scenario), num);
			EACTreeNode eACTreeNode2 = new EACTreeNode
			{
				Text = text,
				EventAggregator = EventAggregator,
				ScreenFactoryKey = UIPageScreen.Key,
				ScreenSubject = new UIScreenSubject
				{
					Key = key,
					Header = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0} - {1}", eACTreeNode.Text, text)
				},
				Key = key,
				NodeForm = FormCategory.Scenario,
				SpecialFlag = specialFlag
			};
			eACTreeNode.Children.Insert(++num, eACTreeNode2);
			if (isBackground)
			{
				UnselectAllNode();
				eACTreeNode2.OnSelectedWithoutSideEffects();
			}
			else
			{
				eACTreeNode2.IsSelected = true;
			}
			return eACTreeNode2;
		}

		private void UnselectAllNode()
		{
			SelectedNode?.SetSelectedWithoutSideEffects(value: false);
		}

		private int GenerateScenarioNumber(EACTreeNode projectNode)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (EACTreeNode child in projectNode.Children)
			{
				if (child.Key.StartsWith(projectNode.Key + ".Scenario", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					MatchCollection matchCollection = _regx.Matches(child.Key);
					string value = matchCollection[matchCollection.Count - 1].Value;
					int num2 = Convert.ToInt32(_numberRegex.Match(value).Value);
					if (++num < num2)
					{
						return num;
					}
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return ++num;
		}

		private void DeleteTreeNode(UpdateTreeEventArgs arg)
		{
			bool isBackgroundThread = false;
			bool ignoreChildNodeToHXNet = arg.Category == FormCategory.Scenario;
			string text;
			if (arg.State == null)
			{
				EACTreeNode selectedNode = SelectedNode;
				if (selectedNode == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				text = selectedNode.Key;
				string[] array = text.Split('.');
				if (array.Length == 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (text.IndexOf(EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormKey(arg.Category)) < 0)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					foreach (EACTreeNode child in FindNode(array[0], Children).Children)
					{
						if (child.Key.IndexOf(EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormKey(arg.Category)) > 0)
						{
							text = child.Key;
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (arg.State is object[])
			{
				if (!(arg.State is object[] array2) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(array2[0] as string) || array2.Length < 2)
				{
					return;
				}
				isBackgroundThread = string.Compare("background", array2[0].ToString(), ignoreCase: true) == 0;
				ignoreChildNodeToHXNet = true;
				if (string.Compare("dashboard", array2[1].ToString(), ignoreCase: true) == 0)
				{
					DeleteTreeNodeByFlag(array2[1].ToString(), ignoreChildNodeToHXNet);
					return;
				}
				text = array2[1].ToString();
			}
			else
			{
				text = arg.State.ToString();
			}
			DeleteTreeNodeByPath(text, isBackgroundThread, ignoreChildNodeToHXNet);
		}

		private void DeleteTreeNodeByPath(string path, bool isBackgroundThread = false, bool ignoreChildNodeToHXNet = false)
		{
			if (path == "Project Comparison")
			{
				EACFormFactory.RemoveEACProjectTreeNode(path);
			}
			EACTreeNode eACTreeNode = ((path.LastIndexOf('.') == -1) ? null : FindNode(path.Remove(path.LastIndexOf('.')), Children));
			if (path.LastIndexOf('.') == -1 && path.StartsWith("Project"))
			{
				ProjectNumber = ((ProjectNumber <= 1) ? ProjectNumber : (--ProjectNumber));
				EACFormFactory.RemoveEACProjectTreeNode(path);
			}
			NavigatorTreeNodeCollection navigatorTreeNodeCollection = ((eACTreeNode == null) ? Children : eACTreeNode.Children);
			EACTreeNode eACTreeNode2 = FindNode(path, navigatorTreeNodeCollection);
			if (eACTreeNode2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ManualResetEvent manualResetEvent = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
			for (int num = eACTreeNode2.Children.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				EACTreeNode eACTreeNode3 = (EACTreeNode)eACTreeNode2.Children[num];
				if (eACTreeNode3.Children.Count > 0)
				{
					ManualResetEvent manualResetEvent2 = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
					for (int num2 = eACTreeNode3.Children.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
					{
						EACTreeNode eACTreeNode4 = (EACTreeNode)eACTreeNode3.Children[num2];
						UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(mContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UITreeNodeSelectionEvent>().Publish(new UITreeNodeSelectionArgs
						{
							NodeKey = eACTreeNode4.Key,
							State = new object[5]
							{
								true,
								OperationEnum.Delete,
								eACTreeNode4.OwnedRetorfitIndex.ToString(),
								ignoreChildNodeToHXNet,
								manualResetEvent2
							}
						});
						manualResetEvent2.WaitOne();
						manualResetEvent2.Reset();
					}
				}
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(mContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UITreeNodeSelectionEvent>().Publish(new UITreeNodeSelectionArgs
				{
					NodeKey = eACTreeNode3.Key,
					State = new object[5]
					{
						true,
						OperationEnum.Delete,
						eACTreeNode3.OwnedRetorfitIndex.ToString(),
						ignoreChildNodeToHXNet,
						manualResetEvent
					}
				});
				manualResetEvent.WaitOne();
				manualResetEvent.Reset();
			}
			navigatorTreeNodeCollection.Remove(eACTreeNode2);
			if (eACTreeNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (isBackgroundThread)
			{
				eACTreeNode.OnSelectedWithoutSideEffects();
			}
			else
			{
				eACTreeNode.IsSelected = true;
			}
			if (eACTreeNode.NodeForm != FormCategory.Scenario)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = eACTreeNode.Children.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (EACRetrofitTreeNode child in eACTreeNode.Children)
			{
				child.ParentNodeRetrofitsCounter = count;
			}
		}

		private void DeleteTreeNodeByFlag(string flag, bool ignoreChildNodeToHXNet = false)
		{
			NavigatorTreeNode navigatorTreeNode = Children[0];
			IEnumerable<NavigatorTreeNode> source = navigatorTreeNode.Children.Where((NavigatorTreeNode item) => string.Compare(flag, ((EACTreeNode)item).SpecialFlag, ignoreCase: true) == 0);
			for (int num = source.Count() - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (source.ElementAt(num) is EACTreeNode eACTreeNode)
				{
					DeleteTreeNodeByPath(eACTreeNode.Key, isBackgroundThread: true, ignoreChildNodeToHXNet);
					navigatorTreeNode.Children.Remove(eACTreeNode);
				}
			}
		}

		private EACTreeNode GetSelectedNode(NavigatorTreeNodeCollection nodeCollection)
		{
			foreach (EACTreeNode item in nodeCollection)
			{
				if (item.IsSelected)
				{
					return item;
				}
				if (item.Children != null && item.Children.Count > 0)
				{
					EACTreeNode selectedNode = GetSelectedNode(item.Children);
					if (selectedNode != null)
					{
						return selectedNode;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void RefreshTree()
		{
			OnPropertyChanged("Children");
		}

		private void Save()
		{
			using Stream stream = new MemoryStream();
			StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(stream);
			streamWriter.Write(SerilaizeChildren(Children));
			streamWriter.Flush();
			stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			_SavedData = new StreamReader(stream).ReadToEnd();
			stream.Close();
		}

		public void Load(object state)
		{
			if (state is object[] array && array.Length >= 2 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(array[1] as string))
			{
				bool isBackground = array[0] is bool && (bool)array[0];
				_SavedData = array[1] as string;
				Children.Clear();
				DeserializeChildren(_SavedData, isBackground);
				ProjectNumber = Children.Count;
			}
		}

		private string SerilaizeChildren(NavigatorTreeNodeCollection collection)
		{
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			XmlNode newChild = xmlDocument.CreateNode(XmlNodeType.XmlDeclaration, "", _xmlNamespace);
			XmlNode xmlNode = xmlDocument.CreateNode(XmlNodeType.Element, "Tree", _xmlNamespace);
			foreach (EACTreeNode child in Children)
			{
				XmlNode xmlNode2 = Serialize(xmlDocument, child);
				XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = xmlDocument.CreateAttribute("ScenarioNumber");
				xmlAttribute.Value = ((child.Children.Count > 2) ? (child.Children.Count - 2) : 0).ToString();
				xmlNode2.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute);
				foreach (EACTreeNode child2 in child.Children)
				{
					XmlNode xmlNode3 = Serialize(xmlDocument, child2);
					foreach (EACTreeNode child3 in child2.Children)
					{
						xmlNode3.AppendChild(Serialize(xmlDocument, child3));
					}
					xmlNode2.AppendChild(xmlNode3);
				}
				xmlNode.AppendChild(xmlNode2);
			}
			xmlDocument.AppendChild(newChild);
			xmlDocument.AppendChild(xmlNode);
			return xmlDocument.InnerXml;
		}

		private XmlNode Serialize(XmlDocument xmlDoc, EACTreeNode node)
		{
			XmlNode xmlNode = xmlDoc.CreateNode(XmlNodeType.Element, "EACTreeNode", _xmlNamespace);
			XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = xmlDoc.CreateAttribute("Key", _xmlNamespace);
			xmlAttribute.Value = node.Key;
			XmlAttribute xmlAttribute2 = xmlDoc.CreateAttribute("Text", _xmlNamespace);
			xmlAttribute2.Value = node.Text;
			XmlAttribute xmlAttribute3 = xmlDoc.CreateAttribute("ScreenFactoryKey", _xmlNamespace);
			xmlAttribute3.Value = node.ScreenFactoryKey;
			XmlAttribute xmlAttribute4 = xmlDoc.CreateAttribute("NodeForm", _xmlNamespace);
			xmlAttribute4.Value = node.NodeForm.ToString();
			XmlAttribute xmlAttribute5 = xmlDoc.CreateAttribute("IsSelected", _xmlNamespace);
			xmlAttribute5.Value = node.IsSelected.ToString();
			XmlAttribute xmlAttribute6 = xmlDoc.CreateAttribute("RetrofitIndex", _xmlNamespace);
			xmlAttribute6.Value = node.OwnedRetorfitIndex.ToString();
			XmlAttribute xmlAttribute7 = xmlDoc.CreateAttribute("Flag", _xmlNamespace);
			xmlAttribute7.Value = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(node.SpecialFlag) ? "0" : node.SpecialFlag);
			xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute);
			xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute2);
			xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute3);
			xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute4);
			xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute5);
			xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute6);
			xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute7);
			if (node is EACRetrofitTreeNode)
			{
				XmlAttribute xmlAttribute8 = xmlDoc.CreateAttribute("ParentNodeRetrofitsCounter", _xmlNamespace);
				xmlAttribute8.Value = (node as EACRetrofitTreeNode).ParentNodeRetrofitsCounter.ToString();
				xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute8);
			}
			XmlNode xmlNode2 = xmlDoc.CreateNode(XmlNodeType.Element, "UIScreenSubject", _xmlNamespace);
			if (node.ScreenSubject is UIScreenSubject { Key: not null, Header: not null })
			{
				XmlNode xmlNode3 = xmlDoc.CreateNode(XmlNodeType.Element, "Key", _xmlNamespace);
				xmlNode3.InnerText = ((UIScreenSubject)node.ScreenSubject).Key;
				XmlNode xmlNode4 = xmlDoc.CreateNode(XmlNodeType.Element, "Header", _xmlNamespace);
				xmlNode4.InnerText = ((UIScreenSubject)node.ScreenSubject).Header;
				xmlNode2.AppendChild(xmlNode3);
				xmlNode2.AppendChild(xmlNode4);
			}
			xmlNode.AppendChild(xmlNode2);
			return xmlNode;
		}

		private void DeserializeChildren(string xml, bool isBackground = false)
		{
			new NavigatorTreeNodeCollection();
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			try
			{
				xmlDocument.LoadXml(xml);
				XmlNodeList xmlNodeList = xmlDocument.SelectNodes("/Tree/EACTreeNode");
				int num = 0;
				foreach (XmlNode item in xmlNodeList)
				{
					EACTreeNode eACTreeNode = GenerateTreeNode(item, isBackground);
					if (eACTreeNode == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (item.Attributes != null && item.Attributes["ScenarioNumber"] != null)
					{
						EventAggregator.GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Publish(new WorkflowControlStateArgs
						{
							ControlType = WorkflowControl.NavigationTree,
							State = new object[2]
							{
								eACTreeNode.Key,
								"ScenarioNumber:" + item.Attributes["ScenarioNumber"].Value
							}
						});
					}
					foreach (XmlNode item2 in item.SelectNodes("EACTreeNode"))
					{
						EACTreeNode eACTreeNode2 = GenerateTreeNode(item2, isBackground);
						if (eACTreeNode2 == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						XmlNodeList xmlNodeList2 = item2.SelectNodes("EACTreeNode");
						num++;
						foreach (XmlNode item3 in xmlNodeList2)
						{
							EACTreeNode eACTreeNode3 = GenerateTreeNode(item3, isBackground);
							if (eACTreeNode3 != null)
							{
								num++;
								eACTreeNode2.Children.Add(eACTreeNode3);
							}
						}
						foreach (NavigatorTreeNode child in eACTreeNode2.Children)
						{
							if (child is EACRetrofitTreeNode)
							{
								((EACRetrofitTreeNode)child).ParentNodeRetrofitsCounter = eACTreeNode2.Children.Count;
							}
						}
						eACTreeNode.Children.Add(eACTreeNode2);
					}
					Children.Add(eACTreeNode);
					EACFormFactory.AddEACProjectTreeNode(eACTreeNode.Key);
					EACFormFactory.EACTreeNodeRibbonInfo eACRibbonInfo = EACFormFactory.GetEACRibbonInfo(eACTreeNode.Key);
					if (eACTreeNode.Children.Count <= 1)
					{
						eACRibbonInfo.Status = EACFormFactory.EACTreeNodeRibbonStatus.Initialized;
					}
					else
					{
						foreach (NavigatorTreeNode child2 in eACTreeNode.Children)
						{
							if (child2.TextReadOnly.StartsWith("Scenario"))
							{
								int scenarioCount = eACRibbonInfo.ScenarioCount + 1;
								eACRibbonInfo.ScenarioCount = scenarioCount;
							}
							else
							{
								child2.TextReadOnly.StartsWith("Saving Potentials");
							}
						}
						eACRibbonInfo.Status = EACFormFactory.EACTreeNodeRibbonStatus.Analyzed;
					}
					if (eACTreeNode.Children.FirstOrDefault((NavigatorTreeNode tmpItem) => ((EACTreeNode)tmpItem).NodeForm == FormCategory.SavingPotentials) != null)
					{
						UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(mContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<DataSourceChangedEvent>().Publish(new DataSourceChangedEventArgs
						{
							SourceType = DataSourceTypeEnum.HeatExchangerCost
						});
					}
				}
				NavigatorTreeNode navigatorTreeNode = Children[Children.Count - 1];
				if (navigatorTreeNode != null)
				{
					if (navigatorTreeNode.Children.FirstOrDefault((NavigatorTreeNode nodeItem) => ((EACTreeNode)nodeItem).NodeForm == FormCategory.ResultComparison) != null)
					{
						num = 7;
					}
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(mContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Publish(new WorkflowControlStateArgs
					{
						State = num,
						ControlType = WorkflowControl.ProgressIndicator
					});
				}
			}
			catch (XmlException)
			{
			}
		}

		private EACTreeNode GenerateTreeNode(XmlNode node, bool isBackground)
		{
			if (node.Attributes["Key"] == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = node.Attributes["RetrofitIndex"];
				FormCategory formCategory = (FormCategory)Enum.Parse(typeof(FormCategory), node.Attributes["NodeForm"].Value);
				EACTreeNode eACTreeNode = new EACTreeNode();
				if (formCategory == FormCategory.AddNewE400 || formCategory == FormCategory.RelocateE108 || formCategory == FormCategory.ModifyHeatExchanger)
				{
					_ = node.Attributes["Text"].Value;
					eACTreeNode = new EACRetrofitTreeNode(mContainer, string.Format("{0}.{1}", node.Attributes["Text"].Value, xmlAttribute.Value.Trim()))
					{
						TextFormat = EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(formCategory)
					};
					if (node.Attributes["ParentNodeRetrofitsCounter"] != null)
					{
						((EACRetrofitTreeNode)eACTreeNode).ParentNodeRetrofitsCounter = int.Parse(node.Attributes["ParentNodeRetrofitsCounter"].Value);
					}
				}
				eACTreeNode.Key = node.Attributes["Key"].Value;
				string value = node.Attributes["Text"].Value;
				string[] array = ParseNumber(value);
				eACTreeNode.Text = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, EACFormFactory.CreateInstance().GetFormText(formCategory), (formCategory != FormCategory.Project && formCategory != FormCategory.Scenario && formCategory != FormCategory.Scenario) ? value.Replace(new Regex("\\b(.+?)\\b").Match(value).Groups[1].Value, string.Empty).Trim() : ((array == null || array.Length == 0) ? string.Empty : array[0]));
				eACTreeNode.ScreenFactoryKey = node.Attributes["ScreenFactoryKey"].Value;
				eACTreeNode.EventAggregator = EventAggregator;
				eACTreeNode.NodeForm = formCategory;
				if (!isBackground)
				{
					eACTreeNode.IsSelected = string.Compare(node.Attributes["IsSelected"].Value, "true", ignoreCase: true) == 0;
				}
				else
				{
					eACTreeNode.SetSelectedWithoutSideEffects(string.Compare(node.Attributes["IsSelected"].Value, "true", ignoreCase: true) == 0);
				}
				if (node.Attributes["Flag"] != null)
				{
					eACTreeNode.SpecialFlag = node.Attributes["Flag"].Value;
				}
				if (node.SelectSingleNode("UIScreenSubject/Key") != null)
				{
					eACTreeNode.ScreenSubject = new UIScreenSubject
					{
						Key = ScreenSubjectAdapter.ParseScreenSubjectKey(formCategory, eACTreeNode.Key, node.SelectSingleNode("UIScreenSubject/Key").InnerText),
						Header = ScreenSubjectAdapter.ParseScreenSubjectHeader(node.SelectSingleNode("UIScreenSubject/Header").InnerText, formCategory)
					};
				}
				if (xmlAttribute != null)
				{
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(mContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<UITreeNodeSelectionEvent>().Publish(new UITreeNodeSelectionArgs
					{
						NodeKey = eACTreeNode.Key,
						State = new object[3]
						{
							true,
							OperationEnum.Restore,
							xmlAttribute.Value.Trim()
						}
					});
				}
				return eACTreeNode;
			}
			catch (NullReferenceException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static string[] ParseNumber(string nodeText)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(nodeText))
			{
				return null;
			}
			MatchCollection matchCollection = new Regex("\\s(\\d+)\\s*").Matches(nodeText);
			string[] array = new string[matchCollection.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < matchCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = matchCollection[i].Groups[1].Value;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public override void NavigateTo(string navigationPath, ShowScreenOptions options)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(navigationPath))
			{
				return;
			}
			NavigatorTreeNode navigatorTreeNode = null;
			NavigatorTreeNodeCollection children = Children;
			string[] array = navigationPath.Split(new char[1] { '.' }, StringSplitOptions.None);
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				if (navigatorTreeNode != null)
				{
					navigatorTreeNode.IsExpanded = true;
					children = navigatorTreeNode.Children;
				}
				navigatorTreeNode = FindChildByText(children, text);
				if (navigatorTreeNode == null)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (navigatorTreeNode != null)
			{
				navigatorTreeNode.SetSelectedWithoutSideEffects(value: true);
				navigatorTreeNode.ExecuteShowScreen(options);
			}
		}

		private static NavigatorTreeNode FindChildByText(NavigatorTreeNodeCollection children, string text)
		{
			if (children == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (NavigatorTreeNode child in children)
			{
				if (child != null && child.TextReadOnly == text)
				{
					return child;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	public class UIScreenSubject : ScreenSubject
	{
		public string Key { get; set; }

		public string Header { get; set; }

		public UIScreenSubject()
		{
			base.NavigationGroupKey = "Energy Analysis";
		}

		public override bool SatisfiesScreenRequirements(ScreenSubject screenSubject)
		{
			if (!(screenSubject is UIScreenSubject uIScreenSubject))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (this == uIScreenSubject)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Equals(Key, uIScreenSubject.Key, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return string.Equals(Header, uIScreenSubject.Header, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class UIScreenState : ScreenState
	{
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public object ContentState { get; set; }
	}
	public class UIPageScreen : ScreenContentControl
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<string, ScreenState> _cachedRuntimeSettings = new Dictionary<string, ScreenState>();

		private string _screenIdentifier;

		public static string Key => "UIPageScreen";

		public string Identifier => _screenIdentifier;

		public UIPageScreen()
		{
			base.NavigationGroupKey = "Energy Analysis";
		}

		public override void InitializeScreen(IUnityContainer container, ScreenSubject screenSubjectOpaque, ScreenState screenState)
		{
			UIScreenSubject uIScreenSubject = screenSubjectOpaque as UIScreenSubject;
			base.Header = uIScreenSubject.Header;
			_screenIdentifier = uIScreenSubject.Key;
			string[] array = uIScreenSubject.Key.Split('.');
			switch (ParseFormType(uIScreenSubject.Key))
			{
			case "Project":
			case "Setup":
				base.Content = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Project_Setup_Template>(container, "ProjectSetupForm", Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				break;
			case "Saving Potentials":
				base.Content = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Project_SavingPotentials>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				break;
			case "Modify Heat Exchangers":
			{
				Project_ModifyXchanger project_ModifyXchanger = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Project_ModifyXchanger>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				project_ModifyXchanger.Scenario = uIScreenSubject.Key + "RetrofitIndex" + ((array.Length > 1) ? array[array.Length - 1] : "1");
				base.Content = project_ModifyXchanger;
				break;
			}
			case "Summary":
			case "Scenario":
			{
				Project_Summary project_Summary = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Project_Summary>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				project_Summary.Scenario = uIScreenSubject.Key;
				base.Content = project_Summary;
				break;
			}
			case "Relocate":
			{
				Project_RelocateXchanger project_RelocateXchanger = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Project_RelocateXchanger>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				project_RelocateXchanger.Scenario = uIScreenSubject.Key + "RetrofitIndex" + ((array.Length > 1) ? array[array.Length - 1] : "1");
				base.Content = project_RelocateXchanger;
				break;
			}
			case "Add New":
			{
				Project_AddXchanger project_AddXchanger = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Project_AddXchanger>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				project_AddXchanger.Scenario = uIScreenSubject.Key + "RetrofitIndex" + ((array.Length > 1) ? array[array.Length - 1] : "1");
				base.Content = project_AddXchanger;
				break;
			}
			case "Result Comparison":
			{
				Project_CompareResult content2 = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Project_CompareResult>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				base.Content = content2;
				break;
			}
			case "Project Comparison":
			{
				Project_CompareProjectResult content = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<Project_CompareProjectResult>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				base.Content = content;
				break;
			}
			}
			if (base.Content is MMViewModelContainer)
			{
				((MMViewModelContainer)base.Content).Variable = new DataVariable
				{
					ProjectKey = array[0]
				};
			}
			RestoreState(screenSubjectOpaque, screenState);
			base.Focusable = false;
		}

		private void CacheState()
		{
			string text = GenerateSettingsKey(base.ScreenSubject);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				_cachedRuntimeSettings[text] = SaveState();
			}
		}

		private void RestoreState(ScreenSubject subjectFromCommonShell, ScreenState stateFromCommonShell)
		{
			UIScreenState uIScreenState = stateFromCommonShell as UIScreenState;
			if (uIScreenState == null)
			{
				string text = GenerateSettingsKey(subjectFromCommonShell);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && _cachedRuntimeSettings.ContainsKey(text))
				{
					uIScreenState = _cachedRuntimeSettings[text] as UIScreenState;
				}
			}
			if (uIScreenState != null)
			{
				if (base.Content is IPersistent)
				{
					((IPersistent)base.Content).Restore(uIScreenState.ContentState);
				}
				base.Zoom = uIScreenState.Zoom;
			}
		}

		public override ScreenState SaveState()
		{
			UIScreenState uIScreenState = new UIScreenState
			{
				Zoom = base.Zoom
			};
			if (base.Content is IPersistent persistent)
			{
				uIScreenState.ContentState = persistent.Save();
			}
			return uIScreenState;
		}

		private string GenerateSettingsKey(ScreenSubject screenSubject)
		{
			if (screenSubject is UIScreenSubject uIScreenSubject)
			{
				return uIScreenSubject.Key;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static string ParseFormType(string sceenSubjectKey)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sceenSubjectKey))
			{
				return "Project";
			}
			string result = null;
			string[] array = sceenSubjectKey.Split('.');
			for (int num = array.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (array[num].IndexOf("Project Comparison") >= 0)
				{
					result = "Project Comparison";
					break;
				}
				if (array[num].IndexOf("Project") >= 0)
				{
					result = "Project";
					break;
				}
				if (array[num].IndexOf("Setup") >= 0)
				{
					result = "Setup";
					break;
				}
				if (array[num].IndexOf("Saving Potentials") >= 0)
				{
					result = "Saving Potentials";
					break;
				}
				if (array[num].IndexOf("Scenario") >= 0 || array[num].IndexOf("Summary") >= 0)
				{
					result = "Scenario";
					break;
				}
				if (array[num].IndexOf("Modify Heat Exchangers") >= 0)
				{
					result = "Modify Heat Exchangers";
					break;
				}
				if (array[num].IndexOf("Relocate") >= 0)
				{
					result = "Relocate";
					break;
				}
				if (array[num].IndexOf("Add New") >= 0)
				{
					result = "Add New";
					break;
				}
				if (array[num].IndexOf("Result Comparison") >= 0)
				{
					result = "Result Comparison";
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnZoomChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			ApplyZoom(newValue);
			base.OnZoomChanged(oldValue, newValue);
		}

		private void ApplyZoom(double newValue)
		{
			object content = base.Content;
			IShellZoomable val = (IShellZoomable)((content is IShellZoomable) ? content : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.Zoom(newValue);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClosing(CancelEventArgs args)
		{
			base.OnClosing(args);
			if (base.Content is MMTabPage mMTabPage)
			{
				mMTabPage.OnClosing(args);
				return;
			}
			MMTabTemplate obj = base.Content as MMTabTemplate;
			MMTabStrip mMTabStrip = obj.Content as MMTabStrip;
			if (obj == null || mMTabStrip.Items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (MMTabItem item in mMTabStrip.Items)
			{
				if (item.Content is MMTabPage mMTabPage2)
				{
					mMTabPage2.OnClosing(args);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClosed(EventArgs args)
		{
			CacheState();
			base.OnClosed(args);
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Keyboard.IsKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.Key.LeftCtrl) || Keyboard.IsKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.Key.RightCtrl))
			{
				if (e.Delta > 0)
				{
					base.Zoom *= 1.25;
				}
				else
				{
					base.Zoom *= 0.8;
				}
			}
			base.OnPreviewMouseWheel(e);
		}
	}

	public class HeatExchangerTypeConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value != null;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class RemoveNewLineConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return value.ToString().Replace(Environment.NewLine, " ");
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

namespace Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.ViewControls
{
	public class ProgressIndicatorSegement : UserControl, INotifyPropertyChanged, IComponentConnector
	{
		private const double ProgressBar_Height = 15.0;

		private double ProgressBar_Width = 100.0;

		private const double ProgressBar_Indicator_Height = 5.0;

		private const double ProgressBar_Indicator_Width = 4.0;

		private const double ProgressBar_Indicator_X = 10.0;

		private const double ProgressBar_Indicator_Y = 11.0;

		private static DependencyProperty ProgressBarBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ProgressBarBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(UserControl), new PropertyMetadata(new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Green)));

		private static DependencyProperty IndicatorHeaderProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IndicatorHeader", typeof(string), typeof(UserControl), new PropertyMetadata("Header"));

		private static DependencyProperty HasIndicatorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HasIndicator", typeof(bool), typeof(UserControl), new PropertyMetadata(true, OnHasIndicatorChanged));

		private static DependencyProperty BottomIndicatorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BottomIndicator", typeof(IEnumerable<string>), typeof(UserControl), new PropertyMetadata(OnHasIndicatorChanged));

		private static DependencyProperty IsStartSegementProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsStartSegement", typeof(bool), typeof(UserControl), new PropertyMetadata(false, OnHasIndicatorChanged));

		private static DependencyProperty LineWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LineWidth", typeof(double), typeof(UserControl), new PropertyMetadata(100.0, OnHasIndicatorChanged));

		private static DependencyProperty MouseEnterCommandProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MouseEnterCommand", typeof(ICommand), typeof(ProgressIndicatorSegement));

		private static DependencyProperty MouseLeaveCommandProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MouseLeaveCommand", typeof(ICommand), typeof(ProgressIndicatorSegement));

		internal Label IndicatorTextLabel;

		internal System.Windows.Shapes.Path ProgressBar;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush ProgressBarBrush
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ProgressBarBrushProperty) as System.Windows.Media.Brush;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ProgressBarBrushProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string IndicatorHeader
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(IndicatorHeaderProperty).ToString();
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IndicatorHeaderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasIndicator
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(HasIndicatorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(HasIndicatorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<string> BottomIndicator
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(BottomIndicatorProperty) as IEnumerable<string>;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BottomIndicatorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsStartSegement
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsStartSegementProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsStartSegementProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double LineWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(LineWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LineWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ICommand MouseEnterCommand
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(MouseEnterCommandProperty) as ICommand;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MouseEnterCommandProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ICommand MouseLeaveCommand
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(MouseLeaveCommandProperty) as ICommand;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MouseLeaveCommandProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double LabelMaxWidth => ProgressBar_Width;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public ProgressIndicatorSegement()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			ConstructProgressBar();
		}

		private void ConstructProgressBar()
		{
			ProgressBar_Width = LineWidth;
			PathSegmentCollection pathSegmentCollection = new PathSegmentCollection(new PathSegment[1]
			{
				new LineSegment(new System.Windows.Point(10.0 + ProgressBar_Width, 11.0), isStroked: true)
			});
			if (HasIndicator)
			{
				pathSegmentCollection.Add(new LineSegment(new System.Windows.Point(10.0 + ProgressBar_Width, 6.0), isStroked: true));
				pathSegmentCollection.Add(new LineSegment(new System.Windows.Point(10.0 + ProgressBar_Width + 4.0, 6.0), isStroked: true));
				pathSegmentCollection.Add(new LineSegment(new System.Windows.Point(10.0 + ProgressBar_Width + 4.0, 11.0), isStroked: true));
				pathSegmentCollection.Add(new LineSegment(new System.Windows.Point(10.0 + ProgressBar_Width + 4.0, 26.0), isStroked: false));
				if (BottomIndicator != null && BottomIndicator.Count() != 0)
				{
					pathSegmentCollection.Add(new LineSegment(new System.Windows.Point(10.0 + ProgressBar_Width + 4.0, 31.0), isStroked: true));
					pathSegmentCollection.Add(new LineSegment(new System.Windows.Point(10.0 + ProgressBar_Width, 31.0), isStroked: true));
					pathSegmentCollection.Add(new LineSegment(new System.Windows.Point(10.0 + ProgressBar_Width, 26.0), isStroked: true));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				pathSegmentCollection.Add(new LineSegment(new System.Windows.Point(10.0 + ProgressBar_Width + 4.0, 11.0), isStroked: true));

					IsClosed = false
				}
			});
		}

		private bool _displayAllHeatExchangers;

		private static readonly DependencyProperty SettleCorrectionFactorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SettleCorrectionFactor", typeof(double), typeof(SurfaceAreaControl), new PropertyMetadata(0.8));

		public static Regex validDoubleRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (_validDoubleRegex == null)
				{
					_validDoubleRegex = new Regex("^$|^[+-]?\\d*(\\.\\d*)?([Ee][+-]?\\d+)?$");
				}
				return _validDoubleRegex;
			}
		}

		public static Regex maskDoubleRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (_maskDoubleRegex == null)
				{
					_maskDoubleRegex = new Regex("^[+-]?\\d*(\\.)?\\d*([eE][+-]?\\d*)?$");
				}
				return _maskDoubleRegex;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<Field> SurfaceAreaFields

		private void CellValuePresenter_PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			CellValuePresenter val = (CellValuePresenter)((sender is CellValuePresenter) ? sender : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				ValueEditor editor = ((ValuePresenter)(object)val).Editor;
				if (editor != null && !editor.IsReadOnly)
				{
					editor.StartEditMode();
				}
			}
		}

		private void CellValuePresenter_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			CellValuePresenter val = (CellValuePresenter)((sender is CellValuePresenter) ? sender : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ValueEditor editor = ((ValuePresenter)(object)val).Editor;
			if (editor != null && !editor.IsReadOnly && Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(editor, typeof(TextBox), allowSubclassOfType: false) is TextBox textBox)
			{
				string empty = string.Empty;
				empty = ((e.Text == " ") ? GetPreviewInputStringWhenAddText(textBox, " ") : ((!(e.Text == ".")) ? GetPreviewInputStringWhenAddText(textBox, e.Text) : GetPreviewInputStringWhenAddText(textBox, GetSystemDecimalSymbol())));
				if (!maskDoubleValue(empty, 0))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				else if (e.Text == ".")
				{
					textBox.Text = empty;
					textBox.SelectionStart = empty.Length;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public static string GetPreviewInputStringWhenAddText(TextBox tb, string previewAddingText)
		{
			string text = tb.Text;
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (text != null)
			{
				int selectionStart = tb.SelectionStart;
				selectionStart = ((selectionStart > text.Length) ? text.Length : selectionStart);
				int selectionLength = tb.SelectionLength;
				int num = selectionStart + selectionLength;
				num = ((num > tb.Text.Length) ? tb.Text.Length : num);
				string obj = ((selectionStart == 0) ? string.Empty : text.Substring(0, selectionStart));
				string text2 = ((num >= text.Length) ? string.Empty : text.Substring(selectionStart + selectionLength));
				return obj + previewAddingText + text2;
			}
			return previewAddingText;
		}

		public static string GetSystemDecimalSymbol()
		{
			return 0.1.ToString().Replace("0", string.Empty).Replace("1", string.Empty);
		}

		public static bool maskDoubleValue(string testString, int MaxLength)
		{
			testString = testString.Replace(GetSystemDecimalSymbol(), ".");
			if (!maskDoubleRegex.IsMatch(testString) || (MaxLength != 0 && testString.Length > MaxLength))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(testString) && (testString.Contains("e") || testString.Contains("E")))
			{
				if (double.TryParse(testString, out var result))
				{
					if (result < -1E+300 || result > 1E+300)
					{
						return false;
					}
					int num = result.ToString().IndexOf("e", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
					if (num > -1 && num > 0 && int.TryParse(result.ToString().Substring(num + 1), out var result2) && (result2 < -300 || result2 > 300))
					{
						return false;
					}
					num = testString.IndexOf("e", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
					if (result == 0.0 && double.TryParse(testString.Substring(0, num), out var result3) && result3 != 0.0)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!double.TryParse(testString, out result) && validDoubleRegex.IsMatch(testString))
				{
					int num2 = testString.IndexOf("e", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
					if (num2 > -1 && int.TryParse(testString.Substring(num2 + 1), out var result4) && result4 >= -300 && result4 <= 300)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CheckBox_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			CheckBox chk = sender as CheckBox;
			if (chk != null)
			{
				Field val = _surfaceAreaFields.FirstOrDefault((Field item) => ((FieldItem)item).Label.ToString().IndexOf(chk.Tag.ToString()) >= 0);
				if (val != null)
				{
					((FieldItem)val).Visibility = ((!chk.IsChecked.HasValue || !chk.IsChecked.Value) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
			}
		}

				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		private void surfaceAreaGrid_EditModeEnding(object sender, EditModeEndingEventArgs e)
		{
			ValueEditor editor = ((EditModeEventArgs)e).Editor;
			if (editor != null && editor.IsValueValid && (editor.OriginalValue == null || editor.Value == null || !(editor.OriginalValue.GetType() == typeof(string)) || !(editor.Value.GetType() == typeof(string)) || !string.Equals(editor.OriginalValue.ToString(), editor.Value.ToString())) && CellValueUpdateAction != null)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.Invoke(CellValueUpdateAction, true);
			}
		}

				((DataPresenterBase)surfaceAreaGrid).DataSource = DataSource;
			}
		}

		private double unscaledY { get; set; }

		public SingleUtilityCompositeChart()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			base.Closing += ActivationForm_Closing;
			SharedChartData.UpdateChartsEventHandler += UpdateThisChart_Handler;
		}

		public override void InitializeScreen(IUnityContainer container, ScreenSubject screenSubject, ScreenState screenState)
		{
			base.InitializeScreen(container, screenSubject, screenState);
			base.HelpId = 13108;
			UIScreenState uIScreenState = screenState as UIScreenState;
			if (uIScreenState == null)
			{
				uIScreenState = new UIScreenState();
				uIScreenState.ContentState = new object[7];
			}
			else if (uIScreenState.ContentState != null)
			{
				byte[] buffer = Convert.FromBase64String(uIScreenState.ContentState.ToString());
				if (!(new BinaryFormatter().Deserialize(new MemoryStream(buffer)) is object[] array) || array.Length != 7)
				{
					uIScreenState.ContentState = new object[7];
				}
				else
				{
					uIScreenState.ContentState = array;
				}
			}
			Restore(uIScreenState);
		}

		public void Restore(object state)
		{
		}

		private void ActivationForm_Closing(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Content is SingleUtilityCompositeChart singleUtilityCompositeChart)
			{
				singleUtilityCompositeChart.UnRegisterEvents();
			}
		}

		public void UnRegisterEvents()
		{
			SharedChartData.UpdateChartsEventHandler -= UpdateThisChart_Handler;
		}

		public object Save()
		{
			return new object[7];
		}

		protected override void OnZoomChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			object content = base.Content;
			IShellZoomable val = (IShellZoomable)((content is IShellZoomable) ? content : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.Zoom(newValue);
			}
			base.OnZoomChanged(oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.LeftCtrl) || Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.RightCtrl))
			{
				if (e.Delta > 0)
				{
					base.Zoom *= 1.25;
				}
				else
				{
					base.Zoom *= 0.8;
				}
			}
			base.OnPreviewMouseWheel(e);
		}

		private void Chart_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateChartData();
		}

		public void UpdateThisChart_Handler(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateChartData();
		}

		public void UpdateChartData()
		{
			if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.UTILCOMPCUR, out var value))
			{
				HotSeries = Chart.Series.First((Infragistics.Controls.Charts.Series c) => c.Name == "HotCurveSeries");
				ColdSeries = Chart.Series.First((Infragistics.Controls.Charts.Series c) => c.Name == "ColdCurveSeries");
				CompositeChartViewModel compositeChartViewModel = value as CompositeChartViewModel;
				HotSeries.ItemsSource = compositeChartViewModel.HotCurveView.Points;
				ColdSeries.ItemsSource = compositeChartViewModel.ColdCurveView.Points;
				LandingFormGridResource landingFormGridResource = TryFindResource("GridResource") as LandingFormGridResource;
				Chart.Axes.First((Axis c) => c.Name == "yAxis").Title = landingFormGridResource.TemperatureChartHeader;
				Axis axis = Chart.Axes.First((Axis c) => c.Name == "xAxis");
				axis.Title = landingFormGridResource.EnthalpyChartHeader;
				axis.Label = "{0:E3}";
			}
		}

		private void ImageBorder_MouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is Border border)
			{
				border.BorderBrush = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.LightGray;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void ImageBorder_MouseLeave(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is Border border)
			{
				border.BorderBrush = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void Toggle_Interactive_Graph_Window(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Chart.OverviewPlusDetailPaneVisibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				Chart.OverviewPlusDetailPaneVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			else
			{
				Chart.OverviewPlusDetailPaneVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
		}

		private int? GetFirstIndex(List<CompositeCurvePoint> data, double Ent, double Temp)
		{
			double num = Math.Round(Ent, 2);
			double num2 = Math.Round(Temp, 2);
			double num3 = 0.05;
			int? result = null;
			int count = data.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (i + 1 >= count)
				{
					continue;
				}
				double num4 = Math.Round(data[i].Enthalpy, 2);
				double num5 = Math.Round(data[i].Temperature, 2);
				double num6 = Math.Round(data[i + 1].Enthalpy, 2);
				double num7 = Math.Round(data[i + 1].Temperature, 2);
				if ((1.0 + num3) * num4 >= num && num >= (1.0 - num3) * num6)
				{
					if ((1.0 + num3) * num5 >= num2 && num2 >= (1.0 - num3) * num7)
					{
						result = i;
						break;
					}
					if ((1.0 + num3) * num7 >= num2 && num2 >= (1.0 - num3) * num5)
					{
						result = i;
						break;
					}
				}
				else if ((1.0 + num3) * num6 >= num && num >= (1.0 - num3) * num4)
				{
					if ((1.0 + num3) * num5 >= num2 && num2 >= (1.0 - num3) * num7)
					{
						result = i;
						break;
					}
					if ((1.0 + num3) * num7 >= num2 && num2 >= (1.0 - num3) * num5)
					{
						result = i;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void HotCurveSeries_MouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.UTILCOMPCUR, out var value))
			{
				CompositeChartViewModel compositeChartViewModel = value as CompositeChartViewModel;
				int? firstIndex = GetFirstIndex(compositeChartViewModel.HotCurveView.Points, unscaledX, unscaledY);
				if (firstIndex.HasValue && compositeChartViewModel.HotCurveView.Points[firstIndex.Value].NextIntervalStreams != null)
				{
					text = compositeChartViewModel.HotCurveView.Points[firstIndex.Value].NextIntervalStreams.StreamNames[0].ToString();
				}
			}
			if (text != string.Empty)
			{
				ToolTip toolTip = new ToolTip();
				TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock();
				textBlock.Foreground = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black;
				textBlock.Text = $"Streams in this segment:\n{text}";
				toolTip.Content = textBlock;
				toolTip.Padding = new Thickness(4.0);
				ToolTipService.SetToolTip(HotCurveSeries, toolTip);
			}
			else
			{
				ToolTipService.SetToolTip(HotCurveSeries, null);
			}
		}

		private void ColdCurveSeries_MouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.UTILCOMPCUR, out var value))
			{
				CompositeChartViewModel compositeChartViewModel = value as CompositeChartViewModel;
				int? firstIndex = GetFirstIndex(compositeChartViewModel.ColdCurveView.Points, unscaledX, unscaledY);
				if (firstIndex.HasValue && compositeChartViewModel.ColdCurveView.Points[firstIndex.Value].NextIntervalStreams != null)

			}
			else
			{
				ToolTipService.SetToolTip(ColdCurveSeries, null);
			}
		}

		private void OnCurveChartMouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			Infragistics.Controls.Charts.Series series = Chart.Series.FirstOrDefault();
			if (series != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(series);
				if (((XamDataChart)series.SeriesViewer).Axes.OfType<NumericXAxis>().Any())
				{
					NumericXAxis numericXAxis = ((XamDataChart)series.SeriesViewer).Axes.OfType<NumericXAxis>().First();
					NumericYAxis numericYAxis = ((XamDataChart)series.SeriesViewer).Axes.OfType<NumericYAxis>().First();
					Rect viewport = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, numericXAxis.ActualWidth, numericYAxis.ActualHeight);
					Rect windowRect = series.SeriesViewer.WindowRect;
					bool isInverted = numericXAxis.IsInverted;
					unscaledX = numericXAxis.GetUnscaledValue(p: new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, isInverted), scaledValue: position.X);
					isInverted = numericYAxis.IsInverted;
					ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, isInverted);
					unscaledY = numericYAxis.GetUnscaledValue(position.Y, p);
					ScatterXCoordinateTextBlock.Text = $"{unscaledX:0.00}";
					ScatterYCoordinateTextBlock.Text = $"{unscaledY:0.00}";
				}
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		public void InitializeComponent()
		{
			if (!_contentLoaded)
			{
				_contentLoaded = true;
				Uri resourceLocator = new Uri("/Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface;component/itempages/singleutilitycompositechart.xaml", UriKind.Relative);
				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		internal Delegate _CreateDelegate(Type delegateType, string handler)
		{
			return Delegate.CreateDelegate(delegateType, this, handler);
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		void IComponentConnector.Connect(int connectionId, object target)
		{
			switch (connectionId)
			{
			case 1:
				ScatterXCoordinateTextBlock = (TextBlock)target;
				break;
			case 2:
				ScatterYCoordinateTextBlock = (TextBlock)target;
				break;
			case 3:
				Chart = (XamDataChart)target;
				Chart.Loaded += Chart_Loaded;
				Chart.MouseMove += OnCurveChartMouseMove;
				break;
			case 4:
				xAxis = (NumericXAxis)target;
				break;
			case 5:
				yAxis = (NumericYAxis)target;
				break;
			case 6:
				HotCurveSeries = (ScatterLineSeries)target;
				HotCurveSeries.MouseEnter += HotCurveSeries_MouseEnter;
				break;
			case 7:
				ColdCurveSeries = (ScatterLineSeries)target;
				ColdCurveSeries.MouseEnter += ColdCurveSeries_MouseEnter;
				break;
			case 8:
				xmLegend = (Legend)target;
				break;
			case 9:
				((Border)target).MouseEnter += ImageBorder_MouseEnter;
				((Border)target).MouseLeave += ImageBorder_MouseLeave;
				break;
			case 10:
				((System.Windows.Controls.Image)target).MouseDown += Toggle_Interactive_Graph_Window;
				break;
			default:
				_contentLoaded = true;
				break;
			}
		}
	}

			}
			else if (uIScreenState.ContentState != null)
			{
				byte[] buffer = Convert.FromBase64String(uIScreenState.ContentState.ToString());
				if (!(new BinaryFormatter().Deserialize(new MemoryStream(buffer)) is object[] array) || array.Length != 7)
				{
					uIScreenState.ContentState = new object[7];
				}
				else
				{
					uIScreenState.ContentState = array;
				}
			}
			Restore(uIScreenState);
		}

		}

		}

		public void UpdateChartData()
		{
			if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.COMPCURV, out var value))
			{
				HotSeries = Chart.Series.First((Infragistics.Controls.Charts.Series c) => c.Name == "HotCurveSeries");
				ColdSeries = Chart.Series.First((Infragistics.Controls.Charts.Series c) => c.Name == "ColdCurveSeries");
				ThePinchPointSerie = Chart.Series.First((Infragistics.Controls.Charts.Series c) => c.Name == "PinchPointSerie");
				CompositeChartViewModel compositeChartViewModel = value as CompositeChartViewModel;
				HotSeries.ItemsSource = compositeChartViewModel.HotCurveView.Points;
				ColdSeries.ItemsSource = compositeChartViewModel.ColdCurveView.Points;
				LandingFormGridResource landingFormGridResource = TryFindResource("GridResource") as LandingFormGridResource;
				Chart.Axes.First((Axis c) => c.Name == "yAxis").Title = landingFormGridResource.TemperatureChartHeader;
				Axis axis = Chart.Axes.First((Axis c) => c.Name == "xAxis");
				axis.Title = landingFormGridResource.EnthalpyChartHeader;
				axis.Label = "{0:E3}";
				if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.PINCHLIST, out var value2) && value2 != null)
				{
					PinchListViewModel pinchListViewModel = value2 as PinchListViewModel;
					ThePinchPointSerie.ItemsSource = CompositeCurveUtilities.LocatePintchPointsBetweenCurves(pinchListViewModel, compositeChartViewModel.HotCurveView.Points, compositeChartViewModel.ColdCurveView.Points);
				}
			}
		}

		private int? GetFirstIndex(List<CompositeCurvePoint> data, double Ent, double Temp)
		{
			double num = Math.Round(Ent, 2);
			double num2 = Math.Round(Temp, 2);
			double num3 = 0.05;
			int? result = null;
			int count = data.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (i + 1 >= count)
				{
					continue;
				}
				double num4 = Math.Round(data[i].Enthalpy, 2);
				double num5 = Math.Round(data[i].Temperature, 2);
				double num6 = Math.Round(data[i + 1].Enthalpy, 2);
				double num7 = Math.Round(data[i + 1].Temperature, 2);
				if ((1.0 + num3) * num4 >= num && num >= (1.0 - num3) * num6)
				{
					if ((1.0 + num3) * num5 >= num2 && num2 >= (1.0 - num3) * num7)
					{
						result = i;
						break;
					}
					if ((1.0 + num3) * num7 >= num2 && num2 >= (1.0 - num3) * num5)
					{
						result = i;
						break;
					}
				}
				else if ((1.0 + num3) * num6 >= num && num >= (1.0 - num3) * num4)
				{
					if ((1.0 + num3) * num5 >= num2 && num2 >= (1.0 - num3) * num7)
					{
						result = i;
						break;
					}
					if ((1.0 + num3) * num7 >= num2 && num2 >= (1.0 - num3) * num5)
					{
						result = i;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void Toggle_Interactive_Graph_Window(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Chart.OverviewPlusDetailPaneVisibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				Chart.OverviewPlusDetailPaneVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			else
			{
				Chart.OverviewPlusDetailPaneVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
		}

		private void HotCurveSeries_MouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.COMPCURV, out var value))
			{
				CompositeChartViewModel compositeChartViewModel = value as CompositeChartViewModel;
				int? firstIndex = GetFirstIndex(compositeChartViewModel.HotCurveView.Points, unscaledX, unscaledY);
				if (firstIndex.HasValue && compositeChartViewModel.HotCurveView.Points[firstIndex.Value].NextIntervalStreams != null)
				{
					text = compositeChartViewModel.HotCurveView.Points[firstIndex.Value].NextIntervalStreams.StreamNames[0].ToString();
				}
			}
			if (text != string.Empty)
			{
				ToolTip toolTip = new ToolTip();
				TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock();
				textBlock.Foreground = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black;
				textBlock.Text = $"Streams in this segment:\n{text}";
				toolTip.Content = textBlock;
				toolTip.Padding = new Thickness(4.0);
				ToolTipService.SetToolTip(HotCurveSeries, toolTip);
			}
			else
			{
				ToolTipService.SetToolTip(HotCurveSeries, null);
			}
		}

		private void ColdCurveSeries_MouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (SharedChartData.CurveDataDictionary.TryGetValue(CurveDataType.COMPCURV, out var value))
			{
				CompositeChartViewModel compositeChartViewModel = value as CompositeChartViewModel;
				int? firstIndex = GetFirstIndex(compositeChartViewModel.ColdCurveView.Points, unscaledX, unscaledY);

		private void OnCurveChartMouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			Infragistics.Controls.Charts.Series series = Chart.Series.FirstOrDefault();
			if (series != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(series);
				if (((XamDataChart)series.SeriesViewer).Axes.OfType<NumericXAxis>().Any())
				{
					NumericXAxis numericXAxis = ((XamDataChart)series.SeriesViewer).Axes.OfType<NumericXAxis>().First();
					NumericYAxis numericYAxis = ((XamDataChart)series.SeriesViewer).Axes.OfType<NumericYAxis>().First();
					Rect viewport = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, numericXAxis.ActualWidth, numericYAxis.ActualHeight);
					Rect windowRect = series.SeriesViewer.WindowRect;
					bool isInverted = numericXAxis.IsInverted;
					unscaledX = numericXAxis.GetUnscaledValue(p: new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, isInverted), scaledValue: position.X);
					isInverted = numericYAxis.IsInverted;
					ScalerParams p = new ScalerParams(windowRect, viewport, isInverted);
					unscaledY = numericYAxis.GetUnscaledValue(position.Y, p);
					ScatterXCoordinateTextBlock.Text = $"{unscaledX:0.00}";
					ScatterYCoordinateTextBlock.Text = $"{unscaledY:0.00}";
				}
			}
		}

			switch (connectionId)

				PinchPointSerie = (ScatterLineSeries)target;

				break;

				break;

				_contentLoaded = true;
				break;
			}
		}

	public class Landing_Template : MMTabTemplate, IComponentConnector
	{
		private Action _todoActionAfterReloaded;

		internal MMTabItem Tab1;

		internal MMTabItem Tab7;

		internal MMTabItem Tab2;

		internal MMTabItem Tab6;

		internal MMTabItem Tab3;

		internal MMTabItem Tab4;

		internal MMTabItem Tab5;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		[Obsolete("not recommend")]
		public Collection<BackDoorMessage> BackDoorMessage => CollectBackDoorMessage();

		public Landing_Template()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			base.ViewModel = new Landing_ViewModel();
			base.Loaded += Landing_Template_Loaded;
			base.Unloaded += Landing_Template_Unloaded;
		}

		private void Landing_Template_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (energyAnalysisAgent != null && Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, typeof(XamTabControl), allowSubclassOfType: true) is XamTabControl xamTabControl)
			{
				energyAnalysisAgent.LastOpenedTabIndex = xamTabControl.SelectedIndex;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUnityContainerChanged(IUnityContainer oldValue, IUnityContainer newValue)
		{
			base.OnUnityContainerChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					energyAnalysisAgent.AnalysisCompleteEvent += agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent;
					energyAnalysisAgent.ShowWarningFormEvent += agent_ShowWarningFormEvent;
					energyAnalysisAgent.UpdateLandingFormsEnabledStateEvent += agent_UpdateLandingFormsEnabledStateEvent;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsFindingDesignChanges()
		{
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					return energyAnalysisAgent.IsFindingDesignChanges ?? false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void UnRegisterEvents()
		{
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					energyAnalysisAgent.AnalysisCompleteEvent -= agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent;
					energyAnalysisAgent.ShowWarningFormEvent -= agent_ShowWarningFormEvent;
					energyAnalysisAgent.UpdateLandingFormsEnabledStateEvent -= agent_UpdateLandingFormsEnabledStateEvent;
				}
				if (Tab1.Content is Landing_Summary landing_Summary)
				{
					landing_Summary.UnRegisterEvents();
				}
				if (Tab2.Content is Landing_Utilities landing_Utilities)
				{
					landing_Utilities.UnRegisterEvents();
				}
				if (Tab6.Content is Landing_CarbonEmissions landing_CarbonEmissions)
				{
					landing_CarbonEmissions.UnRegisterEvents();
				}
				if (Tab3.Content is Landing_Exchangers landing_Exchangers)
				{
					landing_Exchangers.UnRegisterEvents();
				}
				if (Tab4.Content is Landing_SImprovements landing_SImprovements)
				{
					landing_SImprovements.UnRegisterEvents();
				}
				if (Tab5.Content is Landing_Configuration landing_Configuration)
				{
					landing_Configuration.UnRegisterEvents();
				}
				if (Tab7.Content is Landing_Curves landing_Curves)
				{
					landing_Curves.UnRegisterEvents();
				}
			}
		}

		private void agent_UpdateLandingFormsEnabledStateEvent(object sender, UpdateLandingFormsEnabledStateArgs e)
		{
			if (!e.HasResult)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (energyAnalysisAgent != null)
				{
					energyAnalysisAgent.LastOpenedTabIndex = -1;
				}
				ShowConfigurationTabAndDisableOthers();
			}
		}

		private void Landing_Template_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (!energyAnalysisAgent.IsAutoRun())
			{
				ShowConfigurationTabAndDisableOthers();
			}
			else if (Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, typeof(XamTabControl), allowSubclassOfType: true) is XamTabControl xamTabControl)
			{
				if (_todoActionAfterReloaded != null)
				{
					_todoActionAfterReloaded();
				}
				else if (energyAnalysisAgent.LastOpenedTabIndex >= 0)
				{
					xamTabControl.SelectedIndex = energyAnalysisAgent.LastOpenedTabIndex;
				}
			}
			_todoActionAfterReloaded = null;
		}

		private void agent_ShowWarningFormEvent(object sender, WarningTypeArgs e)
		{
			if (Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, typeof(XamTabControl), allowSubclassOfType: true) is XamTabControl xamTabControl)
			{
				IEnergyAnalysisAgent energyAnalysisAgent = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(base.Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (e.Type == WarningType.ExchangerWarning)
				{
					xamTabControl.SelectedIndex = 4;
					energyAnalysisAgent.LastOpenedTabIndex = 4;
				}
				else if (e.Type == WarningType.UtilitiesWarning)
				{
					xamTabControl.SelectedIndex = 2;
					energyAnalysisAgent.LastOpenedTabIndex = 2;
				}
			}
		}

		private void agent_AnalysisCompleteEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e is EAUpdateEventArgs e2))
			{
				return;
			}
			XamTabControl tabs = Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, typeof(XamTabControl), allowSubclassOfType: true) as XamTabControl;
			if (tabs == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Action action = delegate
			{
				Tab1.IsEnabled = true;
				Tab2.IsEnabled = true;
				Tab3.IsEnabled = true;
				Tab4.IsEnabled = true;
				Tab6.IsEnabled = true;
				Tab7.IsEnabled = true;
				tabs.SelectedIndex = 0;
			};
			Action action2 = delegate
			{
				Tab1.IsEnabled = true;
				Tab2.IsEnabled = true;
				Tab3.IsEnabled = true;
				Tab4.IsEnabled = true;
				Tab6.IsEnabled = true;
				Tab7.IsEnabled = true;
			};
			if (!base.IsLoaded)
			{
				if (e2.opt == EAOperations.RunCompleted)
				{
					_todoActionAfterReloaded = action;
				}
				else if (e2.opt == EAOperations.UpdateView)
				{
					_todoActionAfterReloaded = action2;
				}
			}
			else if (e2.opt == EAOperations.RunCompleted)
			{
				action();
			}
			else if (e2.opt == EAOperations.UpdateView)
			{
				action2();
			}
			else if (e2.opt == EAOperations.EAOff || e2.opt == EAOperations.RefreshConfigOnly)
			{
				ShowConfigurationTabAndDisableOthers();
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("not recommend")]
		private Collection<BackDoorMessage> CollectBackDoorMessage()
		{
			return new Collection<BackDoorMessage>();
		}

		public void ShowConfigurationTabAndDisableOthers()
		{
			if (Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, typeof(XamTabControl), allowSubclassOfType: true) is XamTabControl xamTabControl)
			{
				Tab1.IsEnabled = false;
				Tab2.IsEnabled = false;
				Tab3.IsEnabled = false;
				Tab4.IsEnabled = false;
				Tab6.IsEnabled = false;
				Tab7.IsEnabled = false;
				xamTabControl.SelectedIndex = 6;
			}
		}

		public object Save()
		{
			return new object[7]
			{
				Save(Tab1),
				Save(Tab2),
				Save(Tab3),
				Save(Tab4),
				Save(Tab5),
				Save(Tab6),
				Save(Tab7)
			};
		}

		private object Save(MMTabItem tab)
		{
			IPersistent persistent = tab as IPersistent;
			if (persistent == null)
			{
				persistent = tab.Content as IPersistent;
			}
			return persistent?.Save();
		}

		public void Restore(object state)
		{
			if (state is UIScreenState { ContentState: object[] contentState } && contentState.Length == 7)
			{
				Restore(Tab1, contentState[0]);
				Restore(Tab2, contentState[1]);
				Restore(Tab3, contentState[2]);
				Restore(Tab4, contentState[3]);
				Restore(Tab5, contentState[4]);
				Restore(Tab6, contentState[5]);
				Restore(Tab7, contentState[6]);
			}
		}

		private void Restore(MMTabItem tab, object state)
		{
			IPersistent persistent = tab as IPersistent;
			if (persistent == null)
			{
				persistent = tab.Content as IPersistent;
			}
			persistent?.Restore(state);
		}
