namespace Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.Images

	public static class ImageResources
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<string, ImageSource> _imageSources = new Dictionary<string, ImageSource>();

		public static ImageSource Check => GetImageSource("check.png");

		public static ImageSource Uncheck => GetImageSource("uncheck.png");

		public static ImageSource Copy => GetImageSource("Copy16.ico");

		public static ImageSource Cut => GetImageSource("Cut16.ico");

		public static ImageSource Paste => GetImageSource("Paste16.ico");

		internal static ImageSource GetImageSource(string imageName)
		{
			if (!_imageSources.ContainsKey(imageName))
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				stringBuilder.Append("pack://application:,,,/");
				stringBuilder.Append(typeof(ImageResources).Assembly.FullName);
				stringBuilder.Append(";component/Images/");
				stringBuilder.Append(imageName);
				try
				{
					BitmapImage bitmapImage = new BitmapImage(new Uri(stringBuilder.ToString(), UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute));
					if (bitmapImage.CanFreeze)
					{
						bitmapImage.Freeze();
					}
					_imageSources.Add(imageName, bitmapImage);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					_ = ex.Message;
					_imageSources.Add(imageName, null);
				}
			}
			return _imageSources[imageName];
		}
	}

		private void ComboBox_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is ComboBox { Tag: int[] tag } comboBox)
			{
				if (!_changedItems.ContainsKey(tag[1] + "." + tag[0]))
				{
					_changedItems.Add(tag[1] + "." + tag[0], new object[2] { comboBox, comboBox.Text });
				}
				if (comboBox.SelectedItem != null && _streams != null)
				{
					double num = findStreamIndex(comboBox.SelectedItem.ToString(), _streams.ModelNmaes);
					_changeMatch(tag[1] + "." + tag[0], num);
					_streams.MatchesIndexer[tag[0], tag[1]] = num;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetControlStateInXamGrid()
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (Record item in (IEnumerable<Record>)((DataPresenterBase)StreamGrid).Records)
			{
				DataRecord val = (DataRecord)(object)((item is DataRecord) ? item : null);
				if (val == null || (int)((Record)val).RecordType != 0 || !(val.DataItem is ProcessStreamView processStreamView))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (Cell item2 in (IEnumerable<Cell>)val.Cells)
				{
					if (((FieldItem)item2.Field).Label == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					CellValuePresenter val2 = CellValuePresenter.FromCell(item2);
					if (val2 == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!(((Control)(object)val2).Template.FindName("Part_Control", (FrameworkElement)(object)val2) is ComboBox comboBox))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (_streams == null || _streams.HotStreams == null || _streams.ColdStreams == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					int num = findStreamIndex(processStreamView.ColdStream, _streams.ColdStreams);
					int num2 = findStreamIndex(((FieldItem)item2.Field).Label.ToString(), _streams.HotStreams);
					if (num2 >= 0)
					{
						int num3 = (int)_streams.MatchesIndexer[num2, num];
						if (num3 >= 0)
						{
							comboBox.SelectedIndex = num3;
							comboBox.Tag = new int[2] { num2, num };
						}
					}
				}
			}
			DialogPage.Visibility = ((((DataPresenterBase)StreamGrid).Records.Count <= 0) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
		}

					case "heatexchanger2":
						base.Title = UIResources.Progressbar_AddHXTitle;
						ProgressContent = UIResources.Progressbar_AddRelocateSolutionSeachDefaultContent;
						_retrofitType = 37;
						ProgressbarAnimation();
						break;
					case "heatexchanger3":
						base.Title = UIResources.Progressbar_RelocateHXTitle;
						ProgressContent = UIResources.Progressbar_AddRelocateSolutionSeachDefaultContent;
						_retrofitType = 38;
						ProgressbarAnimation();
						break;
					case "analyzer":
						ProgressContent = UIResources.Progressbar_AnalyzerContent;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

				{
					_logFile = System.IO.Path.GetTempPath() + System.IO.Path.ChangeExtension(value, "atslv");
				}
			}

		private void ViewLogs(object arg)
		{
			if (!File.Exists(_logFile))
			{
				File.Create(_logFile).Dispose();
				using StreamWriter streamWriter = new FileInfo(_logFile).AppendText();
				streamWriter.WriteLine(string.Empty);
				streamWriter.Flush();
			}
			ShellExecute(IntPtr.Zero, "open", "notepad.exe", _logFile, "", 1);
		}

		private void Button_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			CloseWindow();
		}

		private void CloseWindow()
		{
			if (_eventAggregator == null)
			{
				Close();
				return;
			}
			_eventAggregator.GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Publish(new WorkflowControlStateArgs
			{
				ControlType = WorkflowControl.ModifyHeatExchanger_ProcessBar,
				State = "close"
			});
		}

		private void ProgressbarAnimation()
		{
			SolutionNumber = 5;
			PGB.IsIndeterminate = false;
			ProgressValue = 5;
			ProgressContent = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, new Regex(_retrofitType + "\\s*([\\s\\S]*?)(((-\\d)|(\\d))+[^}])", RegexOptions.Multiline).Match(UIResources.Progressbar_SolutionSeachResult).Groups[1].Value, 1, SolutionNumber, Environment.NewLine);
			UpdateProgressbarValue();
		}

		private void UpdateProgressbarValue()
		{
			DateTime start = DateTime.Now;
			int tryCounter = 0;
			int currentCounter = 0;
			DispatcherTimer dispatcherTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
			dispatcherTimer.Interval = new TimeSpan(1500L);
			dispatcherTimer.Tick += delegate(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				if (ProgressValue == 100 || (DateTime.Now - start).TotalMinutes >= 20.0)
				{
					if (sender is DispatcherTimer dispatcherTimer2)
					{
						dispatcherTimer2.Stop();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					currentCounter = ExtractCurrentDesignIndex();
					if (currentCounter > 1 && tryCounter == 0)
					{
						int num = tryCounter + 1;
						tryCounter = num;
					}
					else if (currentCounter >= 1)
					{
						int num = tryCounter + 1;
						tryCounter = num;
						ProgressValue = ((currentCounter == 1) ? 10 : ((currentCounter - 1) * 20));
						ProgressContent = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, new Regex(_retrofitType + "\\s*([\\s\\S]*?)(((-\\d)|(\\d))+[^}])", RegexOptions.Multiline).Match(UIResources.Progressbar_SolutionSeachResult).Groups[1].Value, currentCounter, SolutionNumber, Environment.NewLine);
					}
				}
			};
			dispatcherTimer.Start();
		}

		private int ExtractCurrentDesignIndex()
		{
			int result = -1;
			try
			{
				using FileStream stream = File.OpenRead(System.IO.Path.Combine(System.IO.Path.GetTempPath(), "Retrofit.log"));
				string s;
				using (StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream))
				{
					s = streamReader.ReadToEnd();
				}
				if (!int.TryParse(s, out result))
				{
					result = -1;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			return result;
		}

	public class Subflowsheet

		private Action<string, bool, bool> _selectedChangeEvent;

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public bool IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				return _isSelected;
			}
			set
			{
				bool flag = false;
				flag = _isSelected != value;
				_isSelected = value;
				if (_selectedChangeEvent != null)
				{
					_selectedChangeEvent(Name, _isSelected, flag);
				}
			}
		}

		public Action<string, bool, bool> SelectedChangeEvent
		{
			get
			{
				return _selectedChangeEvent;
			}
			set
			{
				_selectedChangeEvent = value;
			}
		}

		public Subflowsheet(string flowsheetName, bool isSelected = false, Action<string, bool, bool> selectedChangedAction = null)
		{
			Name = flowsheetName;
			_isSelected = isSelected;
			_selectedChangeEvent = selectedChangedAction;
		}
	}

	public class SelectedSubFlowSheetSetViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private readonly IEnergyAnalysisAgent _agent;

		private List<SelectableSubFlowsheetViewModel> _selectableSubFlowsheetSetViewModel = new List<SelectableSubFlowsheetViewModel>();

		public List<SelectableSubFlowsheetViewModel> Members => _selectableSubFlowsheetSetViewModel;

		public bool? AllMembersAreChecked
		{
			get
			{
				bool? flag = null;
				for (int i = 0; i < Members.Count; i++)
				{
					if (i == 0)
					{
						flag = Members[0].IsChecked;
					}
					else if (flag != Members[i].IsChecked)
					{
						flag = null;
						break;
					}
				}
				return flag;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!value.HasValue)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value == false && Members.Count((SelectableSubFlowsheetViewModel m) => m.IsChecked) == 1 && Members.Count != 1)
				{
					value = true;
				}
				foreach (SelectableSubFlowsheetViewModel member in Members)
				{
					member.IsChecked = value.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		[InjectionConstructor]
		public SelectedSubFlowSheetSetViewModel(IEnergyAnalysisAgent agent)
		{
			_agent = agent;
			List<Subflowsheet> flowsheets = FlowsheetDataSource.Flowsheets;
			if (flowsheets == null || flowsheets.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Subflowsheet item2 in flowsheets)
			{
				SelectableSubFlowsheetViewModel item = new SelectableSubFlowsheetViewModel(item2, this);
				_selectableSubFlowsheetSetViewModel.Add(item);
			}
			foreach (SelectableSubFlowsheetViewModel item3 in _selectableSubFlowsheetSetViewModel)
			{
				item3.PropertyChanged += delegate(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					if (e.PropertyName == "IsChecked")
					{
						OnPropertyChanged("AllMembersAreChecked");
					}
				};
			}
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string prop)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(prop));
			}
		}
	}
	public class SelectableSubFlowsheetViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private readonly Subflowsheet _Subflowsheet;

		private readonly SelectedSubFlowSheetSetViewModel _parentViewModel;

		public bool IsChecked
		{
			get
			{
				return _Subflowsheet.IsSelected;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_Subflowsheet.IsSelected != value)
				{
					if (_parentViewModel.Members.Count((SelectableSubFlowsheetViewModel m) => m.IsChecked) == 1 && _Subflowsheet.IsSelected && !value)
					{
						MessageBox.Show(UIResources.AtLeastOneFlowsheetNeeded, UIResources.HeaterExchangerCost_CostRuleGrid_Message_ErrorTitle, MessageBoxButton.OK);
						return;
					}
					_Subflowsheet.IsSelected = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("IsChecked");
				}
			}
		}

		public string Name => _Subflowsheet.Name;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public SelectableSubFlowsheetViewModel(Subflowsheet subflowsheet, SelectedSubFlowSheetSetViewModel parentViewModel)
		{
			_Subflowsheet = subflowsheet;
			_parentViewModel = parentViewModel;
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string prop)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(prop));
			}
		}
	}

		public void SyncWithSimulatorUnits()
		{
			try
			{
				UnitConversionSetManager unitConversionSetManager = ParseUnitConversionSetManager();
				if (unitConversionSetManager != null)
				{
					UnitConversionSet unitConversionSet = unitConversionSetManager.GetUnitConversionSet(UnitConversionType_enum.uctHCost);
					SystemUnit_Label.Instance.CostYearlyRateUnit = unitConversionSet.CurrentDisplayUnit.name + "/Yr";
					SystemUnit_Label.Instance.FiscalUserUnit = ((unitConversionSet.CurrentDisplayUnit.name == "Cost") ? "" : unitConversionSet.CurrentDisplayUnit.name);
					UnitConversionSet unitConversionSet2 = unitConversionSetManager.GetUnitConversionSet(UnitConversionType_enum.uctMassFlow);
					SystemUnit_Label.Instance.MassflowUserUnit = unitConversionSet2.CurrentDisplayUnit.name;
					if (unitConversionSet2[SystemUnit_Label.Instance.MassflowUserUnit] is UnitConversion unitConversion)
					{
						SystemUnit_conversionFactors.ConvertToMassFlowDisplayUnitValue = unitConversion.FromCalculationUnit;
					}
					UnitConversionSet unitConversionSet3 = unitConversionSetManager.GetUnitConversionSet(UnitConversionType_enum.uctEnthalpy);
					SystemUnit_Label.Instance.EnthalpyUserUnit = unitConversionSet3.CurrentDisplayUnit.name;
					if (unitConversionSet3[SystemUnit_Label.Instance.EnthalpyUserUnit] is UnitConversion unitConversion2)
					{
						SystemUnit_conversionFactors.ConvertToEnthalpyDisplayUnitValue = unitConversion2.FromCalculationUnit;
					}
					UnitConversionSet unitConversionSet4 = unitConversionSetManager.GetUnitConversionSet(UnitConversionType_enum.uctCostPerMass);
					if (unitConversionSet4 != null)
					{
						SystemUnit_Label.Instance.UnitPriceUserUnit = unitConversionSet4.CurrentDisplayUnit.name;
					}
					if (unitConversionSet4[SystemUnit_Label.Instance.UnitPriceUserUnit] is UnitConversion unitConversion3)
					{
						SystemUnit_conversionFactors.ConvertToCostPerMassDisplayUnitValue = unitConversion3.FromCalculationUnit;
						SystemUnit_conversionFactors.ConvertFromCostPerMassDisplayUnitValue = unitConversion3.ToCalculationUnit;
					}
					UnitConversionSet unitConversionSet5 = unitConversionSetManager.GetUnitConversionSet(UnitConversionType_enum.uctArea);
					if (unitConversionSet5 != null)
					{
						SystemUnit_Label.Instance.AreaUserUnit = unitConversionSet5.CurrentDisplayUnit.name;
					}
					if (unitConversionSet5[SystemUnit_Label.Instance.AreaUserUnit] is UnitConversion unitConversion4)
					{
						SystemUnit_conversionFactors.ConvertToAreaDisplayUnitValue = unitConversion4.FromCalculationUnit;
						SystemUnit_conversionFactors.ConvertFromAreaDisplayUnitValue = unitConversion4.ToCalculationUnit;
					}
					UnitConversionSet unitConversionSet6 = unitConversionSetManager.GetUnitConversionSet(UnitConversionType_enum.uctTemperature);
					if (unitConversionSet6 != null)
					{
						SystemUnit_Label.Instance.TempUserUnit = unitConversionSet6.CurrentDisplayUnit.name;
					}
					if (unitConversionSet6[SystemUnit_Label.Instance.TempUserUnit] is UnitConversion unitConversion5)
					{
						SystemUnit_conversionFactors.ConvertToTemperatureDisplayUnitValue = unitConversion5.FromCalculationUnit;
						SystemUnit_conversionFactors.ConvertFromTemperatureDisplayUnitValue = unitConversion5.ToCalculationUnit;
					}
					UnitConversionSet unitConversionSet7 = unitConversionSetManager.GetUnitConversionSet(UnitConversionType_enum.uctDeltaTemperature);
					if (unitConversionSet7 != null)
					{
						SystemUnit_Label.Instance.DeltaTempUserUnit = unitConversionSet7.CurrentDisplayUnit.name;
					}
					if (unitConversionSet7[SystemUnit_Label.Instance.DeltaTempUserUnit] is UnitConversion unitConversion6)
					{
						SystemUnit_conversionFactors.ConvertToDeltaTemperatureDisplayUnitValue = unitConversion6.FromCalculationUnit;
						SystemUnit_conversionFactors.ConvertFromDeltaTemperatureDisplayUnitValue = unitConversion6.ToCalculationUnit;
					}
					UnitConversionSet unitConversionSet8 = unitConversionSetManager.GetUnitConversionSet(UnitConversionType_enum.uctUA);
					if (unitConversionSet8 != null)
					{
						SystemUnit_Label.Instance.OverallUAUserUnit = unitConversionSet8.CurrentDisplayUnit.name;
					}
					if (unitConversionSet8[SystemUnit_Label.Instance.OverallUAUserUnit] is UnitConversion unitConversion7)
					{
						SystemUnit_conversionFactors.ConvertToUADisplayUnitValue = unitConversion7.FromCalculationUnit;
					}
					UnitConversionSet unitConversionSet9 = unitConversionSetManager.GetUnitConversionSet(UnitConversionType_enum.uctHeatCoefficient);
					if (unitConversionSet9 != null)
					{
						SystemUnit_Label.Instance.OverallHTCUserUnit = unitConversionSet9.CurrentDisplayUnit.name;
					}
					if (unitConversionSet9[SystemUnit_Label.Instance.OverallHTCUserUnit] is UnitConversion unitConversion8)

						SystemUnit_conversionFactors.ConvertToOverallHTCDisplayUnitValue = unitConversion8.FromCalculationUnit;
						SystemUnit_conversionFactors.ConvertFromOverallHTCDisplayUnitValue = unitConversion8.ToCalculationUnit;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		private UnitConversionSetManager ParseUnitConversionSetManager()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_caseFilePath))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(Marshal.BindToMoniker(_caseFilePath) is SimulationCase simulationCase))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((Aspentech.HYSYS.Application)(dynamic)simulationCase.Application)?.UnitConversionSetManager;
		}

		public void OpenHeatExchangerView(string filePath, string exchangerName)
		{
			try
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(exchangerName) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath) || !(Marshal.BindToMoniker(filePath) is SimulationCase simulationCase) || !exchangerName.Contains('@'))
				{
					return;
				}
				string[] array = exchangerName.Split(new char[1] { '@' }, 2);
				string text = array[0];
				string text2 = null;
				bool flag = false;
				int num = 2;
				if (array.Length > 1)
				{
					text2 = array[1];
					if (text2.EndsWith("_Exchanger"))
					{
						text2 = text2.Substring(0, text2.LastIndexOf('_'));
						flag = true;
					}
					else if (text2.Contains('_') && text2.Contains('@'))
					{
						text2 = text2.Substring(0, text2.LastIndexOf('_'));
					}
				}
				Flowsheet flowsheet = FindFlowsheet(simulationCase.Flowsheet, text2);
				if (flowsheet == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				BackDoor backDoor = null;
				if (flag)
				{
					Streams streams = flowsheet.Streams;
					if (((string[])(dynamic)streams.Names).Contains(text))
					{
						Aspentech.HYSYS.ProcessStream processStream = (dynamic)streams[text];
						FixedAttachments attachedOpers = processStream.AttachedOpers;
						if (attachedOpers.Count == 0)
						{
							backDoor = processStream as BackDoor;
							num = 0;
						}
						else
						{
							backDoor = (dynamic)attachedOpers[0];
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Operations operations = flowsheet.get_Operations(Type.Missing);
					if (((string[])(dynamic)operations.Names).Contains(text))
					{
						backDoor = (dynamic)operations[text];
					}
				}
				if (backDoor != null)
				{
					backDoor.SendBackDoorMessage("ViewTabbed");
					if (backDoor is GibbsReactor || backDoor is ConversionReactor || backDoor is KineticReactor || backDoor is EquilibriumReactor)
					{
						num = 3;
					}
					((dynamic)backDoor.get_BackDoorVariable((object)":PageNumber.0").Variable).SetValue(num);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				_ = ex.Message;
			}
		}

		private Flowsheet FindFlowsheet(Flowsheet fs, string tag)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tag))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (fs.name == tag)
			{
				return fs;
			}
			foreach (Flowsheet flowsheet2 in fs.Flowsheets)
			{
				Flowsheet flowsheet = FindFlowsheet(flowsheet2, tag);
				if (flowsheet != null)
				{
					return flowsheet;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Start(string filePath, bool? updateTree)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath))
			{
				return;
			}
			_caseFilePath = filePath;
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CaseDocument>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			try
			{
				object obj = Marshal.BindToMoniker(filePath);
				SimulationCase simCase = obj as SimulationCase;
				BackDoor backDoor = simCase as BackDoor;
				if (backDoor == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				backDoor.SendBackDoorMessage("SetUtilityInformation");
				bool topologyChanged = true;
				double lifeOfPlant;
				double operatingHours;
				double carbonFeeTax = (lifeOfPlant = (operatingHours = 0.0));
				IList<string> flowsheetsName = new List<string>();
				IList<string> list = new List<string>();
				IList<double> utilDTMins = new List<double>();
				IList<double> utilFactors = new List<double>();
				list = GetUtilityDataFromHYSYSPUM(simCase.ProcessUtilityManager, out utilDTMins, out utilFactors);
				IEnumerable<HYSYSEnergyStream> energyStreams = null;

		private IList<string> GetFlowsheetsName(Flowsheet flowsheet)
		{
			IList<string> list = new List<string>();
			Stack<Flowsheet> stack = new Stack<Flowsheet>();
			stack.Push(flowsheet);
			while (stack.Count > 0)
			{
				Flowsheet flowsheet2 = stack.Pop();
				if (flowsheet2 != null && flowsheet2.TypeName != "sruflowsheet")
				{
					list.Add(flowsheet2.TaggedName);
				}
				if (flowsheet2 != null && flowsheet2.Flowsheets.Count > 0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < flowsheet2.Flowsheets.Count; i++)
					{
						stack.Push(flowsheet2.Flowsheets[i] as Flowsheet);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IEnumerable<HYSYSEnergyStream> GetEnergyStreams(Flowsheet flowsheet, ProcessUtilityManager utilityManager, Dictionary<string, IList<string>> flowsheetEnergyStreamDic = null)
		{
			Collection<HYSYSEnergyStream> collection = new Collection<HYSYSEnergyStream>();
			IList<string>[] utilities = GetUtilities(utilityManager);
			Func<FixedAttachments, string> func = delegate(FixedAttachments attachment)
			{
				bool flag4 = attachment == null;
				if (flag4 || ((flag4 | ((dynamic)attachment.Names == null)) ? true : false))
				{
					return (string)null;
				}
				return (!(attachment.Names is IList<string> { Count: not 0 } list2)) ? null : list2[0];
			};
			Stack<Flowsheet> stack = new Stack<Flowsheet>();
			stack.Push(flowsheet);
			while (stack.Count > 0)
			{
				Flowsheet flowsheet2 = stack.Pop();
				if (flowsheet2 == null || flowsheet2.EnergyStreams == null || flowsheet2.TypeName == "sruflowsheet")
				{
					continue;
				}
				IList<string> list = flowsheet2.EnergyStreams.Names as IList<string>;
				for (int num = 0; num < flowsheet2.EnergyStreams.Count; num++)
				{
					if (!(flowsheet2.EnergyStreams[num] is Aspentech.HYSYS.ProcessStream processStream))
					{
						continue;
					}
					try
					{
						string text = func(processStream.UpstreamOpers);
						bool flag = false;
						bool flag2 = false;
						bool flag3 = false;
						flag2 = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text);
						if (flag2 && processStream.HeatFlowValue > 0.0)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						if (flag2 && processStream.HeatFlowValue < 0.0)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						if (Math.Abs(processStream.HeatFlowValue) < 1E-10)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (text == null)
						{
							text = func(processStream.DownstreamOpers);
						}
						if (!flag2 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
						{
							flag3 = true;
						}
						if (flag3 && processStream.HeatFlowValue > 0.0)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						if (flag3 && processStream.HeatFlowValue < 0.0)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						Temperature? temperature = GetFeedAndProductTemperature(text, flowsheet2.get_Operations(Type.Missing));
						if (!temperature.HasValue)
						{
							continue;
						}
						string text2 = flowsheet2.TaggedName.Substring(flowsheet2.TaggedName.IndexOf('(') + 1, flowsheet2.TaggedName.Length - flowsheet2.TaggedName.IndexOf('(') - 2);
						text = text + "@" + text2;
						list[num] = list[num] + "@" + text2;
						IValueUnit valueUnitConverter = UnitValueFactory.Create(ValueUnitEnum.HYSYSSimulator);
						collection.Add(new HYSYSEnergyStream(processStream.SetUtilityTagName, OnAddNewUtility)
						{
							Name = list[num],
							Unit = text,
							FlowSheetName = flowsheet2.TaggedName,
							UtilityTypes = (flag ? utilities[0] : utilities[1]),
							UtilityName = ((flowsheetEnergyStreamDic == null || !flowsheetEnergyStreamDic.ContainsKey(flowsheet2.TaggedName.GetHashCode().ToString()) || flowsheetEnergyStreamDic[flowsheet2.TaggedName.GetHashCode().ToString()].Count <= num) ? processStream.GetUtilityTagName() : flowsheetEnergyStreamDic[flowsheet2.TaggedName.GetHashCode().ToString()][num]),
							InletTemperatrues = (utilityManager.InletTemperature.Values as double[]),
							OutletTemperatures = (utilityManager.OutletTemperature.Values as double[]),
							UtilDeltaT = (utilityManager.DeltaT.Values as double[]),
							FeedAndProductTemperature = temperature.Value,
							UtilitiesOriginalTypes = (utilityManager.UtilityName.Values as string[]),
							ValueUnitConverter = valueUnitConverter,
							ShowConfigurationChangedOnDashboardAction = delegate
							{
								if (_container != null)
								{
									UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>())?.UpdateDashboardStatus(new UpdateDashboardStatusArgs
									{
										Mode = StatusControlDisplayMode.TextWithWarning,
										Hint = "ConfigurationChanged"
									});
								}
							}
						});
					}
					catch (COMException ex)
					{
						_ = ex.Message;
					}
				}
				if (flowsheet2.Flowsheets.Count > 0)
				{
					for (int num2 = 0; num2 < flowsheet2.Flowsheets.Count; num2++)
					{
						stack.Push(flowsheet2.Flowsheets[num2] as Flowsheet);
					}
				}
			}

		}

		private dynamic GetFeedAndProductTemperature(string utilityOpertation, Operations operations)
		{
			try
			{
				if (operations == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				double inlet = double.NaN;
				double outlet = double.NaN;
				int num = operations.get_index((object)utilityOpertation);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				_ = (string)((dynamic)operations[num]).TypeName;
				UnitOperationTypeEnum unitOperationTypeEnum = default(UnitOperationTypeEnum);
				if ((!Enum.TryParse(((dynamic)operations[num]).TypeName, true, out unitOperationTypeEnum)))
				{
					return null;
				}
				Aspentech.HYSYS.ProcessStream processStream = ((dynamic)operations[num]).AttachedFeeds[0] as Aspentech.HYSYS.ProcessStream;
				Aspentech.HYSYS.ProcessStream processStream2 = ((dynamic)operations[num]).AttachedProducts[0] as Aspentech.HYSYS.ProcessStream;
				if ((unitOperationTypeEnum == UnitOperationTypeEnum.flashtank || unitOperationTypeEnum == UnitOperationTypeEnum.sep3op || unitOperationTypeEnum == UnitOperationTypeEnum.partialcondenser || unitOperationTypeEnum == UnitOperationTypeEnum.reactorop || unitOperationTypeEnum == UnitOperationTypeEnum.kineticreactorop || unitOperationTypeEnum == UnitOperationTypeEnum.pfreactorop || unitOperationTypeEnum == UnitOperationTypeEnum.conversionreactorop || unitOperationTypeEnum == UnitOperationTypeEnum.equilibriumreactorop || unitOperationTypeEnum == UnitOperationTypeEnum.gibbsreactorop) && processStream != null && processStream2 != null)
				{
					inlet = processStream.TemperatureValue;
					outlet = processStream2.TemperatureValue;
				}
				switch (unitOperationTypeEnum)
				{
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.Unknow:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.Columnop:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.distillation:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.reboiledabsorber:
					return null;
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.Coolerop:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.Heaterop:
					return new Temperature(((dynamic)operations[num]).FeedTemperatureValue, ((dynamic)operations[num]).ProductTemperatureValue);
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.Pumpop:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.Compressop:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.Compressor:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.fractop:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.expandop:
					return null;
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.Bpreboiler:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.Condenser3op:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.totalcondenser:
					return new Temperature(((dynamic)operations[num]).FeedStreams[0].TemperatureValue, ((dynamic)operations[num]).LiquidStream.TemperatureValue);
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.Separator:
					return new Temperature(((dynamic)operations[num]).AttachedFeeds[0].Temperature, ((dynamic)operations[num]).VapourProduct.Temperature);
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.sep3op:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.flashtank:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.partialcondenser:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.reactorop:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.kineticreactorop:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.gibbsreactorop:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.pfreactorop:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.conversionreactorop:
				case UnitOperationTypeEnum.equilibriumreactorop:
					return new Temperature(inlet, outlet);
				default:
					return new Temperature(double.NaN, double.NaN);
				}
			}
			catch (ArgumentNullException)
			{
				return null;
			}
			catch (ArgumentOutOfRangeException)
			{
				return null;
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				return null;
			}
			catch (NullReferenceException)
			{
				return null;
			}
			catch (Exception ex5)
			{
				_ = ex5.Message;
				return null;
			}
		}

		private IList<string>[] GetUtilities(ProcessUtilityManager utilityManager)
		{
			IList<string>[] array = new IList<string>[2];
			try
			{
				Collection<string> collection = new Collection<string>();
				Collection<string> collection2 = new Collection<string>();
				string[] array2 = utilityManager.UtilityName.Values as string[];
				double[] array3 = utilityManager.InletTemperature.Values as double[];
				double[] array4 = utilityManager.OutletTemperature.Values as double[];
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					if (array3[i] != array4[i] && IsTemperatureDefined(array3[i]) && IsTemperatureDefined(array4[i]))
					{
						if (array3[i] > array4[i])
						{
							collection2.Add(array2[i]);
						}
						else
						{
							collection.Add(array2[i]);
						}
					}
				}
				string addNew = UIResources.AddNew;
				collection2.Add(addNew);
				collection.Add(addNew);
				array[0] = collection;
				array[1] = collection2;
			}
			catch (NullReferenceException)
			{
			}
			return array;
		}

		private bool IsTemperatureDefined(double temp)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (temp < -273.15)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void SendData(object newValue, string property)
		{
			if (!(Marshal.BindToMoniker(_caseFilePath) as SimulationCase is BackDoor backDoor))
			{
				return;
			}
			string empty = string.Empty;
			DataTypes dataTypes = DataTypes.Unknown;
			BackDoorMessageTypeEnum messageType = BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.Unknow;
			if (!(property == "CarbonFee"))
			{
				if (property == "topologyChanged")
				{
					messageType = BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.TopologyChangeStatus;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				messageType = BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.CarbonFee;
			}
			empty = getCommand(messageType);
			switch (getType(messageType))
			{
			case DataTypes.Real:
			case DataTypes.Boolean:
			{
				double value = Convert.ToDouble(newValue);
				SetInternalRealData(backDoor, empty, value);
				break;
			}
			case DataTypes.Unknown:
			case DataTypes.RealFlex:
			case DataTypes.Text:
			case DataTypes.TextFlex:
				break;
			}
		}

		private string getCommand(BackDoorMessageTypeEnum messageType)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			switch (messageType)
			{
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.Names:
				result = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, ":Name.{0}.[]", (int)messageType);
				break;
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.Factors:
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.DeltaMinTemperature:
				result = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, ":ExtraData.{0}.[]", (int)messageType);
				break;
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.HeatExchangerCost_OperationLifeOfPlant:
				result = ":Time.400";
				break;
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.CarbonFee:
				result = ":CostPerMass.194";
				break;
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.HeatExchangerCost_OperationHoursPerYear:
				result = ":Time.402";
				break;
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.TopologyChangeStatus:
				result = ":Boolean.701";
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private DataTypes getType(BackDoorMessageTypeEnum messageType)
		{
			DataTypes result = DataTypes.Unknown;
			switch (messageType)
			{
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.Names:
				result = DataTypes.TextFlex;
				break;
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.Factors:
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.DeltaMinTemperature:
				result = DataTypes.RealFlex;
				break;
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.CarbonFee:
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.HeatExchangerCost_OperationLifeOfPlant:
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.HeatExchangerCost_OperationHoursPerYear:
				result = DataTypes.Real;
				break;
			case BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.TopologyChangeStatus:
				result = DataTypes.Boolean;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string getMessage(BackDoorMessageTypeEnum messageType)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			if (messageType == BackDoorMessageTypeEnum.CarbonFee || (uint)(messageType - 301) <= 1u || (uint)(messageType - 555) <= 3u)
			{
				result = ":ClearTopologyFlag";
			}
			return result;
		}

		private object GetData(BackDoor backDoor, BackDoorMessageTypeEnum messageType)
		{
			object obj = null;
			string command = getCommand(messageType);
			if (command == string.Empty)
			{
				return obj;
			}
			DataTypes type = getType(messageType);
			switch (type)
			{
			case DataTypes.Real:
			case DataTypes.Boolean:
				obj = GetInternalRealData(backDoor, command);
				if (type == DataTypes.Boolean)
				{
					obj = Convert.ToBoolean(obj);
				}
				break;
			case DataTypes.RealFlex:
				obj = GetInternalRealFlexData(backDoor, command);
				break;
			case DataTypes.Text:
				obj = GetInternalTextData(backDoor, command);
				break;
			case DataTypes.TextFlex:
				obj = GetInternalTextFlexData(backDoor, command);
				break;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private object GetInternalTextFlexData(BackDoor backDoor, string command)
		{
			InternalVariableWrapper internalVariableWrapper = backDoor.get_BackDoorVariable((object)command);
			if (internalVariableWrapper == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(internalVariableWrapper.Variable is InternalTextFlexVariable internalTextFlexVariable))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return internalTextFlexVariable.Values;
		}

		private object GetInternalTextData(BackDoor backDoor, string command)
		{
			InternalVariableWrapper internalVariableWrapper = backDoor.get_BackDoorVariable((object)command);
			if (internalVariableWrapper == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(internalVariableWrapper.Variable is InternalTextVariable internalTextVariable))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return internalTextVariable.Value;
		}

		private object GetInternalRealFlexData(BackDoor backDoor, string command)
		{
			InternalVariableWrapper internalVariableWrapper = backDoor.get_BackDoorVariable((object)command);
			if (internalVariableWrapper == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(internalVariableWrapper.Variable is InternalRealFlexVariable internalRealFlexVariable))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return internalRealFlexVariable.Values;
		}

		private object GetInternalRealData(BackDoor backDoor, string command)
		{
			InternalVariableWrapper internalVariableWrapper = backDoor.get_BackDoorVariable((object)command);
			if (internalVariableWrapper == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(internalVariableWrapper.Variable is InternalRealVariable internalRealVariable))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return internalRealVariable.Value;
		}

		private void SetInternalRealData(BackDoor backDoor, string command, double value)
		{
			InternalVariableWrapper internalVariableWrapper = backDoor.get_BackDoorVariable((object)command);
			if (internalVariableWrapper != null && internalVariableWrapper.Variable is InternalRealVariable internalRealVariable)
			{
				internalRealVariable.Value = value;
			}
		}
	}

				dblInletTemp = new double[array.Length];
				int num7 = 0;

						continue;
					}
					double? num8 = null;
					double? num9 = null;

					double? num12 = (num9 = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(_dataProvider.BatchGet(text9, "value", "C")));
					dblOutletTemp[num7] = ((num12.HasValue && num12.HasValue) ? num12.Value : double.NaN);
					string text10 = "Top.appModel.Utilities." + text8 + ".Input.TIN";
					double? num13 = (num8 = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(_dataProvider.BatchGet(text10, "value", "C")));
					dblInletTemp[num7] = ((num13.HasValue && num13.HasValue) ? num13.Value : double.NaN);
					string text11 = "Top.appModel.Utilities." + text8 + ".Input.VFRAC_OUT";
					num11 = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(_dataProvider.BatchGet(text11, "value", "C"));
					string text12 = "Top.appModel.Utilities." + text8 + ".Input.VFRAC";

					if (num8.HasValue && num9.HasValue)
					{

						{
							if (dblInletTemp[num7] > dblOutletTemp[num7])
							{
								_hotUtilities.Add(text8);
							}
							else

								_coldUlities.Add(text8);
							}
						}
						else if (num11.HasValue && num10.HasValue)
						{
							if (num10 > num11)
							{
								_hotUtilities.Add(text8);
							}
							else
							{
								_coldUlities.Add(text8);
							}
						}
					}
					else if (num11.HasValue && num10.HasValue)

						else
						{
							_coldUlities.Add(text8);

					{

						dblOutletTemp[num7] = num15.Value;
						if (num14.Value > num15.Value)
						{
							_hotUtilities.Add(text8);
						}
						else if (num14.Value < num15.Value)
						{
							_coldUlities.Add(text8);
						}
						else if (num17.HasValue && num16.HasValue)
						{
							if (num17.Value > num16.Value)
							{
								_hotUtilities.Add(text8);
							}
							else
							{
								_coldUlities.Add(text8);
							}
						}
					}
					num7++;
				}
				string addNew = UIResources.AddNew;
				_hotUtilities.Add(addNew);
				_coldUlities.Add(addNew);
			}
			string text14 = "Top.appModel.Setup.Main.Input.OPER_YEAR";
			double? num18 = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(_dataProvider.BatchGet(text14, "value", "hr"));

			num19 = ((num20.HasValue && num20.HasValue) ? num20.Value : 5.0);
			double num21 = 0.0;
			string text16 = "Top.appModel.Setup.Sim-Options.Input.CARBON_FEE";

			}

		public void OpenHeatExchangerView(string filePath, string exchangerName)
		{
			string text = "";
			string[] array = null;
			if (exchangerName.Contains('@'))
			{
				array = exchangerName.Split(new char[1] { '@' }, 2);
			}
			else
			{
				text = exchangerName;
			}
			string text2 = "";
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (array != null && array.Length > 1)
			{
				text2 = array[1];
			}
			else if (text.EndsWith("_heat_Exchanger"))
			{
				text2 = text.Substring(0, text.IndexOf('_'));
				flag2 = true;
			}
			else if (text.EndsWith("_Exchanger") && !flag2)
			{
				text2 = text.Substring(0, text.LastIndexOf('_'));
				flag = true;
			}
			else
			{
				text2 = text;
			}
			if (text.Contains("."))
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					text2 = text2.Replace(".", ".Blocks.");
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					string text3 = text2.Substring(0, text.LastIndexOf('.')).Replace(".", ".Blocks.");
					text2.LastIndexOf('.');
					int num = text2.LastIndexOf('.') + 1;
					int length = text2.Length;
					string text4 = text.Substring(num, length - num);
					text4 = ".Streams." + text4;
					text2 = text3 + text4;
				}
				else
				{
					text2 = text.Replace(".", ".Blocks.");
				}
			}
			text2 = ((!flag || text.Contains(".")) ? ("Blocks." + text2) : ("Streams." + text2));
			string path = text2;
			EAGoToNodeEventArgs payload = new EAGoToNodeEventArgs
			{
				Path = path,
				TabName = null,
				UseNewTab = true
			};
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<EAGotoNodeEvent>().Publish(payload);
		}

		public void SetUtilityID(string sNewUtility, string sUnit)
		{
			string sPid = string.Empty;
			string utilMMvar = string.Empty;
			string unitOpIDfromEAName = GetUnitOpIDfromEAName(sUnit, ref sPid, ref utilMMvar);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(unitOpIDfromEAName))
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = "Top.appModelV8.Blocks.";
			if (unitOpIDfromEAName.Length > 0)
			{
				string text2 = unitOpIDfromEAName.Replace(".", ".Data.Blocks.");
				text += text2;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(utilMMvar))
			{
				string text3 = text + ".Input." + utilMMvar.ToUpper();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sPid))
				{
					text3 = text + ".Subobjects.Pumparounds." + sPid + ".Input." + utilMMvar.ToUpper() + "sPid";
				}
				_dataProvider.BatchSet(text3, "value", (string)null, (object)sNewUtility);
				_dataProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				ResetTopologyFlaginSimulator(null, topologyFlag: true);
			}
		}

		public string GetUnitOpIDfromEAName(string sEAName, ref string sPid, ref string utilMMvar)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sEAName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			utilMMvar = "utility_id";
			if (sEAName.Contains("_Exchangers"))
			{
				return sEAName.Split('_')[0];
			}
			if (sEAName.Contains("@"))
			{
				string[] array = sEAName.Split('@');
				if (array[0].ToLower() == "condenser")
				{
					utilMMvar = "cond_util";
				}
				else if (array[0].ToLower() == "reboiler")
				{
					utilMMvar = "reb_util";
				}
				else
				{
					sPid = array[0];
					utilMMvar = "pautility_id";
				}
				return array[1];
			}
			string text = "Top.appModelV8.Blocks.";
			if (sEAName.Length > 0)
			{
				string text2 = sEAName.Replace(".", ".Data.Blocks.");
				text += text2;
			}
			string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(_dataProvider.BatchGet(text, "type", (string)null));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3) && text3.ToUpper() == "HEATX")
			{
				string text4 = text + ".Input.HOT_UTIL";
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(CxsConverter.ValueToString(_dataProvider.BatchGet(text4, "value", (string)null))))
				{
					utilMMvar = "hot_util";
				}
				text4 = text + ".Input.COLD_UTIL";
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(CxsConverter.ValueToString(_dataProvider.BatchGet(text4, "value", (string)null))))
				{
					utilMMvar = "cold-util";
				}
			}
			return sEAName;
		}

		public string ConstructDisplayName(string sUnitOp, string sUtilityMMVar, string sId)
		{
			string text = "Top.appModelV8.Blocks.";
			if (sUnitOp.Length > 0)
			{
				string text2 = sUnitOp.Replace(".", ".Data.Blocks.");
				text += text2;
			}
			string empty = string.Empty;
			return sUtilityMMVar switch
			{
				"cond-util" => "Condenser@" + sUnitOp, 
				"reb-util" => "Reboiler@" + sUnitOp, 
				"pautility-id" => sId + "@" + sUnitOp, 
				_ => sUnitOp, 
			};
		}

		private void AddHYSYSEnergyStream(string sMainPath, string sUniqueId, string sUtilityVar, string sUtilityId, double heatDuty)
		{
			IValueUnit valueUnitConverter = UnitValueFactory.Create(ValueUnitEnum.Simulator);
			HYSYSEnergyStream hYSYSEnergyStream = new HYSYSEnergyStream(SetUtilityID, OnAddNewUtility);
			hYSYSEnergyStream.ValueUnitConverter = valueUnitConverter;
			hYSYSEnergyStream.SendUtilToSim = false;
			hYSYSEnergyStream.Unit = sUniqueId;
			hYSYSEnergyStream.UtilityName = sUtilityId;
			hYSYSEnergyStream.ShowConfigurationChangedOnDashboardAction = delegate
			{
				if (_container != null)
				{
					UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEnergyAnalysisAgent>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>())?.UpdateDashboardStatus(new UpdateDashboardStatusArgs
					{
						Mode = StatusControlDisplayMode.TextWithWarning,
						Hint = "ConfigurationChanged"
					});
				}
			};
			if (sUniqueId.Contains("@"))
			{
				string[] array = sUniqueId.Split('@');
				hYSYSEnergyStream.FlowSheetName = array[1];
			}
			else if (sUniqueId.Contains("."))
			{
				int length = sUniqueId.LastIndexOf('.');
				hYSYSEnergyStream.FlowSheetName = sUniqueId.Substring(0, length);
			}
			else
			{
				hYSYSEnergyStream.FlowSheetName = "Case (Main)";
			}
			bool num = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sUtilityId) && (_coldUlities.Contains(sUtilityId) || _hotUtilities.Contains(sUtilityId));
			bool flag = _coldUlities.Contains(sUtilityId);
			if (!num)
			{
				if (sUtilityVar.IndexOf("utility-id") != -1 || sUtilityVar.IndexOf("hot-util") != -1 || sUtilityVar.IndexOf("cold-util") != -1)
				{
					if (heatDuty < 0.0)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else if (heatDuty > 0.0)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				else if (sUtilityVar.IndexOf("cond-util") != -1)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (sUtilityVar.IndexOf("reb-util") != -1)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				hYSYSEnergyStream.UtilityTypes = _coldUlities;
			}
			else
			{
				hYSYSEnergyStream.UtilityTypes = _hotUtilities;
			}
			hYSYSEnergyStream.UtilDeltaT = dblDeltaMin;
			hYSYSEnergyStream.InletTemperatrues = dblInletTemp;
			hYSYSEnergyStream.OutletTemperatures = dblOutletTemp;
			if (sUtilityVar.IndexOf("utility-id") != -1 || sUtilityVar.IndexOf("hot-util") != -1 || sUtilityVar.IndexOf("cold-util") != -1)
			{
				List<string> sInlet = new List<string>();
				List<string> sOutlet = new List<string>();
				GetModelInletAndOutletStreams(sMainPath, ref sInlet, ref sOutlet);
				double num2 = 0.0;
				double? dblTempVal = 0.0;
				if (sInlet.Count() > 0)
				{
					for (int num3 = 0; num3 < sInlet.Count(); num3++)
					{
						double? dblTempVal2 = null;
						GetStreamTemp(sMainPath, sInlet[num3], ref dblTempVal2);
						if (!dblTempVal2.HasValue || !dblTempVal2.HasValue)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (num3 == 0)
						{
							num2 = dblTempVal2.Value;
						}
						else if (flag)
						{
							if (num2 < dblTempVal2.Value)
							{
								num2 = dblTempVal2.Value;
							}
						}
						else if (num2 > dblTempVal2.Value)
						{
							num2 = dblTempVal2.Value;
						}
					}
					if (sOutlet.Count() > 0)
					{
						for (int num4 = 0; num4 < sOutlet.Count(); num4++)
						{
							GetStreamTemp(sMainPath, sOutlet[num4], ref dblTempVal);
							if (dblTempVal.HasValue && dblTempVal.HasValue)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					Temperature feedAndProductTemperature = new Temperature(num2, dblTempVal.HasValue ? dblTempVal.Value : 0.0);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sUtilityId))
					{
						if (num2 > dblTempVal)
						{
							hYSYSEnergyStream.UtilityTypes = _coldUlities;
						}
						else
						{
							hYSYSEnergyStream.UtilityTypes = _hotUtilities;
						}
					}
					hYSYSEnergyStream.FeedAndProductTemperature = feedAndProductTemperature;
				}
			}
			else if (sUtilityVar.IndexOf("cond-util") != -1)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GetReboilerType(sMainPath)))
				{
					double? num5 = null;
					double? num6 = null;
					GetCondenserInletAndOutletTemp(sMainPath, out num5, out num6);
					if (num5.HasValue && num6.HasValue)
					{
						Temperature feedAndProductTemperature2 = new Temperature(num5.Value, num6.Value);
						hYSYSEnergyStream.FeedAndProductTemperature = feedAndProductTemperature2;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (sUtilityVar.IndexOf("reb-util") != -1)
			{
				double? num7 = null;
				double? num8 = null;
				GetReboilerInletAndOutletTemp(sMainPath, out num7, out num8);
				if (num7.HasValue && num8.HasValue)
				{
					Temperature feedAndProductTemperature3 = new Temperature(num7.Value, num8.Value);
					hYSYSEnergyStream.FeedAndProductTemperature = feedAndProductTemperature3;
				}
			}
			hYSYSEnergyStream.SendUtilToSim = true;
			_lstHYSYSEnergyStream.Add(hYSYSEnergyStream);
		}

		private void PopulateUtilityTable(string[] saSubFlowsheets)
		{
			InitUtilityVarMap();
			_lstHYSYSEnergyStream.Clear();
			foreach (string text in saSubFlowsheets)
			{
				string text2 = "Top.appModelV8.Blocks.";
				if (text.Length > 0)
				{
					string text3 = text.Replace(".", ".Data.Blocks.");
					text2 += text3;
				}
				string text4 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(_dataProvider.BatchGet(text2, "type", (string)null));
				double num = 0.0;
				string text5 = text2 + ".Output.QCALC";
				double? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(_dataProvider.BatchGet(text5, "value", "kW"));
				num = ((num2.HasValue && num2.HasValue) ? num2.Value : 0.0);
				if ((!text4.ToUpper().Contains("FRAC") && Math.Abs(num) < 1E-10) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4) || !_dictModel2MMUtilVarMap.TryGetValue(text4.ToUpper(), out var value) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					continue;
				}
				string[] array = value.Split(';');
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Count(); j++)
				{
					string text6 = array[j];
					text6 = text6.Replace('-', '_');
					string text7 = text2 + ".Input." + text6.ToUpper();
					if (!text6.Contains("pautility") && !text4.ToUpper().Contains("HEATX"))
					{
						string text8 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(_dataProvider.BatchGet(text7, "value", (string)null));
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text8))
						{
							text8 = "";
						}
						string sUniqueId = ConstructDisplayName(text, array[j], null);
						AddHYSYSEnergyStream(text2, sUniqueId, array[j], text8, num);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetModelInletAndOutletStreams(string sMainPath, ref List<string> sInlet, ref List<string> sOutlet)
		{
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(_dataProvider.BatchGet(sMainPath + ".Connections", "child_ids", (string)null));
			if (array == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text in array2)
			{
				string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(_dataProvider.BatchGet(sMainPath + ".Connections." + text, "value", (string)null));
				if (text2.IndexOf("(IN)") != -1)
				{
					sInlet.Add(text);
				}
				else if (text2.IndexOf("(OUT)") != -1)
				{
					sOutlet.Add(text);
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetStreamTemp(string sMainPath, string streamID, ref double? dblTempVal)
		{
			string text = CxsPath.CombinePaths(CxsPath.ParentPath(CxsPath.ParentPath(sMainPath)), "Streams");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(streamID))
			{
				string text2 = CxsPath.CombinePaths(text, streamID);
				string text3 = CxsPath.CombinePaths(text2, "Input.TEMP.MIXED");
				string value = CxsConverter.ValueToString(_dataProvider.BatchGet(text3, "value", "C"));
				string text4 = CxsPath.CombinePaths(text2, "Output.TEMP_OUT.MIXED");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4))
				{
					dblTempVal = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(_dataProvider.BatchGet(text4, "value", "C"));
				}
				else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					dblTempVal = Convert.ToDouble(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetColumnStageTemp(string sContextMainPath, int nStageIndx, out double? dblVal)
		{
			dblVal = null;
			string text = CxsPath.CombinePaths(sContextMainPath, "Input.NSTAGE");
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(_cxsCase.BatchGet(text, "value", (string)null));
			if (!(nStageIndx > num))
			{
				string text2 = CxsPath.CombinePaths(sContextMainPath, "Output.B_TEMP");
				if (CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(_cxsCase.BatchGet(text2, "child_ids")) != null)
				{
					string text3 = sContextMainPath + ".Output.B_TEMP." + nStageIndx;
					dblVal = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(_cxsCase.BatchGet(text3, "value", "C"));
				}
			}
		}

		private string GetCondenserType(string sMainPath)
		{
			string text = CxsPath.CombinePaths(sMainPath, "Input.CONDENSER");
			return CxsConverter.ValueToString(_cxsCase.BatchGet(text, "value", (string)null));
		}

		private string GetReboilerType(string sMainPath)
		{
			string text = CxsPath.CombinePaths(sMainPath, "Input.REBOILER");
			return CxsConverter.ValueToString(_cxsCase.BatchGet(text, "value", (string)null));
		}

		public void GetCondenserInletAndOutletTemp(string sMainPath, out double? dblInletTemp, out double? dblOutletTemp)
		{
			dblInletTemp = null;
			dblOutletTemp = null;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GetCondenserType(sMainPath)))
			{
				int nStageIndx = 1;
				GetColumnStageTemp(sMainPath, nStageIndx, out dblOutletTemp);
				nStageIndx = 2;
				GetColumnStageTemp(sMainPath, nStageIndx, out dblInletTemp);
			}
		}

		public void GetReboilerInletAndOutletTemp(string sMainPath, out double? dblInletTemp, out double? dblOutletTemp)
		{
			dblInletTemp = null;
			dblOutletTemp = null;
			string text = CxsPath.CombinePaths(sMainPath, "Input.NSTAGE");
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(_cxsCase.BatchGet(text, "value", (string)null));
			if (num.HasValue && num.HasValue)
			{
				int value = num.Value;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GetReboilerType(sMainPath)) && value > 1)
				{
					GetColumnStageTemp(sMainPath, value, out dblOutletTemp);
					GetColumnStageTemp(sMainPath, value - 1, out dblInletTemp);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SendDataToAspenPlus(object eaValue, string valueType)
		{
			if (_cxsCase != null)
			{
				string text = "";
				if (valueType == "CarbonFee")
				{
					text = "Top.appModel.Setup.Sim-Options.Input.CARBON_FEE";
					_dataProvider.BatchSet(text, "value", "$/kg", (object)Convert.ToDouble(eaValue));
					_dataProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool GetTopologyFlagFromSimulator()
		{
			bool flag = true;
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(_cxsCase.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "GetTopologyChangedFlag", Array.Empty<object>()));
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				flag = Convert.ToBoolean(num);
				HYSYSParameters hYSYSParameters = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<HYSYSParameters>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (hYSYSParameters != null)
				{
					hYSYSParameters.topologyChanged = flag;
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

			}
		}

		public void SetUtilityDeltaTMin(string utilityName, double tempVal)
		{
			if (_dataProvider != null)
			{
				string text = "Top.appModel.Utilities." + utilityName + ".Input.MIN_TAPP";
				double? num = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(_dataProvider.BatchGet(text, "value", "C"));
				if (num.HasValue && num.HasValue && num.Value != tempVal)
				{
					_dataProvider.BatchSet(text, "value", "C", (object)tempVal);
					_dataProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				}
			}
		}

			}
		}

	internal class SimulatorApplicationWrapper
	{
		private IUnityContainer _container;

		private string _casePath = string.Empty;

		private IApplicationWrapper _application;

		private string _simulatorName;

		public const string XmlExtension = "xml";

		private const string HYSYS_FILE_EXTENSION = ".hsc";

		private const string ASPENPLUS_FILE_EXTENSION = ".bkp";

		private const string SIMULATORNAME_ASPENPLUS = "aspenplus";

		private const string SIMULATORNAME_HYSYS = "hysys";

		[InjectionConstructor]
		public SimulatorApplicationWrapper(IUnityContainer container)
		{
			_container = container;
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<DocumentOpenedEvent>().Subscribe(OnDocumentOpenedEvent, ThreadOption.PublisherThread, keepSubscriberReferenceAlive: true, (DocumentOpenedArgs filter) => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(filter.OpenedDocumentPath));
			UnityContainerExtensions.RegisterInstance(_container, typeof(HYSYSParameters), (object)new HYSYSParameters());
			UnityContainerExtensions.RegisterInstance(_container, typeof(CaseDocument), (object)new CaseDocument());
			UnityContainerExtensions.RegisterInstance(_container, typeof(IDataResolver), (object)new Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.ClassLibrary.DataEngine.DataResolver());
		}

		private void OnDocumentOpenedEvent(DocumentOpenedArgs args)
		{
			string.Compare(_casePath, args.OpenedDocumentPath, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
			if (args.OpenedDocumentPath == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_casePath = args.OpenedDocumentPath;
			if (_application == null)
			{
				string text = args.SimulatorName;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					text = new FileInfo(_casePath).Extension.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						text = (args.SimulatorName ?? string.Empty).ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
					}
				}
				_application = GenerateApplication(text);
			}
			if (_application != null)
			{
				InitalizeDocument();
				UnityContainerExtensions.RegisterInstance(_container, typeof(IApplicationWrapper), (object)_application);
				bool value = !args.IsRestoringLayout && args.UpdateTree == true;
				_application.Start(_casePath, value);
				_application.SyncWithSimulatorUnits();
				string casePath = _casePath;
				object state = args.State;
				RestoreSavedFile(casePath, (IUnityContainer)((state is IUnityContainer) ? state : null), !args.IsRestoringLayout && (args.UpdateTree ?? true), args.DoNotLaunchEA);
			}
		}

		private IApplicationWrapper GenerateApplication(string fileExtension)
		{
			IApplicationWrapper result = null;
			switch (fileExtension)
			{
			case "hysys":
			case ".hsc":
				result = new Aspentech.EnergyAnalysis.UserInterface.HYSYSApplicationWrapper.HYSYSApplicationWrapper(_container);
				_simulatorName = "hysys";
				break;
			case "aspenplus":
			case ".bkp":
				result = new AspenPlusApplicationWrapper(_container);
				_simulatorName = "aspenplus";
				break;
			}
			UnitValueFactory.Create(_simulatorName);
			return result;
		}

		private void RestoreSavedFile(string filePath, IUnityContainer container, bool restoreNavigationTreeNodeSelection = true, bool DoNotLaunchEA = false)
		{
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<WorkflowControlStateEvent>().Publish(new WorkflowControlStateArgs
			{
				ControlType = WorkflowControl.SimulatorCase,
				State = new object[5]
				{
					filePath,
					_simulatorName,
					container,
					!restoreNavigationTreeNodeSelection,
					DoNotLaunchEA
				}
			});
		}

		public void OpenSimulatorHeatExchangerView(string filePath, string exchangerName)
		{
			if (_application != null)
			{
				_application.OpenHeatExchangerView(filePath, exchangerName);
			}
		}

		public void AppWrapStart(string filepath, bool flag)
		{
			if (_application != null)
			{
				_application.Start(filepath, flag);
			}
		}

		private bool IsHysysBk(string casefile)
		{
			string extension = System.IO.Path.GetExtension(casefile);
			if (extension.StartsWith(".bk"))
			{
				return extension != ".bkp";
			}
			return false;
		}

		private string GetXmlExtension(string casefile)
		{
			if (IsHysysBk(casefile))
			{
				return System.IO.Path.GetExtension(casefile).Replace(".bk", ".xm").Substring(1);
			}
			return "xml";
		}

		private void InitalizeDocument()
		{
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IDataResolver>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>())?.Active(System.IO.Path.ChangeExtension(_casePath, GetXmlExtension(_casePath)));
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CaseDocument>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).FilePath = System.IO.Path.ChangeExtension(_casePath, GetXmlExtension(_casePath));
		}
	}
}
